~Path of the Berserker~.Effect:
Instead of having normal Health Regen, 200% of your Health Regen is added to your Max Health (and as such your Health Regen after combat is always 0).
You can not gain extra Defense except through magical means (magic items, spells, etc).
~Path of the Berserker~.Notes: Increasing Health Regen increases your Max Health instead (and losing Health Regen loses you Max Health instead).
~Path of the Berserker~.Name: ~Path of the Berserker~

~Onslaught~.Effect: Whenever ^you^ kill a Worthy Enemy, Heal for 1d6 Health. In addition, if an Enemy has 25% or less Health, you know exactly how much Health it has (ask the QM).
~Onslaught~.Name: ~Onslaught~

~Reckless Charge~.Effect:
Freely dash exactly 2 meters towards a Worthy Enemy, landing on the closest space. It becomes Rooted.
~Your next weapon attack deals 2d6 extra Damage to the target and half of that to yourself.~
You can only use this once on every Worthy Enemy.
~Reckless Charge~.Name: ~Reckless Charge~
~Reckless Charge~.Notes: A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.

~Charge~.Effect: Freely dash exactly 2 meters towards a Worthy Enemy, landing on the closest space, near them.
~Charge~.Name: ~Charge~
~Charge~.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~War Craft~.Effect:
No two warriors fight alike. Choose your War Craft from below!
Each War Craft usually gives you a way to deal {Color('#ff5900' '+1d4 extra Damage each Turn')}.
~War Craft~.Upgrade: You may change your War Craft inbetween Adventures.
~War Craft~.Name: ~War Craft~

~Shield Craft~.Effect: Use after you are melee attacked. Make a {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attack against it for 1 base Smash Damage.
~Shield Craft~.Combo: And Slam it that many meters away from you.
~Shield Craft~.Name: ~Shield Craft~

~Dualwield Craft~.Effect: Your {Color('#ff5900' 'second 1')} {A}{Color('#ff5900' '{A}Action Point')} attack with a real weapon each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} {Color('#ff5900' 'if it is with a different weapon than the first attack')}.
~Dualwield Craft~.Name: ~Dualwield Craft~

~Heavy Weapon Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' '2')} {A}{Color('#ff5900' '{A}Action Points')} weapon attack each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} {Color('#ff5900' 'if there is an Ally, obstacle or wall directly behind your target')}.
~Heavy Weapon Craft~.Name: ~Heavy Weapon Craft~

~Throw Craft~.Effect:
You may {Color('#ff5900' 'throw')} real melee weapons with a 3-5 meter range.

If your first Act each Turn is a {Color('#ff5900' 'thrown')} weapon attack, it is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}.
~Throw Craft~.Name: ~Throw Craft~

~Unarmed Craft~.Effect: Your {Color('#ff5900' 'second Unarmed Combat*')} attack each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}. If it {Green('Critically Strikes')}, your next one is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} as well.
~Unarmed Craft~.Upgrade: You gain the Unarmed Combat Feat without spending the cost. You can find it on the `Feats page$/Other/Feats`.
~Unarmed Craft~.Name: ~Unarmed Craft~

~Marksman Craft~.Effect: Your first ~ranged~ weapon attack each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} {Color('#ff5900' 'if there is no Unit or obstacle near the target')}.
~Marksman Craft~.Name: ~Marksman Craft~

~Dual Shield Craft~.Effect:
You can Dual Wield shields and attack with them for 1d6 + ^Might or Instinct^ Damage.
Your first one each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}.
~Dual Shield Craft~.Name: ~Dual Shield Craft~

~Improvisation Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'Improvised* attack')} each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} {Color('#ff5900' 'if you have never used that object as a weapon')}.
~Improvisation Craft~.Upgrade: You gain the Unarmed Combat Feat without spending the cost. You can find it on the `Feats page$/Other/Feats`.
~Improvisation Craft~.Name: ~Improvisation Craft~

~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'old-fashioned*')} weapon attack each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}, {Color('#ff5900' 'and also applies a ~Combo~ if the target is a Person')}.
~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Upgrade: Old-fashioned weapons are weapons that do not deal extra Damage with any Stat (e.g. Hammer).
~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Name: ~Old-Fashioned Craft~

~Vault Break~.Effect: Slam the ground so hard that it shatters one obstacle that fits within a 3x3x3 meter area.
~Vault Break~.Notes: It is the Quest Master's call if an obstacle can be broken. Most walls can't be broken, except for thinner ones and fences.
~Vault Break~.Name: ~Vault Break~

~Sound Mind~.Effect:
Take 2d4 Damage.
Block any non-damaging negative incoming _effect_ on another ally you can see.
~Sound Mind~.Upgrade: Negative effects in this case means any Control Effect, Debuff, Curse, mind-altering magic, non-Damaging Poison, etc.
~Sound Mind~.Name: ~Sound Mind~

~Doublesault~.Effect: Leap up to 3 meters. If you land on a Unit, Doublesault again (for free)!
~Doublesault~.Notes:
You leap from Unit to Unit until you no longer land on a Unit. If you land on a Unit, you must leap again. You can't leap on the same Unit twice; if you do, you end your leap in the closest space near it.
You can use this even while in the air and it cancels out your current fall or acceleration.
~Doublesault~.Name: ~Doublesault~

~Snap Out Of It~.Effect: Attack a different Unit with a One-Handed weapon. Any of its Damage becomes Healing instead.
~Snap Out Of It~.Notes: Any extra Damage effects on it Heal as well (e.g. Fierce Craft, Criticl Strikes, etc). Apply any weapon effects if they happen. The attack might still do Healing to other collateral Units (if applies, e.g. Cleaver, Smite, etc).
~Snap Out Of It~.Name: ~Snap Out Of It~

~Strength and Honor~.Effect:
You may exceed the Level limits for maximum Stats.
You start with +1 in any Stat.
~Strength and Honor~.Notes: The maximum a Stat can be until Level 4 is +3. Between 4 and 8 is +4. There is no limit from Level 8 on.
~Strength and Honor~.Name: ~Strength and Honor~

~Bristleback~.Effect: You take less Damage when struck from behind. Enemies with 2 or less Presence...
~Bristleback~.Name: ~Bristleback~

~Hemmingstep~.Effect: When standing right next to a wall, you take -1 Damage from all sources.
~Hemmingstep~.Name: ~Hemmingstep~

~Painfeast~.Effect: Until the start of your next Turn, all Damage you take is transformed into Healing instead!
~Painfeast~.Name: ~Painfeast~

~Heavenbreaker~.Effect:
You jump high up above the battlefield and end your Turn.
At the start of your next Turn, you plunge into the earth like a comet towards a destintion space.
All Units within 3 meters of you take X Damage TODO and a crater forms in the zone, 2 meters deep at the extremities of the area.
~Heavenbreaker~.Name: ~Heavenbreaker~

~Survive Killing Blow~.Effect: Damage puts you at negative Health. When the effect expires, Heal for that amount.
~Survive Killing Blow~.Name: ~Survive Killing Blow~

~Bloodlusting More~.Effect: If an enemy dies around you, Heal.
~Bloodlusting More~.Name: ~Bloodlusting More~

~Strength of Giants~.Effect: You can't be damaged for more than 10% of your Maximum Health at once.
~Strength of Giants~.Name: ~Strength of Giants~

~Wolf Apparition~.Effect: Summon something with health equal to your missing health
~Wolf Apparition~.Name: ~Wolf Apparition~

<Undying Rage>.Effect:
Taking Damage that would kill you puts you in a state of primal rage, and leaves you at 1 Health instead.
For the rest of the Combat, increase all Healing you do on yourself by 50%.
<Undying Rage>.Name: <Undying Rage>

<Blood and Fire>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Strike a Unit for an amount of Fire Damage equal to 50% of your missing Health.
<Blood and Fire>.Name: <Blood and Fire>

<Primal Trophy>.Effect:
Whenever ^you^ kill a Worthy Enemy, gain one Primal Trophy. Every 3 Primal Trophies increase your Max Health by 1.
Every 10 Primal Trophies give you an extra non-combat Skill (make you Skilled in a type of activity).
<Primal Trophy>.Name: <Primal Trophy>

~Bloodlust~.Effect: Add 1d4 Damage to a weapon attack for each 10 Health you are missing.
~Bloodlust~.Notes: This is not considered a Spell.
~Bloodlust~.Name: ~Bloodlust~

<Heartbeat Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Then, until the ^end^ of your next Turn, you take 50% less Damage (including from your own Abilities).
When Heartbeat Trance ends, Heal for 1d6.
<Heartbeat Trance>.Name: <Heartbeat Trance>

<Rage Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Until the ^end^ of your next Turn, all your attacks deal +1d4 Damage and Onslaught Healing is increased by 100%.
When Rage Trance ends, Heal for 1d6.
<Rage Trance>.Name: <Rage Trance>

<Battle Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Until the ^end^ of your next Turn, all Damage you do to yourself becomes Healing instead and you are immune to Control Effects.
When Battle Trance ends, Heal for 2d6.
<Battle Trance>.Name: <Battle Trance>

<Hunger For Blood>.Effect: Whenever you deal Damage to a Worthy Enemy, Heal for 10% of it (rounded down).
<Hunger For Blood>.Name: <Hunger For Blood>

<Last Resort>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Your next single-target weapon attack deals +1d20 Damage.
For the rest of the Combat, you deal -50% Damage but increase all Healing you do by 50%.
<Last Resort>.Name: <Last Resort>

~FURY~.Upgrade: Every time you do Healing or weapon Damage, do +1 for each {Orange('Fury')}, then lose 1 {Orange('Fury')}.
~FURY~.Name: ~FURY~

~Painful Puncture~.Effect: Attack a Unit for 1d6 + 2 Damage of your ^weapon^'s type. Its Passives, weapon* effects and Reactions are disabled until the start of your next Turn.
~Painful Puncture~.Notes: Its Passives become disabled before you hit it (e.g. Kobolds don't dodge this attack). Some monsters have special weapon* effects, like Centaurs who gain extra Damage based on how much they moved. These are disabled.
~Painful Puncture~.Name: ~Painful Puncture~

<Blood Craft>.Effect: Whenever you Damage with War Craft to a Worthy Enemy, Damage yourself equal to the original roll, then increase it by 100% to the enemy.
<Blood Craft>.Name: <Blood Craft>

<Death Mark>.Effect:
Mark a Unit you can see.
Whenever ^you^ deal Damage to it until your next Turn, remember the Damage done.
At the start of your next Turn, the mark bursts and the Unit takes directly 33% of the Damage you dealt to it in this time period.
<Death Mark>.Name: <Death Mark>

<Earthshattering Wave>.Effect:
All units in a line must succeed a Might Check against _10% of your Max Health_ or be Triple-Stunned. If they succeed, they become Fumbling instead.
The line is 3 meters wide, and has a length of 1 meter for ever 5 Health you are missing.
<Earthshattering Wave>.Notes:
E.g. if you have 30 out of 50 Health (thus missing 20 Health), then the line will be 4 meters long.
Cover is applied normally.

A Double-Stunned Unit has -3 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
<Earthshattering Wave>.Name: <Earthshattering Wave>

<Ruining Shout>.Effect:
Damages all Enemies within 4 meters of you.
Deals 1d6 Psychic Damage for each 1 meter to the target (up to 4d6).
Roll 4d6 at the same time, and choose which dice affect the units closer.
<Ruining Shout>.Name: <Ruining Shout>

<Tribal Tattoos>.Effect:
Your Max Health is further increased by 8.
Every Adventure, you add another tattoo and increase it by 1.
Every 3 new tattoos, gain +1 in any Resist Check of choice.
<Tribal Tattoos>.Name: <Tribal Tattoos>

<One With My Body>.Effect: Choose any Druid or Hunter Utility Talent from any Level.
<One With My Body>.Name: <One With My Body>

<Victory Strike>.Effect:
Attack a Unit for 2d10 Damage of your weapon's type.
Whenever ^you^ kill a Worthy Enemy (with anything), reset the Cooldown of this Ability.
<Victory Strike>.Name: <Victory Strike>

<Frenzy>.Effect:
If you start your turn with 25 or less Health, you have +1 Movement Speed and can Break your Movement.
if you start with 15 or less Health, you also have an extra 1 {A}Action Point.
<Frenzy>.Name: <Frenzy>

<Hurl Over>.Effect:
Grab another non-Epic Unit and throw them up to 10 meters away.
Upon landing, all other Units within 3 meters of the landing place take 3d8 Pulse Damage.
If it was an Enemy, the Thrown Unit takes 50% of the Damage.
<Hurl Over>.Name: <Hurl Over>

<Jotunn>.Effect:
You grow to the size of a giant and become Large.
You gain Shielding equal to 50% of your missing Health.
Your normal Melee attacks hit all Units within 1 meter of the target for the same Damage, without the Stat modifier (e.g. you don't add + Might or Instinct to the secondary targets).
You are immune to being Control Effects and Hard Terrain.
<Jotunn>.Name: <Jotunn>
<Jotunn>.Notes: Moving 1 meter through Hard Terrain takes 2 meters of Movement.

<Echoes of Fury>.Effect: Your _echoes_ can hit the same target (with -50% Damage/Healing). However, if it hits a different target, the Damage or Healing is no longer reduced by 50%.
<Echoes of Fury>.Name: <Echoes of Fury>

<Forced Echoes>.Effect: Your Shaman Abilities and Talents always _echo_.
<Forced Echoes>.Notes: Rainmaking applies 2 effects when echoed. Enlightening Ritual can now, instead, succeed twice per Adventure (Units still can't succeed it more than once).
<Forced Echoes>.Name: <Forced Echoes>

<Bloodbath>.Effect: You Heal for all Damage done by Advanced Flank on Worthy Enemies.
<Bloodbath>.Name: <Bloodbath>

<Echoing Self>.Effect: A spectral self appears at the position where you started your turn, and repeats all Acts you have already done this turn.
<Echoing Self>.Notes:
An Act is considered any Movement, attack or Ability that took at least 0 {A}Action Points (does not include Passives that triggered and _echoes_ that had already happened this turn).
The clone moves exactly as you did (can go through Units) and repeats the Spells and Attacks on the same targets. If there were any dice rolls, the clone rolls them (don't use the same numbers rolled). The clone is a separate special Unit - self effects apply to the clone (and thus self-heals have no effect).
<Echoing Self>.Name: <Echoing Self>

<Flesh of Iron>.Effect:
You Heal for all Damage you would deal to yourself instead of taking it. Pierce, Slash and Smash attacks can't Damage you below 1 Health (they leave you to 1 Health).
Also, passively, you gain +2 Might.
<Flesh of Iron>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Flesh of Iron>.Name: <Flesh of Iron>

<Ferocity Unleashed>.Effect:
If you start your turn with 50% or less Health, you have an extra 2 {A}Action Points on your turn.
Also, passively, gain +1 Might, Instinct and Presence, you are immune to exhaustion in Worthy Combat and you can survive without sleep for 7 days.
<Ferocity Unleashed>.Notes: This stacks with the Frenzy Talent.
<Ferocity Unleashed>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Ferocity Unleashed>.Name: <Ferocity Unleashed>

<MIGHT BRAWN MUSCLE>.Effect: GAIN +10 MIGHT AND THE RESULTS OF ALL YOUR MIGHT CHECKS ARE DOUBLED.
<MIGHT BRAWN MUSCLE>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<MIGHT BRAWN MUSCLE>.Name: <MIGHT BRAWN MUSCLE>

~Idea?~.Effect: Witchblade should also do increased Healing or idk
~Idea?~.Name: ~Idea?~

~Damage To Shielding~.Effect: Gain Shielding equal to your last Damage dealt (spread within multiple d6's as you like).
~Damage To Shielding~.Name: ~Damage To Shielding~

~Sentient Weapon~.Effect:
You have a Witchblade Weapon - a special weapon of one chosen type (e.g. Shortsword, Longbow, Pike, etc). This weapon will have extra effects later on. Don't lose it!
You gain +1 in Might or Instinct, up to +3.
~Sentient Weapon~.Upgrade: Reposess: By spending 1 hour, you can transfer the curse of your Witchblade Weapon into another weapon. That new weapon becomes your Witchblade Weapon, and the old one is destroyed.
~Sentient Weapon~.Notes:
You are bound by soul to your Witchblade Weapon, inside which your patron's avatar lies, either possessing the weapon, being trapped inside it, cursing it, or using it as a means of communication with you.
You must choose your weapon type when you become a Witchblade Witchblade.
You can customize your weapon's personality, voice, the way it looks. Talk to your Quest Master.
~Sentient Weapon~.Name: ~Sentient Weapon~

~Witchblade~.Effect: After you cast a Spell that costs {Mana}Mana, your next Witchblade Weapon attack deals 1d6 extra Damage (within 5 minutes).
~Witchblade~.Notes: You can only add the 1d6 once per turn. The d6's can stack (from multiple Spells that cost {Mana}Mana, one after another).
~Witchblade~.Name: ~Witchblade~

~Hail~.Effect:
Choose a target and a Stat.
Blast it for 2d8 + ^its Stat^ {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage.
~Hail~.Combo: Damages an extra Unit in range with -50% of the original Damage.
~Hail~.Notes: Each extra Unit hit must be different than the others.
~Hail~.Name: ~Hail~

~Wyrd Renewal~.Effect:
Roll 1d10 - 5. After you see the result, choose a Worthy Unit.
If it's negative, deal Scourge Damage to it. Otherwise, Heal it.
~Wyrd Renewal~.Name: ~Wyrd Renewal~

~Deathfire Flame~.Effect: Shoot a bolt of deathly fire in a 1x10 meter line. All Units it touches take 1d6 + 1d8 + 1d10 Scourge or Fire Damage (your choice).
~Deathfire Flame~.Name: ~Deathfire Flame~

~Curse of Weakness~.Effect: Choose a Unit. The first time it deals Damage on its every Turn, roll 1d4 and subtract it from its dealt Damage.
~Curse of Weakness~.Name: ~Curse of Weakness~

~Curse of Pain~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of your Turns, it takes 1d4 Scourge Damage.
~Curse of Pain~.Name: ~Curse of Pain~

~Psyche Blast~.Effect:
A Unit takes 4d6 Psychic Damage and chooses whether to become Blinded or Silenced.
Apply a ~Combo~ to it.
~Psyche Blast~.Notes:
Cover is applied normally.

A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.
~Psyche Blast~.Name: ~Psyche Blast~

~Disenchantment~.Duration: 8 hours (24 hours at level 4, 1 week at level 8)
~Disenchantment~.Effect:
A person makes a Presence Check.
If it fails, it becomes afflicted with a minor (usually non-combat) curse, such as:
{Diamond} Its Setback is doubled
{Diamond} The target can't properly tie knots, sew, use keys or pick locks, etc
{Diamond} The target appears less attractive (its Presence Checks have -3)
{Diamond} Gains runny nose, eyes and sweats more
{Diamond} Stumbles randomly
~Disenchantment~.Notes: A Unit can't be affected by the same Disenchantment effect multiple times.
~Disenchantment~.Name: ~Disenchantment~

~Compel~.Duration: Lasts until they can't see/hear you
~Compel~.Effect: Choose a Unit you can see. You have +1d2 to Presence Rolls against it.
~Compel~.Notes: The target can't tell it was affected unless it knows about this type of magic.
~Compel~.Name: ~Compel~

~Oculus~.Effect:
You conjure a magical eye that stays in place and records everything it sees. You can physically retrieve it to see everything it recorded, as if looking through a crystal ball.

You can program it to respond to a certain trigger to cause it to explode, dealing 2d6 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} to all Units within 1 meter of it.
~Oculus~.Notes: The eye may fit inside your palm, or may be slightly larger. It is visible, but you can freely decide how how it is textured.
~Oculus~.Name: ~Oculus~

~Thaumaturgy~.Effect:
You create one of the following magical effects:
{Diamond} Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.
{Diamond} You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.
~Thaumaturgy~.Upgrade: At Level 4 you can cast this for 1 {A}Action Point, and at Level 7, for 0 {A}Action Points.
~Thaumaturgy~.Name: ~Thaumaturgy~

<Shapeshifting Weapon>.Effect: Instantly change the type of weapon of your Witchblade Weapon.
<Shapeshifting Weapon>.Name: <Shapeshifting Weapon>

<Curseweave>.Effect: After you attack a Worthy Enemy with your Witchblade Weapon, if your next Act is a Damaging Spell that costs {Mana}Mana, it deals +1d6 Damage (within 5 minutes).
<Curseweave>.Notes: Applies to Mass Damage, but only applies once to Spells that hit multiple times (e.g. Magic Missile-like Spells, Damage over time effects, etc).
<Curseweave>.Name: <Curseweave>

<Cursehelix>.Effect: You now have 1 more Witchblade Weapon, of any kind. The same patron or another one of the same type is possessing your second weapon.
<Cursehelix>.Upgrade: Once per turn, for 0 {A}Action Points, you can vanish or resummon one of them.
<Cursehelix>.Name: <Cursehelix>

<Hungering Weapon>.Effect: When ^you^ drop a Worthy Enemy to 0 Health, gain an extra 1 {A}Action Point this turn and 5 Shielding.
<Hungering Weapon>.Name: <Hungering Weapon>

<Spell Tap>.Effect: Every Worthy Combat, the moment you drop to 0 {Mana}Mana, gain Shielding equal to your Max {Mana}Mana and you can immediately freely (for 0 {A}Action Points) cast a Spell that doesn't cost {Mana}Mana.
<Spell Tap>.Name: <Spell Tap>

<Somatic Pulse>.Effect:
^Count^ the Worthy Units within 3 meters of you (including you).
They all take Pulse Damage equal to ^Counted^ d4 (except you).
<Somatic Pulse>.Notes: E.g. if this affects 3 Units, it deals 3d4. If it affects 4 Units, it deals 4d4. 5 Units - 5d4. And so on.
<Somatic Pulse>.Name: <Somatic Pulse>

~Dancing Blade~.Effect:
Your melee weapon Attacks have +1 meter range, by levitating to your target, hitting them, then quickly returning to your hand.
You also have +1 Movement Speed
~Dancing Blade~.Notes:
These Attacks are still considered melee Attacks, and are not considered thrown.
Flanking applies normally if there's an Ally right behind the enemy you're Attacking (forming a line between the 3 of you).
~Dancing Blade~.Name: ~Dancing Blade~

~Speak With Objects~.Effect: Choose a willing, non-hostile object. Think of an idea or question. The object responds in a way only you understand, based on its memory formed through its wear and tear.
~Speak With Objects~.Notes: Keep in mind that object communication is not like talking to a sentient person - it is more akin to analyzing its wear and tear and getting an enhanced idea or impression of an event it went through.
~Speak With Objects~.Name: ~Speak With Objects~

<Hexdrain>.Effect: Your Witchblade (or Curseweave) Damage and heals you for the Damage done.
<Hexdrain>.Name: <Hexdrain>

<Quick Hex>.Effect: Your Spells that cost {Mana}Mana and can't deal Damage take 0 {A}Action Points for you, and your Witchblade applies after you cast ^any^ Spell that costs {Mana}Mana, not just offensive ones.
<Quick Hex>.Name: <Quick Hex>

<Possessio>.Effect:
You become possessed by your patron or power source. While possessed, you have 1 extra Action on your turn and can't spend {Mana}Mana, but you can't control your Hero - your patron or power source controls it (the QM).
You can suggest Actions for your possession, but your patron may act randomly or unpredictibly.
You still roll any dice for Acts your Hero make.
Lasts until the end of your next turn.
<Possessio>.Name: <Possessio>

<Great Talent Bonus>.Effect: Gain one more Level 3 Talent, and one more Level 5 Talent.
<Great Talent Bonus>.Name: <Great Talent Bonus>

<Soulstealer Weapon>.Effect:
Steal the soul of a dead Worthy Unit.
Every 3 stolen souls give your Witchblade Weapon +1 Damage permanently.
At any point, you can release all souls in your weapon to increase the Damage of the attack by 900% of the number of souls released.
<Soulstealer Weapon>.Upgrade: Dead Units whose souls are locked inside the weapon can not be revived.
<Soulstealer Weapon>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Soulstealer Weapon>.Name: <Soulstealer Weapon>

<Whispers of Abeyance>.Effect:
Gain a 1 {A}Action Point this Turn and get -1 in a random Stat permanently.
Upon reaching 0 or less in all Stats, you become permanently possessed by the energies residing in your Witchblade Weapon. Each of your Stats becomes a random of 1d8 permanently.
Reaching 0 or less in all Stats immediately kills you, and both your and your patron's souls are sent to the other plane forever.
<Whispers of Abeyance>.Upgrade: Your soul is sent into a different plane, according to your patronage. From then on, you have the same body, but you are now your patron for all intents and purposes - in mind, personality and soul.
<Whispers of Abeyance>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Whispers of Abeyance>.Name: <Whispers of Abeyance>

<Cursewrought Avatar>.Effect:
Throw your Witchblade Weapon on the ground near you. It becomes a Cursewrought Avatar and immediately grows a body of its own, either ethereal, phantomatic or resembling an animated armor fused with the weapon.
The Cursewrought Avatar resembles you in all aspects, but can't cast Spells or use Abilities, and can attack only with the Witchblade Weapon.
Spells you cast apply to the Damage of your Cursewrought Avatar for Witchblade (or Curseweave).
<Cursewrought Avatar>.Notes: If you're not holding the Witchblade Weapon, you obviously can't attack with it.
<Cursewrought Avatar>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Cursewrought Avatar>.Name: <Cursewrought Avatar>

~Worldshaping~.Effect:
You understand the surroundings and slightly alter the landscape in a 1 kilometer area around you so you feel like in a different environment.
The area becomes the chosen _domain environment_ for you only instead of its real _domain environment_.
~Worldshaping~.Name: ~Worldshaping~

~Fog Cloud~.Effect: A 5x5x5 meter cube becomes covered in fog for 1 minute.
~Fog Cloud~.Upgrade: All Attacks done from, through or to Units inside Fog have Cover (-50%).
~Fog Cloud~.Notes: Fog can be dissipated by wind. You can choose the color of the fog. The fog does not go through walls, but does bend around corners (e.g. up to 360 degrees around wall extremities).
~Fog Cloud~.Name: ~Fog Cloud~

<Call of the Wild>.Effect:
Call upon 2 animals, both of which are specific to your or the current _domain_.
They appear on the edge of the battlefield, from the wilderness, and they fight for you for up to 1 minute.
Each has 2 {A}Action Points with which they can Move and Attack, normally. You can control them on your Turn.
<Call of the Wild>.Notes: Both animals must be of the same type.
<Call of the Wild>.Name: <Call of the Wild>

<Third Kind>.Effect: When Shapeshifting, choose one additional Animal Feature to have.
<Third Kind>.Name: <Third Kind>

~Animal Companion~.Effect:
You have an animal pet that can fight alongside you!
Your pet has the Stats 3, 1, 0, 0, -1 in any order, but they do not affect its Combat capabilities.

Your pet acts on your Turn. It has 2 {A}Action Points, but it can only attack once per Turn.
~Animal Companion~.Upgrade:
If your pet drops to 0 Health, it becomes Fallen, like a player. It's Health Regen is equal to half of its Max Health.
Your pet will not stray more than 30 meters away from you in hostile territory.
~Animal Companion~.Notes:
Your pet can't do Default Moves except Taunt.
Your pet can make normal non-Combat Rolls using using its own Stats.
If your pet ever dies, you can spend 8 hours inbetween Adventures to get a new pet. If you want to change your pet and abandon your current one, you can do so inbetween Adventures, but the guilt will make you Fumbling for the next 2 Worthy Combat encounters.

<Pierce and Cleave>.Name: <Pierce and Cleave>

<Marked for Criticals>.Effect: After you apply ^Marked^ to a Unit, it takes maximum Damage from the next dice roll.
<Marked for Criticals>.Notes: For example, after you Hunter Mark a Unit, if you attack it for 2d8 Damage, you don't roll; it just takes 16 Damage. Applies to bonuses like Dice Upgrades, Smites, etc.
<Marked for Criticals>.Name: <Marked for Criticals>

~Cupcake Shot~.Effect: After a Unit steps on one of your traps, it becomes Frail.
~Cupcake Shot~.Name: ~Cupcake Shot~
~Cupcake Shot~.Notes: A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.

<Eye of the Hawk>.Effect:
All enemies in a Worthy Combat are automatically _Marked_, and your range increases by 500% and your ^Dice^ are further ^Upgraded^ to the ^next^ die type against _Marked_ Units. After manually casting Hunter Mark, your first attack deals 50% more Damage against that Unit.
You automatically pass all Hard Instinct Checks (that require at least 15) and your Presence and Instinct increase by an extra 2.
<Eye of the Hawk>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Eye of the Hawk>.Name: <Eye of the Hawk>

<Eye of the Raptor>.Effect:
Your attacks deal maximum Damage to Units that are not _Marked_ if they are within 3 meters of you or your pet.
You automatically pass all Hard Presence Checks (that require at least 15) and you gain +3 Presence.
<Eye of the Raptor>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Eye of the Raptor>.Name: <Eye of the Raptor>

~Prowl Around~.Notes: This is because of your Animal Companions roaming about.
~Prowl Around~.Name: ~Prowl Around~

~Stablemaster~.Effect:
You have 3 different Animal Companion pets, but only one can adventure with you at a time.
Each of your Animal Companions has 2 Utility Talents and 2 Level 1 Pet Talents.

While not with you, your other Animal Companions hang out on their own in the wilderness, but no more than 5 kilometers away from you.
You can send your current companion off, then spend 30 minutes to call for another one to come join you.
~Stablemaster~.Notes:
The advantage is you can use several animal Abilities that have longer Cooldowns; these are usually stronger.
It is possible that the animal you're calling can't come to your aid if you're indoors, flying or the trail you're on is too difficult. In that case, you will have to return outside or on a safe trail (QM's decision).
In that case, your current companion can not go away, either.
~Stablemaster~.Name: ~Stablemaster~

~Talented Animals~.Effect: Your Level 4, 7, and 9 Talent Tiers apply to your pets. Each of your pets can have one of those Talents at those Levels.
~Talented Animals~.Name: ~Talented Animals~

~Bite and Slash~.Effect: Refresh the Cooldown of one of your pet's Pet Attack.
~Bite and Slash~.Name: ~Bite and Slash~

~Tear!~.Effect: One of your pets gains 2 {A}Action Points this Turn.
~Tear!~.Name: ~Tear!~

~Infused Bites~.Effect: You can change your pet's attacks' Damage Type to {Type}.
~Infused Bites~.Name: ~Infused Bites~

~Apex Companion~.Effect:
You have an animal pet that can fight alongside you!
Your pet has the Stats ~5, 2, 0, 0, -1~ in any order, but they do not affect its Combat capabilities.
It has Max Health equal to ~16 + 400% of Your Level~.
Your pet acts on your Turn. It has ~3 {A}Action Points~, but it can only attack once per Turn.
~It has 4 Level 1 Pet Talents and gains +2 Pet Talents whenever it would gain one.~
~Apex Companion~.Upgrade:
If your pet drops to 0 Health, it becomes Fallen, like a player. It's Health Regen is equal to half of its Max Health.
Your pet will not stray more than 30 meters away from you in hostile territory.
~Apex Companion~.Notes:
Your pet can't do Default Moves except Taunt.
Your pet can make normal non-Combat Rolls using using its own Stats.
Your pet can't rise from being Fallen while in Combat, even if healed.
If your pet ever dies, you can spend 8 hours inbetween Adventures to get a new pet. If you want to change your pet and abandon your current one, you can do so inbetween Adventures, but the guilt will make you Fumbling for the next 2 Worthy Combat encounters.

~Pet Attack~.Effect:
Your pet attacks a target for 1d4 Pierce or Slash Damage (your choice).

~The Cooldown is now Twice / Turn.~

~Apex Companion~.Name: ~Apex Companion~

<Kindred Spirits>.Effect:
One more of your Animal Companions accompanies you while adventuring.
This Animal Companion obeys the same rules as the regular one (takes its Turns, requires Healing between combats, etc).
<Kindred Spirits>.Notes: You're instantly kicked from the group if your pets don't have names.
<Kindred Spirits>.Name: <Kindred Spirits>

~Go!~.Effect:
Your current pet exits Combat. Summon one of your other pets who joins Combat on any space within 5 meters of you.
Each of your pets has +1 Level 1 Pet Talent.
~Go!~.Name: ~Go!~

~Rescue Mission~.Effect: Pick up an ally within 3 meters, then move with them up to your speed and drop them near your landing space.
~Rescue Mission~.Name: ~Rescue Mission~

<Double Training>.Effect: Your pet gains one more Level 1 Pet Talent.
<Double Training>.Name: <Double Training>

~Killing Machine~.Effect: When your pet kills a Worthy Enemy, it gins +1 Max Health permanently.
~Killing Machine~.Name: ~Killing Machine~

~Scavenge~.Effect: Your pet goes scavenging and comes back 1 real hour later with 1d20 {Gold}Gold.
~Scavenge~.Name: ~Scavenge~

~Quickfooted~.Effect: Your pet has +1 Initiative and no Pet Attack Cooldown on its first Turn each Combat.
~Quickfooted~.Name: ~Quickfooted~

~Lacerate~.Effect: Attack a Unit for 1d8 Damage and apply a ~Combo~.
~Lacerate~.Name: ~Lacerate~

<Ravage!>.Effect:
One pet makes a melee Attack for 5d6 Slash Damage.
If the target is at or below 50% Health, deal 2d6 extra Damage.
Otherwise, it becomes Frail.
<Ravage!>.Name: <Ravage!>
<Ravage!>.Notes: A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.

<Sickem>.Effect:
Use when a Unit goes flying against its will on someone else's turn.
Your pet(s) within 5 meters of its landing place can dash to it (after it lands) and make a total of 2 Pet Attacks on it.
<Sickem>.Notes:
Goes flying means is pushed, knocked up, dragged, etc.
This uses YOUR Reaction, not your pets'.
Obviously, your pets need line of sight and can't jump through walls, or over large obstacles. Apply common sense.
<Sickem>.Name: <Sickem>

<Second Winds>.Effect: Instantly Heal yourself and all your pets for 3d6.
<Second Winds>.Name: <Second Winds>

~Search~.Effect:
Name or describe a Unit that is familiar to you. Your animals go and search for your target.
They point which direction (straight) the target is.
~Search~.Name: ~Search~

~Sentience~.Effect: One of your pets becomes sentient as if it were a person with 0 or more Intelligence. It can speak, reason, and think like a person.
~Sentience~.Downside: Once given, the gift of sentience can't be unlearned or taken away.
~Sentience~.Name: ~Sentience~

<Vampiric>.Effect: Pet Attack heals your pet for 100% of its Damage dealt.
<Vampiric>.Name: <Vampiric>

~Final Blow~.Effect:
Dash onto a target and deal 3d4 Pierce or Smash Damage.
Then become Stunned until the end of the Combat.
~Final Blow~.Name: ~Final Blow~

~Ferocious~.Effect: Your pet's Abilities (except Pet Attack) have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Ferocious~.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.
~Ferocious~.Name: ~Ferocious~

~Swallow~.Effect:
Swallow a non-Epic Unit at most as large as the pet.
While swallowed, it is Blinded.
At the start of your next Turn, spit it out near you.
~Swallow~.Name: ~Swallow~
~Swallow~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Pack Tactics~.Effect: When the Hunter or another pet attacks a Unit, make a Pet Attack on it if in Range.
~Pack Tactics~.Name: ~Pack Tactics~

~Teamwork 101~.Effect: Each Turn, alternating your attacks with your pet's attacks in sequence on the same target makes the attacks have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type
~Teamwork 101~.Notes:
"Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1."
A first attack each Turn can not benefit from the Dice Upgrade.
For example, if you start your Turn with Pet Attack with your wolf, and then you hit the target with a sword, the sword attack will have Dice Upgraded. Then if your Spider attacks the same target, it also has Dice Upgraded.
~Teamwork 101~.Name: ~Teamwork 101~

~Shared Love~.Effect: When one of your pet receives Healing above its Max Health, the extra Healing is transferred to another ally in your party.
~Shared Love~.Name: ~Shared Love~

~Consume and Adapt~.Effect:
One of your pets consumes the corpse of a non-humanoid Unit.
It permanently learns one of its Abilities (except its standard attack) and can use it with at least* a Once / Encounter Cooldown.
~Consume and Adapt~.Notes: The Cooldown is overridden if longer than Once / Encounter (e.g. Once / Adventure).
~Consume and Adapt~.Name: ~Consume and Adapt~

<Coordinated Bite>.Effect: One enemy near each of your pets (and/or summons) becomes Single-Stunned, Blinded and Deafened.
<Coordinated Bite>.Name: <Coordinated Bite>
<Coordinated Bite>.Notes:
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

<Call To Action>.Effect: Call to one more of your animal companions! It appears from the wilderness and fights for up to 1 minute as if it were a normal Animal Companion.
<Call To Action>.Name: <Call To Action>

~ENORMOUS~.Effect: Your pet is Huge (3x3) and its Maximum Health increases by 100%.
~ENORMOUS~.Name: ~ENORMOUS~

~Brood~.Effect: Spawn a temporary Small copy of your pet, with all of its Abilities. It has 50% of its Health, -1 {A}Action Points, and deals -50% Damage.
~Brood~.Name: ~Brood~

~Symbiosis~.Effect: Your pet is a symbiote that can attach itself to one of its allies. While attached, the pet can withgo all of its {A}Action Points to give the ally +1 {A}Action Point this Turn and a 1d6 Shielding.
~Symbiosis~.Name: ~Symbiosis~

~Hovering Entity~.Effect: If not in Combat, your pet is hovers or prowls the battlefield untargetable, and it can take Turns with unlimited Range on its attacks and Abilities.
~Hovering Entity~.Name: ~Hovering Entity~

<Shapeshifting Pet>.Effect:
Transform one of your pets into another form of your liking, possibly replacing any Talents it has with any other.
Passively, your Pets gain +3 in all Stats, +10 Health, +2 Movement Speed and +1d4 Damage on all attacks.
<Shapeshifting Pet>.Upgrade: If you have the Wild Single Talent, you can turn a pet into a combination of 2 Animals.
<Shapeshifting Pet>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Shapeshifting Pet>.Name: <Shapeshifting Pet>

<Cryptid Tamer>.Effect:
One of your Animal Companions becomes a Beast, Dragon or Insect from the `Monsters page$/Other/Monsters` worth less than 1000 XP. It doesn't have a regular Pet Attack, but it has exactly the Abilities and attacks, but only 50% of its Max Health. It obeys the rest of your Animal Companion rules as normal.
Passively, your Pets automatically pass all Very Hard Presence Checks (requiring at least 20).
<Cryptid Tamer>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Cryptid Tamer>.Name: <Cryptid Tamer>

~Clone Monster~.Effect: Summon a clone of a monster.
~Clone Monster~.Name: ~Clone Monster~

~Nuh-uh~.Effect: Name a thing a Unit can't do on its next turn
~Nuh-uh~.Name: ~Nuh-uh~

~Possess~.Effect: Possess - enemy can't distinguish friend from foe
~Possess~.Name: ~Possess~

~Swoosh~.Effect: Redirect an attack from an ally to an enemy
~Swoosh~.Name: ~Swoosh~

~Nope~.Effect: Next time target deals Damage, it takes back the same Damage before defense
~Nope~.Name: ~Nope~

Combat Extras: Max Mana is 2 and replenishes after Combats
~Affiance Casting~.Effect:
Your Max {Mana}Mana is 2. It never increases and can't increase except through Warlock Talents.
Your {Mana}Mana replenishes after each Worthy Combat.
~Affiance Casting~.Name: ~Affiance Casting~

~Power Source~.Effect:
Your powers have an external source. Choose another Class and an Element. You can get Level 1 Talents from that Class.
You take -50% Damage from that Element.
~Power Source~.Upgrade: You are bound to a Power Source: something vast, unknowable, or unstable. It might be a pact, a curse, a parasite, a god, or a force of nature. You choose what it is, and when the power speaks you listen.
~Power Source~.Notes: The Class and Element you choose must be thematically tied to your power source, but you can theme it however you want! Be creative!

~Flow Tap~.Effect: Choose an enemy Unit. Cast the last Ability it cast (can include attacks).
~Flow Tap~.Notes: Includes weapon attacks, multiattacks, spells, bodily actions, etc. You can't cast Reactions, Passives or Abilities triggered through Passives. If you copied an attack, you briefly conjure a weapon for the attack only. If the Ability uses any Stats, use yours.

~Power Source~.Name: ~Power Source~

~Mind's Shadow~.Effect:
Deal 1d12 + ^Your Presence or Focus^ Scourge Damage to a Unit.
For the rest of the combat, whenever it would take Scourge Damage, it takes {Damage} more (stacks indefinitely).
~Mind's Shadow~.Name: ~Mind's Shadow~

<Control Crowds>.Effect: Use when an enemy Unit uses an Ability. It must use a different Ability.
<Control Crowds>.Notes: If it has only one Ability or attack, you can't use Control Crowds (the QM will let you know).
<Control Crowds>.Name: <Control Crowds>

<Mana Flow Tapping>.Effect: If Flow Tap is on Cooldown, you can spend 1 {Mana}Mana to cast it regardless.
<Mana Flow Tapping>.Name: <Mana Flow Tapping>

<Power Tap>.Effect:
Cast an Ability one of your Allies has (with that ability's Actions and Costs and your modifiers).
If it costs {Mana}Mana, you must spend its {Mana}Mana.
<Power Tap>.Notes:
Does not work on Passives. The Ability must have 0, a 1 {A}Action Point or 2 {A}Action Pointss cost.
The Cooldown applies to you - you can Power Tap an Ability that's on Cooldown. After you use it, it goes on Cooldown for you, not for your Ally.
<Power Tap>.Name: <Power Tap>

<Patron Aspect>.Effect:
You take on the shape or a being from your patron's plane until the end of your next turn.
Your Basic Spells require no mana to cast.
After you cast a Basic Spell, it goes on a Once / Adventure Cooldown (can't be used until the next Adventure).
<Patron Aspect>.Name: <Patron Aspect>

<Redirection>.Effect: Use when an Unit uses an Ability or attacks. Redirect it to any other valid Unit (e.g. within range). Its Damage or Healing is reduced by 50%.
<Redirection>.Name: <Redirection>

~Shadow Clone~.Effect:
You create an illusion of yourself at a target location.
The illusion has 1 Health and 1 Defense and it fails all Checks.
You can control what the illusion does at will.
If the illusion goes more than 10 meters away from you, it disappears and the spell is cancelled.
~Shadow Clone~.Upgrade: At Level 7, the cast range and illusion range become 15 meters and the sound of your voice can come through the illusion's mouth instead of yours. At Level 5 - 25 meters. At Level 7 you can choose to see through the illusion's eyes at any point.
~Shadow Clone~.Notes: You need maintain line of sight to the clone to keep it working.
~Shadow Clone~.Name: ~Shadow Clone~

~Aging~.Effect:
Touch a Unit or object for 1 minute.
It ages up to 1 year in that 1 minute.
~Aging~.Upgrade: Units can only be aged for 1 minute per in-game day.
~Aging~.Name: ~Aging~

<Nuissance to Gods>.Cooldown: All your Abilities with "Once / Encounter" Cooldown can be used Twice / Encounter instead.
<Nuissance to Gods>.Name: <Nuissance to Gods>

<Possession>.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see.
You possess its body and, on its next turn, you control what it does.
<Possession>.Upgrade:
Only works on targets with Presence less than 3.
The QM will tell you what the Unit can do if it's a monster.
<Possession>.Name: <Possession>

<Advanced Talent Bonus>.Effect: Gain one more Level 3 Talent, ^or^ one more Level 5 Talent.
<Advanced Talent Bonus>.Name: <Advanced Talent Bonus>

<Curse of Domination>.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see. Pass an Focus or Presence Check at least equal to 5% of its Experience Worth to permanently put it under your control. You can command it telepathically what to and it will do your bidding.
You can only have one dominated Unit at a time and lasts until the Unit dies, until you dominate another Unit or until you willingly end the curse.
Also, passively, you gain +3 Presence.
<Curse of Domination>.Upgrade: Failing the Check makes the Unit permanently immune to Hand of Domination and it can sense they resisted an attempt of possession. A dominated Unit has the same combat capabilities and acts like themselves but is essentially a _philosophical zombie_ - they feel no emotion, have no will of their own and manifest little sentiment in their speech and expressiveness. When the Unit stops being dominated, they recall nothing that has happened in that period of time.
<Curse of Domination>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Curse of Domination>.Name: <Curse of Domination>

<Whispers of Oblivion>.Effect:
Gain a 1 {A}Action Point this Turn and get -1 in a random Stat permanently.
Upon reaching 0 or less in all Stats, you become permanently possessed by the energies of your power source. Each of your Stats becomes a random of 1d8 permanently.
Reaching 0 or less in all Stats immediately kills you, and both your and your patron's souls are sent to the other plane forever.
<Whispers of Oblivion>.Upgrade: Your soul is sent into a different plane, according to your patronage. From then on, you have the same body, but you are now your patron for all intents and purposes - in mind, personality and soul.
<Whispers of Oblivion>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Whispers of Oblivion>.Name: <Whispers of Oblivion>

<Mirror Mirror>.Effect:
Summon a clone of yourself on a space within 5 meters. You control the clone and it resembles you perfectly.
In Combat, the clone acts on your Turn. It has Movement of its own, but will always use its Actions to copy all Basic Abilities and Weapon Attacks you make, on the same target.
<Mirror Mirror>.Notes: The clone can't do combat Acts and fine motor skills on its own -- it will always copy yours in parallel.
<Mirror Mirror>.Name: <Mirror Mirror>

~Faith Casting~.Effect:
You have 2 {Mana}Mana Points that can't increase.
Your {Mana}Mana replenishes inbetween Worthy Combats.
~Faith Casting~.Name: ~Faith Casting~

~Holy Grace~.Requirement: Only usable in Worthy Combat. Can't be used on Fallen Units.
~Holy Grace~.Effect:
Heal a Unit for 1d6 (but not yourself).
Your next attack until the end of your next Turn deals extra Damage equal to the amount just Healed.
~Holy Grace~.Name: ~Holy Grace~

~Divine Presence~.Effect: When you use this, for a brief moment, nearby holy and unholy presences emmit a subtle sound and smell ^only you can detect^.
~Divine Presence~.Notes:
Unholiness smells sulphurous and sounds like a deep, echoing rumbling or breath. Holiness smells churchly and sounds like a reverbing crystaline ringing.
Walls block this smell and sound as they normally would.
This smell and sound can only be concealed with magic.
~Divine Presence~.Name: ~Divine Presence~

~Smite~.Effect:
After you roll Damage for a melee attack or Spell made in melee range, add 1d6 Divine Damage.
If the target dies, regain 1 {Mana}Mana.
~Smite~.Combo: Heal for the extra Damage dealt.
~Smite~.Notes: Melee range is 1 meter, longer if made with a Weapon with longer range.
~Smite~.Name: ~Smite~

~Invigorate~.Effect:
Heal a target for 1d4 + ^Presence or Focus^ Health.
After this, if the target is at full Health, repeat this on another target within 5 meters of you.
~Invigorate~.Combo: If the target is Comboed and still not full Health, increase the Healing by 50%.
~Invigorate~.Notes: Yes, this can chain again and again.
~Invigorate~.Name: ~Invigorate~

~Safeguard~.Effect:
A Unit you can see gains 2 Shieldings. Each can block 1d8 Damage.
Each die that rolled maximum applies a ~Combo~.
~Safeguard~.Name: ~Safeguard~

~Knighthood~.Effect: While mounted, after moving in a straight line at least 3 meters, your first attack this turn also hits a Unit directly behind the main target for 50% of the incoming Damage.
~Knighthood~.Combo: Each Comboed Unit hit becomes Single-Stunned.
~Knighthood~.Name: ~Knighthood~
~Knighthood~.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~Light~.Effect:
Create a faithful source of light in a 3 meters radius (of any color).
It levitates and stays where you put it and can be moved by hand, or you can simply stick it to any solid object.
~Light~.Notes:
You may cancel it with 0 {A}Action Points. It can be purposefully destroyed with an Attack.
The light is not strong enough to blind someone.
The bulb can't go through solid objects.
~Light~.Name: ~Light~

~Guidance~.Effect: When an ally makes a Check, it can use your modifiers (including being Skilled in that Skill) instead of its own.
~Guidance~.Name: ~Guidance~

~Liberation~.Effect: Instantly remove all Control Effects from another ally you can see.
~Liberation~.Upgrade:
At Level 5, also removes all non-magical debuffs and poisons.
At Level 8, also removes all curses and normal negative magical effects.
~Liberation~.Name: ~Liberation~

~Free From Corruption~.Effect:
Choose an ally and speak that the power of your religion compels them!
After the 3rd time you cast it on them this Combat, remove one of their Negative Quirks.
~Free From Corruption~.Name: ~Free From Corruption~

~Expelling Bolt~.Effect: Shoot a magical bolt towards a Unit that deals 3d8 + (target's Movement Speed) Fire or Divine Damage to it.
~Expelling Bolt~.Name: ~Expelling Bolt~

~Lance Heave~.DisplayRequirement: Only usable if it hits at least 2 Units
~Lance Heave~.Effect:
Make a {Weapon} ^weapon^ attack {Eff}
~Click on the Icon to select which variant you want to have have!~
~Lance Heave~.Combo: Comboed Units take the original full Damage.
~Lance Heave~.Notes:
Can apply weapon effects. If the weapon effect requires a target, applies to one chosen Unit hit.
Range increases do increase the length. The Damage must the same for all Units hit. All bonuses to the attack (e.g. Smite, Cursewielder, etc) also split evenly.

Variants.Name: Lance Heave
Variants.Eff: that hits all Units in a 3-meter long line. The Damage is evenly split among all hit Units.

Variants.Name: Blade Heave
Variants.Eff: that hits all Units in a 3-meter long line. The Damage is evenly split among all hit Units.

Variants.Name: Penetrating Heave
Variants.Eff: that hits one more Unit up to 2 meters directly behind the main target.

Variants.Name: Piercing Heave
Variants.Eff: that hits one more Unit up to 2 meters directly behind the main target.

~Lance Heave~.Name: ~Lance Heave~

<Retribution>.Name: <Retribution>
<Retribution>.Notes:
A Double-Stunned Unit has -2 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Double-Stunned Unit has -3 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~Gaiety~.Effect: After you cast a Utility Spell, immediately make a Move Act (for free) or apply a ~Combo~ to an ally.
~Gaiety~.Name: ~Gaiety~

~Crusade~.Effect: When ^you^ defeat one Worthy Enemy, all excess Damage is converted to Healing or Divine Damage to a Unit within 5 meters of you.
~Crusade~.Notes: E.g. if a Unit has 5 Health and you deal 12 Damage, the Unit dies and you Heal an ally (or yourself) for 7 Health using your Reaction, or blast another Unit for 7 Divine Damage. If you kill multiple Units at the same time, this triggers only for one of them, of your choice. Excess Damage from Crusade can also trigger Crusade.
~Crusade~.Name: ~Crusade~

~True Presence~.Effect:
When you use this, for a brief moment, nearby ~presences with souls~ emmit a subtle sound and smell ^only you can detect^.
A random one gets a ~Combo and is Single-Stunned~.
~True Presence~.Upgrade: Unholiness smells sulphurous and sounds like a deep, echoing rumbling or breath. Holiness smells churchly and sounds like a reverbing crystaline ringing. Normal souls smell like clean mineral water and sound like a flowing waterfall.
~True Presence~.Notes:
Walls block this smell and sound as they normally would.
The smell and sound can be concealed with magic.     

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
~True Presence~.Name: ~True Presence~

~Crimson Contrition~.Effect: Whenever you deal Damage to multiple Units at the same time, increase all Divine and Fire Damage you deal by 10% for the rest of the Combat (including that Damage).
~Crimson Contrition~.Name: ~Crimson Contrition~

<Join the Crusade>.Effect: A party member pledges to you. They have the Crusade Ability, and the same Level 1 and 2 Talents (including Utility) you have..
<Join the Crusade>.Upgrade: Ask a party member to join your cause and pledge their honor to you. Write a set of vows, which your companion must vow to abide to and follow with their life, upon death do you two apart.
<Join the Crusade>.Notes:
Only one person can pledge for you and it must within sight or hearing to have access to all of those.
If you ever change this Talent, the ally loses access to all things mentioned; it regains them when you get this Talent again.
<Join the Crusade>.Name: <Join the Crusade>

~Seal of the Aurora~.Effect: Whenever you Heal a Unit to full Health, Heal another Unit within 5 meters of it for 50% of the amount healed.
~Seal of the Aurora~.Upgrade: The secondary heals can trigger Seal of the Aurora again.
~Seal of the Aurora~.Name: ~Seal of the Aurora~

~Flaming Reach~.Effect:
Your second and all further melee attacks each Turn deal +1d4 Damage on targets you haven't attacked this Turn.
Their range is 3 meters and all their Damage becomes Fire.
~Flaming Reach~.Name: ~Flaming Reach~

~Exorcism~.Effect:
Deal 5d10 True Damage to a Unit.
If it's a Demon, Fiend or Undead, increase the Damage by 50%.
~Exorcism~.Name: ~Exorcism~

~Radiance~.Effect: For 1 minute, at the end of your Turn, all Units within 1 meter of you take 1d4 Divine Damage.
~Radiance~.Notes: Can't stack multiple Radiances on the same Unit.
~Radiance~.Name: ~Radiance~

<Golden Shield>.Effect:
Use before a Unit you can see would take Damage (before the roll), or on your Turn.
It becomes surrounded in a divine golden shield.
This (or next) time it would take Damage, it is completely blocked.
If used on your Turn, apply a ~Combo~.
<Golden Shield>.Name: <Golden Shield>

~Blinding Light~.Effect:
All Units in a 4x4 meter area take 2d4 Divine Damage and are Blinded.

If only one Unit is hit by the area, it instead takes 5d4 Divine Damage and is Crippled.
~Blinding Light~.Notes:
Cover is calculated from the center of the area.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -100% Damage/Healing.
~Blinding Light~.Name: ~Blinding Light~

~Smiting Fireheart~.Effect: After you defeat a ^Worthy Enemy^, your next attack deals +50% Damage (but can't retrigger Fire Instinct).
~Smiting Fireheart~.Name: ~Smiting Fireheart~

~Eye for Revolution~.Effect: Your melee attacks deal +25% Damage for each Control Effects they have (Double-Stun counts as 2 and Triple-Stun counts as 3). The Damage of those attacks becoms Fire.
~Eye for Revolution~.Name: ~Eye for Revolution~
~Eye for Revolution~.Notes:
A Double-Stunned Unit has -2 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Double-Stunned Unit has -3 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

<Jihad>.Effect:
When Healing yourself with Crusade, increase the Healing by 50%.
Additionally, you can Heal yourself with Holy Grace.
<Jihad>.Name: <Jihad>

~Spreading Exigency~.Effect: When a Unit becomes affected by a Control Effect, all Enemies within 3 meters of it must pass a Instinct Check against your Instinct Check, or also be affected by that Control Effect.
~Spreading Exigency~.Downside: Units affected by Retribution gain +2 to the Check.
~Spreading Exigency~.Name: ~Spreading Exigency~

<Suspension of Belief>.Effect: The moment your {Mana}Mana drops to 0, freely cast Holy Grace (or an upgrade).
<Suspension of Belief>.Notes: Be wary of your faith, though, for gods seldom hold a positive outlook on those putting their conviction on hiatus.
<Suspension of Belief>.Name: <Suspension of Belief>

<Culling Smite>.Effect:
After you roll for a melee attack, add 3d6 Divine Damage.
If the target does not die, refresh 1 {Mana}Mana.
<Culling Smite>.Notes: Can not be used at the same time with other "Smite" Abilities.
<Culling Smite>.Name: <Culling Smite>

<Lay on Hands>.Effect: Heal a Unit you can see for 50% of its Max Health.
<Lay on Hands>.Name: <Lay on Hands>

~Magic Prison~.Effect:
Choose a Unit that has 10% or less Health.
You create a 4x4x4 meter magic cube from which that Unit physically can't walk through, no matter how hard they try.
~Magic Prison~.Name: ~Magic Prison~

~Resurrection~.Effect:
Touch a dead Unit, whose body is still in decent condition (as approved by the QM).
The dead Unit comes back to life, conscious and without Exhaustion, with 1 Health.
~Resurrection~.Name: ~Resurrection~
~Resurrection~.Notes: An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.

~Bravery Despite Fear~.Effect: Reset the Cooldown of a different Ability.
~Bravery Despite Fear~.Name: ~Bravery Despite Fear~

<Harrowing Judgement>.Effect:
Choose a Unit with 50% or less Health.
A colossal spectral lance hits it and ^crushes it to death^.
<Harrowing Judgement>.Upgrade: Against Epic monsters, the threshold is 15% or less Health instead.
<Harrowing Judgement>.Notes:
You always know if a Unit would die from this (ask the QM).
The Unit dies.
<Harrowing Judgement>.Name: <Harrowing Judgement>

~Crimson Grace~.Requirement: Only usable in Worthy Combat. Can't be used on Fallen Units.
~Crimson Grace~.Effect:
~Deal 2 + Your Level Divine Damage to a Worthy Enemy.~
~An ally you see is healed for half of the Damage done.~
~Crimson Grace~.Name: ~Crimson Grace~

<Life Echo>.Effect:
You put a Life Echo on another ally.
Whenever ^you^ Heal a different Unit, the Unit with the Life Echo on them is also healed for 50% of that amount.
<Life Echo>.Name: <Life Echo>

<Divine Resurgence>.Effect: All other Heroes you healed this combat gain an extra 1 {A}Action Point on their next turn.
<Divine Resurgence>.Name: <Divine Resurgence>

<Asceticism>.Effect: For 1 minute, all Healing you do is increased by 50%, but all Damage you deal is reduced by 50%.
<Asceticism>.Name: <Asceticism>

<Aspect of Ascension>.Effect:
You burst with angelic wings and burning vim.
Until the end of your next turn, you have 50% extra Movement and can fly, and can cast unlimited Abilities that cost {Mana}Mana, ignoring the {Mana}Mana cost and the limits of Faith Casting.
<Aspect of Ascension>.Upgrade: You can't use the same Basic Ability twice on the same turn.
<Aspect of Ascension>.Notes: E.g. let's say you used Smite last turn. This turn you activate Aspect of Ascension. You make a One-Handed weapon attack, and add Smite to it as well. Next turn, you cast Solace Wave and Hand of Freedom, then make anther attack to which you add Smite. Then, you end your turn and Aspect of Ascension ends. You can now still cast Solace Wave and Hand of Freedom once.
<Aspect of Ascension>.Name: <Aspect of Ascension>

<Legion of Oathsworn>.Effect:
In a place sanctified and pure, you start your own order of knights. Create a set of vows that your knights will abide to and have to recite to join you on your conquest.
You recruit a 3 beginner adventurer NPCs as squires! Each is one of the 4 possible squire types from the `Pets and Animals page$/Other/PetsAndAnimals`: Bold, Sneaky, Clever or Wise, whichever makes fits better story-wise (or random). All your squires must be different types.
Passively, gain +2 in all Stats.
<Legion of Oathsworn>.Upgrade: If your squire drops to 0 Health, it becomes Fallen, like a player. It has no Health Regen, but at any point outside of combat, you (the pet owner) can spend 30 minutes to tend to your squire's wounds and Heal it back to full Health.
<Legion of Oathsworn>.Notes: Your squire is not a Hero by any means and does not behave like one (it can't use Weapons, Armor, Feats, Abilities, etc like a Hero can). It is limited to what its stat block and Abilities say it can do. You can, however, give it orders, customize its looks (hair style, clothes, etc) and it will obey your commands within reason. You are the leader it looks up to. Lead proudly and fairly!
<Legion of Oathsworn>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.

~Squire Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 Damage of the weapon's type, or do the equivalent of a 1 Action Point (e.g. Sprint, Push, etc).

<Legion of Oathsworn>.Name: <Legion of Oathsworn>

<March of the Chosen>.Effect:
Your entire party joins the crusade! All Heroes in your party have the Crusade Ability, the same Tier 1 Talent you have and access to the Divine Ability List.
Also, your entire party gains +1 Might and +1 Presence.
<March of the Chosen>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<March of the Chosen>.Name: <March of the Chosen>

<Laying Waste>.Effect:
After you use Basic Ability that costs {Mana}Mana with Faith Casting, reset the Cooldowns of all your Paladin Talents.
Passively, you gain +3 Might.
<Laying Waste>.Notes: Flaming Reach bonus Damage stacks with itself.
<Laying Waste>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Laying Waste>.Name: <Laying Waste>

~Awe~.Effect:
After you spend {Mana}Mana, "cast Awe" on a Unit for each {Mana}Mana spent.
Casting Awe deals 1d4 Divine Damage if it's an Enemy, or Heals if it's an Ally.
~Awe~.Notes: Ignores Cover. Some other Cleric spells will "cast Awe" for free.
~Awe~.Name: ~Awe~

~Blessing~.Effect:
Cast Awe on 2 Units and they become Blessed.
Blessed Allies have +1 to all non-Combat Rolls for the rest of the Adventure. Blessed Enemies become Slowed.
~Blessing~.Notes:
You can bless yourself.

A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
~Blessing~.Name: ~Blessing~

~Pain of the Flesh~.Effect:
Take True Damage equal to 10% of your Maximum Health.
Heal 2 allies you can see for that amount.
~Pain of the Flesh~.Name: ~Pain of the Flesh~

~Herald of the Moon~.Effect: After doing a total of 20 Healing with Spells or 50 Damage in Worthy Combat, regain 1 {Mana}Mana.
~Herald of the Moon~.Notes: The dealt Damage and Healing carries over from Combat to Combat, but resets to 0 after casting this Ability, and starts at 0 each Adventure.
~Herald of the Moon~.Name: ~Herald of the Moon~

~Elation~.Effect: Up to 2 Heroes you can see gain Health Regen equal to your Focus.
~Elation~.Name: ~Elation~

~Solace Wave~.Effect:
Heal an ally (or yourself) for 1d8 Health.
If they have 50% or more Health before the Heal, double the result!
~Solace Wave~.Name: ~Solace Wave~

<Compel>.Effect: You can cast Awe on a Unit you can see, Taunt it, Daze it, Apply a ~Combo~ to it, and/or reroll 1 die for the next Charisma Checks against it.
<Compel>.Notes: All these effects are optional. The target might not be able to tell it was affected by a mind spell, unless it knows about this type of magic.
<Compel>.Name: <Compel>

~See No Evil~.Effect:
Up to 1d6 {Type} that can see and hear you take 1d8 {DamageType} Damage, are Dazed and pushed 3 meters away from you.

~Click on the Icon to select which variant you want to have have!~

Variants.Name: See No Evil
Variants.ExtraEffect: One of them in particular takes +100% of the Damage.

Variants.Name: Doomsaying
Variants.ExtraEffect: If only 1 Unit is hit, it takes +200% of the Damage.

~See No Evil~.Name: ~See No Evil~

~Mind's Thing~.Effect:
Deal 1d12 + ^Your Presence or Focus^ {Type} Damage to a Unit.
For the rest of the combat, whenever it would take {Type} Damage, it takes {Damage} more (stacks indefinitely).

~Click on the icon to selecte the preferred effect!~
~Mind's Thing~.Name: ~Mind's Thing~

~Homecoming~.Effect:
Use when an ally would take Damage (or on your Turn).
Instantly pull it to you, then subtract 1d6 from the attack and give them the rolled die as one Shielding.
~Homecoming~.Notes:
The ally goes flying.
You need line of sight to the target. The allies fly to you ignoring obstacles and ground traps (goes around obstacles), unless the ally needs to swerve more than 2 meters in any direction.
If done on your Turn, the Shielding applies but there's no Damage to subtract from.
~Homecoming~.Name: ~Homecoming~

~Radiant Smite~.Effect:
Add 1d6 Damage to a weapon attack or single-target Ability. It's Damage Type becomes {Type}.
If the target dies, regain 1 {Mana}Mana.
~Radiant Smite~.Name: ~Radiant Smite~

~Healing Light~.Effect: Heal a Unit for 2d6 + your Presence, and all other Units within 1 meter of it that can hear and see you for -50% of that amount.
~Healing Light~.Upgrade: If there were no other Units, remove all Control Effects and Debuffs from the target.
~Healing Light~.Name: ~Healing Light~

~Sunshard~.Effect:
Blast a Unit for 1d8 {Type} Damage.
If it can't see or hear you, deals extra Damage equal to ^your^ Instinct.
~Sunshard~.Name: ~Sunshard~

~Holy Fire~.Notes: You can target different or the same Unit(s).

Variants.Name: Holy Fire
Variants.ExtraEffect: For each time it did 8 or more Damage, cast Awe on a different ally.

Variants.Name: Vampiric Fire
Variants.ExtraEffect: For each time it did 8 or more Damage, cast Awe on yourself.

~Holy Fire~.Name: ~Holy Fire~

~Vows of Zealotry~.Effect: While wearing Heavy Armor, Awe has ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type when cast on yourself, and your first melee attack each Combat Blinds the target.
~Vows of Zealotry~.Upgrade: Mercy is a gift for the innocent. For the rest of us, there is no vow - it's a lifestyle, heartfelt and righteous.
~Vows of Zealotry~.Name: ~Vows of Zealotry~
~Vows of Zealotry~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Taketh Away Sight~.Effect: Heal or deal 2d12 True Damage to a Unit you can see. It is Blinded and, for 1 Turn, can't see you and can't make ranged Acts.
~Taketh Away Sight~.Upgrade: For Epic Units, only limits their next offensive act to 1 meter Line of Sight.
~Taketh Away Sight~.Name: ~Taketh Away Sight~
~Taketh Away Sight~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Benediction~.Effect: Cast Awe on a Unit and apply a ~Combo~ to it. Its next single-target attack or Ability deals +50% Damage.
~Benediction~.Name: ~Benediction~

~Herald of Radiance~.Effect:
Awe Damage and Healing is 1d6 if you are at full Health.
You radiate light in a 3 meter radius.
~Herald of Radiance~.Notes: You can turn the light off at will.
~Herald of Radiance~.Name: ~Herald of Radiance~

~Herald of Twilight~.Effect:
Awe Damage and Healing is 1d6 on targets at or below 50% Health.
You can see normally in the dark up to 5 meters away.
~Herald of Twilight~.Name: ~Herald of Twilight~

<Aspect>.Effect: You take on a shadowy or illuminated appearance for the rest of the combat. Choose one:
List: ^Aspect of Light:^ After you use a Healing Ability, gain +1 Healing Spellpower.
^Aspect of Shadow:^ Your cast Spells don't need line of sight. Awe deals Scourge Damage. After you cast Awe, all your future Awe's deal +1 Damage. You can't Heal (with anything).
<Aspect>.Name: <Aspect>

~Death Beckons Me~.Effect:
Use when an Ally would take Damage (before calculations).
The ally only takes half, and you Damage yourself for the other half.
Then cast Awe, but it can't target you or that Ally.
~Death Beckons Me~.Name: ~Death Beckons Me~

~Privilege~.Effect:
Heal a Hero you can see for an amount equal to their Health Regen.
They do not Regen Health at the end of the Combat.
~Privilege~.Combo: They can Regen Health after Combat, but only for 50% of Health Regen.
~Privilege~.Name: ~Privilege~

~Second Light~.Effect:
A shining light bursts onto a Unit, dealing 2d8 + ^Presence^ {Type} Damage to it.
The next time somoene rolls dice that affect that Unit, the roller can reroll each die of that Act they choose once.
~Second Light~.Notes: The roller can rereoll them even if it was an area effect or another effect that affected multiple Units.
~Second Light~.Name: ~Second Light~

~Taketh Away Hearing~.Effect: A Unit you can see takes 3d8 Psychic Damage and is Silenced if it's a non-Epic monster (Deafened otherwise).
~Taketh Away Hearing~.Notes:
Cover is applied normally.
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.
~Taketh Away Hearing~.Name: ~Taketh Away Hearing~

~Reveling Rays~.Effect:
You shoot out 10 rays of light.
Roll 10d4 and assign them to Units within 10 meters as you wish.
Each die heals on odd rolls (1 and 3) and deals Divine Damage on even rolls (2 and 4).
~Reveling Rays~.Name: ~Reveling Rays~

~Fundamentals~.Effect: Pick one more Level 1 or Level 2 Class or Utility Talent.
~Fundamentals~.Name: ~Fundamentals~

~Let There Be Light~.Effect: While standing in natural light (e.g. the sun), your Healing Awe has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type and you are immune to being Silenced.
~Let There Be Light~.Notes:
Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.. It is up to the Quest Master what is considered natural light.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.
~Let There Be Light~.Name: ~Let There Be Light~

<Let There Be Darkness>.Effect: While standing in environmental shadows, your damaging Awe has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type and your attacks ignore Cover.
<Let There Be Darkness>.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.. It is up to the Quest Master what is considered shadow.
<Let There Be Darkness>.Name: <Let There Be Darkness>

~Assistance of Merit~.Effect: Whenever you use a Reaction, cast Awe or Single-Stun a Unit.
~Assistance of Merit~.Name: ~Assistance of Merit~
~Assistance of Merit~.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~Water Walk~.Effect:
Up to 2 willing Units can walk on water as normally.
The effect ends if the Unit takes Damage.
~Water Walk~.Name: ~Water Walk~

Variants.Name: Blessing of the Forge
Variants.Eff: Blessed Allies gain +1 Max Health permanently and 2 Shieldings each, equal to the Awe amount. Blessed enemies become Crippled. You can't bless yourself.

Variants.Name: Blessing of the Flame
Variants.Eff: Blessed Allies gain +1 Damage from all sources. Blessed enemies take +300% Damage from that Awe, and the Damage Type becomes Fire.

Variants.Name: Blessing of the Twilight
Variants.Eff: Blessed Allies become invisible until the end of their next Turn and gain +1 Movement Speed. Blessed Enemies have their line of sight reduced to 1 meter.

~Blessing of~.Name: ~Blessing of~
~Blessing of~.Notes: A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.

~Burning Thy Flesh~.Effect: For each 5 self-inflicted Damage you take, cast Awe twice, but it can't target Clerics.
~Burning Thy Flesh~.Name: ~Burning Thy Flesh~

~Sanctification~.Effect: Cast Awe twice on all Units currently affected by your Buffs and Debuffs or Control Effects.
~Sanctification~.Name: ~Sanctification~

<Circle of Awe>.Effect:
Declare a 4x4 meter area. Cast Awe on all Units inside the area.
After casting Awe 4 other times, reset the Cooldown of this Ability (except Awes from this Ability).
<Circle of Awe>.Name: <Circle of Awe>

~Mind's Thing Upgraded~.Effect:
Deal 1d12 + ^Your Presence or Focus^ {Type} Damage to a Unit.
For the rest of the combat ~you deal~ +{Damage} {Type} Damage (stacks indefinitely).

~Click on the icon to select the preferred effect!~
~Mind's Thing Upgraded~.Name: ~Mind's Thing Upgraded~

~Revendication~.Effect:
Use when using an Ability or when triggering a weapon effect.
Increase any _number_ in it's description by 1 for that Act only.
~Revendication~.Notes: Only numbers displayed with digits can increase (e.g. ^1^ can increase to 2, ^9^ can increase to 10, but ^one^ can not be increased).
~Revendication~.Name: ~Revendication~

~Ritual of Wonder~.Effect: Heal a Unit you can see for 6d6 and increase its Maximum Health by 1 permanently.
~Ritual of Wonder~.Name: ~Ritual of Wonder~

<Shadow Realm>.Effect:
A Unit becomes trapped in a Shadow Realm with you for 2 rounds (this and the next).
Your attacks cast Awe on it for free while inside the Shadow Realm.
<Shadow Realm>.Upgrade:
Neither of you can interact with the outside world, but can feintly see it.
Units on the outside can faintly see the two of you, as if you were ghosts.
The trapping ends immediately if you Fall.
<Shadow Realm>.Notes: The Shadow Realm is a copy of the normal world, but with no other units.
<Shadow Realm>.Name: <Shadow Realm>

<Black Hole>.Effect:
Choose a point as the center of a Black Hole which blocks light within 6 meters, and limits Units' line of sight to its event horizon.
At the end of each Round, Slam* all Units within 6 meters of the Black Hole towards the center.
When one comes within 1 meter of the center, cast Awe on it and it becomes Slowed.
<Black Hole>.Upgrade: Only Units that meet in the center take Damage from the Slam. Each takes Damage equal to their own distance thrown (if they slam into eachother).
<Black Hole>.Notes:
If Units are Slammed into other things, they take Damage as normal.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
<Black Hole>.Name: <Black Hole>

~Aweful Prophecy~.Effect:
Mark a Unit for _prophecy_.
At the start of your next Turn, repeat all Awe cast on it until then.
~Aweful Prophecy~.Name: ~Aweful Prophecy~

~One Hand Giveth~.Effect:
Your Abilities that inflict Blind, Silence, or Deafen deal -50% Damage to allies.
After an Ally recovers from being Blinded by you, their next Act deals 150% extra Damage.
After an Ally recovers from being Deafened or Silenced by you, their next Ability costs -3 {A}Action Points to cast.
~One Hand Giveth~.Name: ~One Hand Giveth~
~One Hand Giveth~.Notes:
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.

~God In Hand~.Effect:
Your next Ability or Attack costs 1 less {A}Action Point.
After doing a total of 50 Damage or 20 Healing in Worthy Combat, reset the Cooldown of this Ability.
~God In Hand~.Notes: The dealt Damage and Healing carries over from Combat to Combat, but resets to 0 after casting this Ability, and starts at 0 each Adventure.
~God In Hand~.Name: ~God In Hand~

~People's Awe~.Effect: Awe now hits all Units in a 2x2 area, but can't Heal yourself and requires being in Worthy Combat.
~People's Awe~.Name: ~People's Awe~

<Maiming Dark>.Effect:
Triple-Stun a Unit and Single-Stun another willing ally (not you). Then cast Awe on each.
These Units' Passive Abilities are disabled while affected.
<Maiming Dark>.Name: <Maiming Dark>
<Maiming Dark>.Notes:
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Double-Stunned Unit has -3 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~The Other Side~.Effect:
You start each Combat with +1 {Mana}Mana.
Also, at the start of each Combat, flip a coin:
List: ^Heads:^ you can only cast the _light_ versions of your Spells, and, whenever you cast one, gain +1 Divine or Healing Spellpower this Combat.
^Tails:^ you can only cast the _shadow_ versions of your Spells, and, whenever you cast one, move 2 meters and gain +1 Scourge Spellpower this Combat.
~The Other Side~.Name: ~The Other Side~

~Arbiter of Balance~.Effect: After you cast a light-themed Ability, your next shadow-themed Ability _balances the scales_ and automatically casts Awe (_and viceversa_).
~Arbiter of Balance~.Downside: If you fail to _balance the scales_, you take 1d4 Psychic Damage and become Deafened for your next Ability.
~Arbiter of Balance~.Notes:
Alternate between dark-themed and light-themed Abiliities, with anything inbetween, to prevent impairment and Damage. You may attack, move, and cast non-themed Abilities between light and dark-themed Abilities without being impaired. Your first Ability every Combat doesn't automatically cast that Awe, and starts the chain of balancing the scales.
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.
~Arbiter of Balance~.Name: ~Arbiter of Balance~

<Healing Doubledown>.Effect: Until the end of your next Turn, double all Healing you and your party does.
<Healing Doubledown>.Notes: Doesn't stack with other Healing multiplication effects.
<Healing Doubledown>.Name: <Healing Doubledown>

<Inedianism>.Effect:
Whenever you cast a 0 {A}Action Points Class Ability or Talent, another ally gains 1 {Mana}Mana.
Also, you don't need to eat or drink to live - you only need exposure to light.
<Inedianism>.Name: <Inedianism>

<Edict of Awe Eternal>.Effect:
~Cast Awe twice. The dice results are increased by 50%.~
This deals 1d4 Divine Damage to enemies or heals allies for 1d4.
Passively, your Focus and Presence increase by 2 and you can effortlessly levitate up to 1 meter above the ground, water etc. and don't take fall Damage.
<Edict of Awe Eternal>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Edict of Awe Eternal>.Name: <Edict of Awe Eternal>

<Miracle>.Effect:
You pray with divine confidence and purpose, and, with the gods' will, you manifest your wish upon your mortal world.
Choose one of the following effects to manifest:
{Diamond} Manifest restoration: Choose a person you can touch to instantly and fully kill, resurrect or Heal them, restore their body parts, injuries or handicaps, change their race, etc.
{Diamond} Manifest materialism: Create an object worth up to 5000 {Gold}Gold and make it appear out of thin air in a beacon of blinding light. Or choose an object or area worth that much and make it disappear; Units with their materialistic value worth a total of 5000 {Gold} or less also disappear.
{Diamond} Manifest fate: Determine or read the near future of one Unit.
{Diamond} Manifest mistake: Undo a recent past event that was not a Worthy Combat. You and your party remains in the present to witness the aftermath.
{Diamond} Manifest destruction: Deal 2d100 Scourge Damage spread (after rolling) as you like among Units within 10 meters.
{Diamond} Manifest development: Choose a Unit and increase up to 2 of their Stats by 1, or they permanently learn a new Basic Ability, etc.
{Diamond} Manifest creativity: Choose something else with a similar scope to do, if the gods will.
After casting Miracle, if the gods will, the Cooldown of Miracle may be reset if they deem the effect was not worthy enough.
<Miracle>.Notes: The gods' will is determined by the Quest Master. Talk to the QM about your possibilities.
<Miracle>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Miracle>.Name: <Miracle>

~Hamorrhage~.Effect:
This Turn, you deal -100% Damage.
However, all Damage you would have done is instead applied to the enemy as a delayed _wound_.
The next time it takes Damage, it also takes all the _wound_ Damage.
