~Hamorrhage~.Name: ~Hamorrhage~

~Dust of Appearance~.Effect:
Mark a Unit with _dust of appearance_.
Other allies deal +10% Damage with all attacks against the marked Unit.
~Dust of Appearance~.Name: ~Dust of Appearance~

~Hidden in Plain Sight~.Effect: In the first round of every combat, enemies can't target you with attacks or Abilities.
~Hidden in Plain Sight~.Name: ~Hidden in Plain Sight~

~Ambush~.Effect: Every Worthy Combat, your first weapon attack deals +1d8 Damage.
~Ambush~.Upgrade: At Level 2, your Specialization will greatly improve your Ambush.
~Ambush~.Name: ~Ambush~

~Stalking~.Effect: On the first Round of Combat, you can start your Turn whenever you like (even during other Units' turns), and make a free Move Act.
~Stalking~.Upgrade: You do count as a Hero Turn towards monsters' Setback, and so perhaps more monsters will take their Turn after you.
~Stalking~.Notes:
If you interrupted an Ally's Turn, monsters may take their Turn immediately after you if their Setback is enough. Then the Ally can resume their Turn.
If you want to start during an enemy's Turn, you do so when they declare they want to do something or after they finish doing something.
~Stalking~.Name: ~Stalking~

~Bells and Whistles~.Effect:
You setup an invisible 6x6x6 meter area.
If an unknown Unit or Enemy enters the cube, you are immediately alerted and woken up.
While inside the area, ^you^ cannot be Surprised.
~Bells and Whistles~.Name: ~Bells and Whistles~

~Camping~.Effect:
Setup camp, creating favorable conditions for your party for up to 8 in-game hours.
Units in the camp are protected from all bad weather and are immune to being poisoned by food and drink.
Until the end of the Adventure, all Units who camped here are immune to Hard Terrain.
~Camping~.Name: ~Camping~
~Camping~.Notes: Moving 1 meter through Hard Terrain takes 2 meters of Movement.

~Panther's Paw~.Effect: You are immune to Fall Damage.
~Panther's Paw~.Name: ~Panther's Paw~

~Fame and Fortune~.Effect: The next time you deal Damage, gain {Gold}Gold equal to 300% of the Damage dealt.
~Fame and Fortune~.Name: ~Fame and Fortune~

~Knife Throw~.Effect: Your next melee One-Handed weapon attack has a 4 meter range.
~Knife Throw~.Name: ~Knife Throw~

~Parry~.Effect: Your next attack deals -50% Damage, but gives an ally you can see one Shielding that can block 1d6 Damage.
~Parry~.Name: ~Parry~

<Pocket Sand>.Name: <Pocket Sand>
<Pocket Sand>.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Goldborn~.Effect: You can spend 300 {Gold}Gold to gain +2 Maximum Health, up to +10 total.
~Goldborn~.Name: ~Goldborn~

~Creeping Ambush~.Effect: Insted of dealing Damage to the same target with Ambush, you can deal it to another Unit you can see.
~Creeping Ambush~.Name: ~Creeping Ambush~

~Lockpicking~.Effect: While you have this Talent, you have the Lockpicking Skill, and an extra +1 in Lockpicking.
~Lockpicking~.Name: ~Lockpicking~

~Gladiator Grandeur~.Effect:
Choose a Worthy Enemy.
Gain {Gold}Gold equal to the enemy's current Health.
That Enemy gains +1 {A}Action Point on its next Turn.
~Gladiator Grandeur~.Upgrade: You only gain 50% of an Epic Unit's current Health.
~Gladiator Grandeur~.Name: ~Gladiator Grandeur~

~Hemorrhage~.Effect:
Use after dealing Damage. Deal -100% Damage. However, all Damage you would have done instead becomes a delayed _wound_ on the target.
The next time it takes (more than 0) Damage, it consumes all _wounds_ and takes extra Damage equal to all the _wounds_.
~Hemorrhage~.Notes: Wounds add up until consumed. The Damager is considered the source of the wound Damage.
~Hemorrhage~.Name: ~Hemorrhage~

~Fool's Gold~.Effect: After you Ambush, gain {Gold}Gold equal to all the Damage done by the attack.
~Fool's Gold~.Notes: Lore-wise, as a Thief, you prepare and build up momentum in combat. When you reach a town, you put your preparations in motion and gain the gold. Feel free to them
~Fool's Gold~.Name: ~Fool's Gold~

~Ambush Upgrade~.Effect: Immediately pick a Level 2 Talent, which upgrades and replaces your starting Ambush.
~Ambush Upgrade~.Name: ~Ambush Upgrade~

~Backstabbing Ambush~.Effect: Every ~Turn~, your first weapon attack deals +1d6 Damage ~if there is an ally of yours near the target~.
~Backstabbing Ambush~.Name: ~Backstabbing Ambush~

~Icebreaker Ambush~.Effect: Every ~Turn~, your first weapon attack deals +1d10 Damage ~if the target is at full Health~.
~Icebreaker Ambush~.Name: ~Icebreaker Ambush~

~Thief's Ambush~.Effect:
Every Worthy Combat, your first weapon attack deals ~+2d8~ Damage ~and applies a ~Combo~~.
~Gain~ {Gold}~{Gold}Gold equal to the ambushed amount.~
~Thief's Ambush~.Name: ~Thief's Ambush~

<Magic Trickster>.Effect:
You have 2 {Mana}Mana that replenishes inbetween Adventures and gain access to one `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` of choice.
When you get this Talent, you can pick 2 Magic Font Spells to Know.
<Magic Trickster>.Notes: You can change all these choices inbetween Adventures.
<Magic Trickster>.Name: <Magic Trickster>

<Verge of the Coin>.Effect: Whenever ^you^ would Damage a Worthy Enemy leaving it at 10% or less Health, it dies, and you gain {Gold}Gold equal to its Maximum Health.
<Verge of the Coin>.Name: <Verge of the Coin>

~Shade Bend~.Effect:
Choose a shadow you can see.
You can manipulate the shape of this shadow and even extend it upward to attack for 1d6 and Daze the target.
~Shade Bend~.Upgrade: This attack is able to trigger Ambush.
~Shade Bend~.Name: ~Shade Bend~

~Ghost Strike~.Effect: When you Ambush, also deal 50% of the Ambush Damage to another Unit within 3 meters of the main target.
~Ghost Strike~.Notes: Refers, for example, to the extra 1d8, not the entire attack's Damage.
~Ghost Strike~.Name: ~Ghost Strike~

<Hide In Plain Sight>.Effect:
When Combat starts, you can start on any visible edge of the battlefield.
The first time you deal Damage each Combat, you can choose to reroll any of the rolled dice.
<Hide In Plain Sight>.Notes: You know the ins and outs of battlefields so well that you successfully reposition before anyone else notices.
<Hide In Plain Sight>.Name: <Hide In Plain Sight>

<Bounty Appraisal>.Effect:
When Worthy Combat starts, the Quest Master determines which is the most powerful enemy.
When that enemy dies, Heal an ally for 1d10 and gain {Gold}Gold equal to 1000% of the amount healed.
<Bounty Appraisal>.Name: <Bounty Appraisal>

~Poison Craft~.Effect:
You coat each of your weapons in a potent poison.
Choose an effect for each.

Values: +1 Damage against Units with 25% or less Health
First attack with the weapon each Combat Slows the target
Weapon's Damage Type becomes Poison, Acid, or Scourge

~Poison Craft~.Name: ~Poison Craft~

<Magestep>.Effect:
Teleport up to 3 meters away.
Your next attack applies your Ambush if it wouldn't normally, and all the Damage becomes Fire, Cold or Shock (your choice).
<Magestep>.Downside: Ambush can only trigger Once / Turn.
<Magestep>.Name: <Magestep>

<Moneycraft>.Effect: Spend 400 {Gold}Gold to permanently improve a piece of equipment. Depending on its type (armor or weapon), roll on the table below to determine the effect you get.
<Moneycraft>.Upgrade: A piece of equipment can be improved any number of times, but every extra improvement costs twice as much as its previous improvement.
<Moneycraft>.Name: <Moneycraft>

<Trap Wires>.Effect:
When combat starts, deploy a number of Trap Wires equal to ^your Focus or Presence^, anywhere on the battlefield.
A Trap Wire is thin and up to 3 meters long, and must be deployed between 2 obstacles.
If a Unit touches a Trap Wire, it takes 1d10 Shock damage and becomes Dazed.
<Trap Wires>.Upgrade: Units with less than 2 Presence can't see the Trap Wires.
<Trap Wires>.Notes:
Each end of the wire must be attached to something solid and static.
You can make use of walls, obstacles, etc.
Requires a Special Tripwire Set item, which can be bought for 100 gold (or freely crafted for the same price in materials).
<Trap Wires>.Name: <Trap Wires>

<Blade Tempest>.Effect:
Throw 8 shurikens: one towards each direction (north, north-east, east, etc).
Each shuriken travels 4 meters, deals 2d6 Slash Damage to all Units it passes through, then stops in place.
At the end of your next turn, each shuriken returns to you, dealing 2d6 Slash Damage again to all Units it passes through.
<Blade Tempest>.Notes: Requires 8 Special Shuriken items, which can be bought for a total of 120 gold (or freely crafted for the same price in materials). If you're playing on a Grid, take semi-hitting into account for blades that don't travel squares exactly in the 8 directions. Cover applies normally to each blade.
<Blade Tempest>.Name: <Blade Tempest>

~Highway Robbery~.Effect: At the start of each Combat, choose a monster. All Units with the same name get +1 Setback. You gain +0.5 Initiative this Combat for each (up to +3).
~Highway Robbery~.Name: ~Highway Robbery~

<Gold Hoard>.Effect:
You gain various bonuses based on how much gold you are carrying.
You gain 1000% inventory capacity.

Values: +10% gold that ^you^ find and get from Abilities

<Gold Hoard>.Name: <Gold Hoard>

<Finders Keepers>.Effect: When looting a _lootable object_ that _contains Worthy items_, you can spend any amount of gold to also loot an item worth up to twice the spent amount.
<Finders Keepers>.Notes: It is up to the Quest Master what a _lootable object_ is (could be a chest, the corpse of an enemy, etc). Also, it is up to the Quest Master what _Worthy items_ means (could be main quest items, magic items, or just a normal chest).
<Finders Keepers>.Name: <Finders Keepers>

<Draw Steel>.Effect: Refresh all your other Cooldowns, Ambushes, and retrigger any _start of Combat_ effects from your Abilities.
<Draw Steel>.Notes: Refreshing an Ambush means you can use it again this Turn if you already used it.
<Draw Steel>.Name: <Draw Steel>

<Minor Golden Ambush>.Effect: When you Ambush, spend 10% of your carried total {Gold}Gold (minimum 100) to add +1d8 Damage.
<Minor Golden Ambush>.Notes: You need to have this gold on you.
<Minor Golden Ambush>.Name: <Minor Golden Ambush>

<Minor Savage Ambush>.Effect: When you Ambush, if the target also has 50% or less Health (before your attack's Damage), the attack deals +1d6 Damage.
<Minor Savage Ambush>.Name: <Minor Savage Ambush>

<Minor Icebreaker Ambush>.Effect: When you Ambush a Unit that has full Health, the attack deals +1d6 Damage.
<Minor Icebreaker Ambush>.Name: <Minor Icebreaker Ambush>

<Minor Isolated Ambush>.Effect: When you Ambush a Unit, if there are no other Units within 1 meter of it (except you), the attack deals +1d6 Damage.
<Minor Isolated Ambush>.Name: <Minor Isolated Ambush>

~King of Beggars~.Effect:
You are accompanied by 2 _bodyguards_, take their Turn immediately after you finish yours and automatically rush to attack Units you attacked this Turn.
Each has 2 {A}Action Points which they can use for at most 1 attack per Turn.
You can equip them with any items, but their baseline Damage is only affected by extra Item effects and bonuses.
If any of them dies, you get new ones when visiting a town or city.
~King of Beggars~.Upgrade: Whenever one of them survives Combat, it gains +1d4 Max Health permanently.

~Weapon Attack~.Effect: Can benefit from any of the equipped weapon's effects, magical or artisanal enhancements, Runes, and Abilities.

~King of Beggars~.Name: ~King of Beggars~

<Sharp Toss>.Effect: This turn, whenever you do an Act, flick a throwable and deal 1d4 Pierce Damage to a Unit.
<Sharp Toss>.Notes: Can flick needles, small knives, shuriken, etc. When thrown, is not considered an Act, and the cast itself does not trigger a flick.
<Sharp Toss>.Name: <Sharp Toss>

~What Sorcery~.Effect:
Your non-Rogue Abilities can trigger your chosen Ambush. If they hit multiple Units, each may take Ambush Damage if it matches the conditions.
You gain +2 Max {Mana}Mana.
~What Sorcery~.Name: ~What Sorcery~

~Everything Has A Price~.Upgrade: You may apply any of these to an ally instead of yourself, but the price is increased by 50%.
~Everything Has A Price~.Name: ~Everything Has A Price~

~Larceny~.Effect: Make a Instinct Check against a Worthy Unit's Instinct Check. If you succeed, permanently steal a random Stat or Attribute from it:
~Larceny~.Notes: Stealing Health Regen from a Unit that doesn't have Health Regen reduces its Max Health by twice that amount instead. If stealing Initiative from a monster, its Setback increases by 1 instead.
~Larceny~.Name: ~Larceny~

~Produce Contraband~.Effect: At the start of each Adventure, you produce a random Magic Item worth somewhere between 25 and 400 {Experience}Experience.
~Produce Contraband~.Notes: The Quest Master determines what item you get and its {XP}Experience worth, which may be entirely random or based on the current situation or other factors.
~Produce Contraband~.Name: ~Produce Contraband~

<Spellkill>.Effect: After you Ambush, your next Spell this Turn costs -1 {Mana}Mana.
<Spellkill>.Name: <Spellkill>

1000 Cuts.Effect:
All your Ambush dice become d12's (including Minor Ambush Talents) and none of your dice can be lower than d8's.
You automatically pass all Hard Instinct Checks (that require at least 15).
1000 Cuts.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
1000 Cuts.Name: 1000 Cuts

Value Town.Effect:
When you get this Talent, gain 2500d100 {Gold}Gold, +2 Initiative, and +2 Presence.
You automatically pass all Hard Presence Checks (that require at least 15).
Value Town.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
Value Town.Name: Value Town

Who Am I.Effect:
You abandon your old self to become an indistinguishably similar copy of another person or non-Large biological Unit, copying their voice, speaking patterns, body, even clothes, etc. You may willingly turn yourself back into your old self, but every time you do, a certain trait appears slightly off, such as your height changing slightly, your eyes, your nose, your skin color, etc. When turning into a copy of a party member, you gain all their Abilities, Stats, etc and lose access to yours (except Ambushes) until you turn back effectively becoming a copy of them. You may keep all Stats, Abilities, etc when transforming into a non-Hero.
Also, passively, all your Stats increase by 1.
Who Am I.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
Who Am I.Name: Who Am I

<Shadowpass>.Effect: Choose a point covered in shadow up to 6 meters away and teleport to it.
<Shadowpass>.Upgrade: You can use this as a Reaction when an enemy wants to attack you (before dealing the Damage). If it can't do the attack anymore, it must choose something else to do.
<Shadowpass>.Name: <Shadowpass>

~Isolated Ambush~.Effect: Every ~Turn~, your first ~attack or single-target offensive Ability against an isolated Unit~ deals +1d8 Damage.
~Isolated Ambush~.Notes: A Unit is _isolated_ if there are no other Units (except you) within 1 meter of it.
~Isolated Ambush~.Name: ~Isolated Ambush~

~Sudden Ambush~.Effect:
Every Worthy Combat, your first weapon attack deals ~+3d6~ Damage.
~If you end a Turn without having dealt Damage, reset this.~
~Sudden Ambush~.Name: ~Sudden Ambush~

~Savage Ambush~.Effect: Every ~Turn~, your first ~attack or single-target offensive Ability against a Unit with 50% or less Health~ deals +1d10 Damage.
~Savage Ambush~.Name: ~Savage Ambush~

<Practice Makes Lethal>.Effect:
Whenever ^you^ kill a Worthy Enemy, gain a ^Practice Makes Lethal^ point.
While you have this Talent, your first Damaging Attack or Ability every Worthy Combat deals extra Damage equal to your ^Practice Makes Lethal^ points.
<Practice Makes Lethal>.Name: <Practice Makes Lethal>

<Enveloping Shadows>.Effect:
Immediately before or after you Shadowpass (your choice), all Units within 1 meter from you become Blinded.
Your next attack deals +1d4 Damage.
<Enveloping Shadows>.Name: <Enveloping Shadows>
<Enveloping Shadows>.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

<Critical Doubledown>.Effect:
When you ^Critical Strike^, the ^Critical Strike^ effect happens twice.
If a weapon can't do a ^Critical Strike^, it also has the following effect:
<Critical Doubledown>.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - If you rolled maximum on at least one die with a {1AP} weapon, deal +1 Damage (+1d4 if {2AP}).
<Critical Doubledown>.Upgrade: Note that the additional (green) Critical Strike is also doubled!
<Critical Doubledown>.Name: <Critical Doubledown>

<Cutting Verve>.Effect: After you Ambush, you can choose one of the rolled dice and give it to an ally you can see (or yourself) as a Shielding after dealing the Damage.
<Cutting Verve>.Name: <Cutting Verve>

<Isolation>.Effect: When Ambushing a Unit, if there is no other Unit near it (except you), the target becomes Dazed.
<Isolation>.Name: <Isolation>

<Displacemental Ambush>.Effect: After you Ambush, Slam the target 1d4 meters for each time you moved from place this Turn.
<Displacemental Ambush>.Name: <Displacemental Ambush>

<Take-Out Shadowpass>.Effect:
Choose a point covered in shadow up to 6 meters away and teleport to it.
~Your next attack within 1 minute makes the target roll a Might Check against the Damage done. If it fails, it becomes put to Sleep for 1 minute.~
<Take-Out Shadowpass>.Upgrade:
You can decide to do 0 Damage, and the Check difficulty becomes 5 + ^your Focus^
You can use this as a Reaction when an enemy wants to attack you (before dealing the Damage). If it can't do the attack anymore, it must choose something else to do.
~Epic monsters are instead Double-Stunned for 1 Turn.~
<Take-Out Shadowpass>.Name: <Take-Out Shadowpass>
<Take-Out Shadowpass>.Notes: A Double-Stunned Unit has -2 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

<Shadow Maw>.Effect:
Open a 5x5 meter maw of shadows on the ground.
All Units caught take 3d6 Psychic Damage.
The shadow maw is completely dark and disorientig - if a Unit starts its Turn in the maw, it must begin by making a Move Act in a random direction.
<Shadow Maw>.Upgrade: Single-target attacks have no line of sight from, to and through the maw, and everything else has Cover.
<Shadow Maw>.Name: <Shadow Maw>

<Blade Verge>.Effect: Whenever ^you^ would Damage an Enemy leaving it at 10% Health or below, it dies, and you can instantly Shadowpass now regardless of its Cooldown.
<Blade Verge>.Name: <Blade Verge>

<Shadowlayers>.Requirement: Only usable until the end of the next Turn after you Shadowpass
<Shadowlayers>.Effect: Immediately Shadowpass back to where you last Shadowpassed from (to the original position from which you Shadowpassed), then become invisible until the start of your next Turn (or for 6 seconds). Also, passively, you can use Shadowpass to teleport an ally instead of yourself.
<Shadowlayers>.Notes: This special Shadowpass doesn't retrigger Shadowlayers, but is improved by any Shadowpass upgrades and effects you have.
<Shadowlayers>.Name: <Shadowlayers>

<One Turn Kill>.Effect: Whenever you take a Worthy Enemy from 50% (or more) to 0% Health in one Turn, Heal for 1d8 and reset all your Cooldowns (including Ambush).
<One Turn Kill>.Name: <One Turn Kill>

~Stalking Prey~.Effect:
~In~ Combat, you can start your Turn whenever you like (even during other Units' turns), and make a free Move Act ~every Turn~.
~You take -50% Damage from all sources if you haven't taken Damage this Round.~
~Stalking Prey~.Upgrade: You do count as a Hero Turn towards monsters' Setback, and so perhaps more monsters will take their Turn after you.
~Stalking Prey~.Notes:
If you interrupted an Ally's Turn, monsters may take their Turn immediately after you if their Setback is enough. Then the Ally can resume their Turn.
If you want to start during an enemy's Turn, you do so when they declare they want to do something or after they finish doing something.
~Stalking Prey~.Name: ~Stalking Prey~

<Ambushing Shadowpass>.Effect: After you Shadowpass, your first Damaging Attack or Spell that turn deals +1d6 Damage.
<Ambushing Shadowpass>.Name: <Ambushing Shadowpass>

~No Blinking~.Effect: Whenever you would kill a Unit from 90% or more Health in the same Turn, your next attack deals extra Damage equal to 50% of the recently killed Unit's Max Health.
~No Blinking~.Name: ~No Blinking~

<Planned Assassination>.Effect:
Name a Unit.
Next Combat, your Ambushes deal +150% Damage against Units with that name.
<Planned Assassination>.Notes: A Unit counts as having the same name if it's base name is the same (works against higher-Level versions of the same Enemy).
<Planned Assassination>.Name: <Planned Assassination>

~Garrote~.Requirement: Only usable in first Round of Combat
~Garrote~.Effect: Freely Shadowpass behind any Unit on the battlefield and Triple-Stun it.
~Garrote~.Upgrade: When used outside Combat, you can Shadowpass behind a Unit within 15 meters.
~Garrote~.Name: ~Garrote~
~Garrote~.Notes: A Double-Stunned Unit has -3 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

<Finale>.Effect: For each attack, Ability and application of Ambush you made this turn, deal 1d10 Damage that ignores all Shielding and Damage Reductions.
<Finale>.Name: <Finale>

<Coup de Grace>.Effect:
Whenever you Ambush a Worthy Enemy, roll a Instinct Check at least equal to ^target's total Stats sum^ to increase the Ambush dice Damage by 50%.
If you fail, your next Check this Adventure increases by 50%.
<Coup de Grace>.Name: <Coup de Grace>

<Sanguinity>.Effect: All Healing and Shielding you do increases by 100%. When Healing a Unit that's not at 100% Health already, your next Ambush deals extra Damage equal to the overheal amount.
<Sanguinity>.Notes: If the target was at 46/50 Health, and you Heal for 15, your next Ambush deals +11 Damage.
<Sanguinity>.Name: <Sanguinity>

~Fan of Blades~.Effect: Whenever you Ambush, deal the extra Ambush Damage to all Enemies within 2 meters of the main target.
~Fan of Blades~.Name: ~Fan of Blades~

Death.Effect:
Deal 95d10 Damage to a Unit. If they die, gain +2 Skill Points.
Also, passively, you gain +3 Instinct.
Death.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
Death.Name: Death

Onslaught Ambush.Effect:
Gain all Level 7 Ambush Talents and your Shadowpass Cooldown becomes Once / Round.

Also, passively, you gain +1 Instinct and Presence.
Onslaught Ambush.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
Onslaught Ambush.Name: Onslaught Ambush

~Better Echo~.Effect: The first spell you cast each combat repeats next round at half effect.
~Better Echo~.Name: ~Better Echo~

~Farsight or Foresight~.Effect: You can see the future, like what a Unit will do and its result. Roll anticipatory dice for it or something.
~Farsight or Foresight~.Name: ~Farsight or Foresight~

~Where Did Witchdoctor Go?~.Effect: Hold a concoction a number of turns - the longer you hold it, the more damage/stun. It may explode on you though (if you roll 1 but the dice increases)
~Where Did Witchdoctor Go?~.Name: ~Where Did Witchdoctor Go?~

~Revenant~.Effect: When you die, you rise as a revenant
~Revenant~.Name: ~Revenant~

~Echoes~.Effect:
After you cast a Basic Ability, roll 1d8.
If you rolled 8 on it, the Ability _echoes_ and you cast it again (for 0 {A}Action Points), but ^all^ Damage or Healing it does is reduced by 50%.
The _echoed_ Ability can't affect the same target(s) or area.
~Echoes~.Notes:
Abilities like Recuperate can't _echo_, since the only possible target is yourself.
If the area overlaps the initial area, the overlapped part has no effect. If it hits the same target(s), it has no effect on them.
Take the Ability text as it is - _echoing_ Lightning Storm repeats the initial Damage, but you'd have to spend another 2 {A}Action Points to retrigger the second Lightning Storm.
The QM has the word on whether something is possible.
~Echoes~.Name: ~Echoes~

~Link Minds~.Effect:
Establish a mind connection with a willing ally.
For the rest of the Adventure, you can talk to eachother telepathically.
~Link Minds~.Notes: You can only have one Focus Linked ally at a time.
~Link Minds~.Name: ~Link Minds~

~Dispel Magic~.Effect: Dispell all ongoing _non-chronic_ magical effects on a Unit (any magical Control Effects, magical buffs and debuffs, etc).
~Dispel Magic~.Notes: Chronic effects are ones that last days, months or are permanent, such as curses, vampirism, etc.
~Dispel Magic~.Name: ~Dispel Magic~

~Fairy Fire~.Effect:
Declare a 4x4x4 meter area.
All Units in that area become outlined in a colored glow (you choose the color). They can't benefit from Cover, turn invisible and their Surprise bonus/minus is cancelled.
~Fairy Fire~.Notes:
The Units glow even through walls, but the denser the walls, the less they appear to glow.
A 1-meter (thickness) of concrete wall completely blocks the glow.
This is not considered a Control Effect.
~Fairy Fire~.Name: ~Fairy Fire~

~Blood and Salt~.Effect: Until the start of your next turn, you take -1d4 Damage from all sources.
~Blood and Salt~.Name: ~Blood and Salt~

<Incorporeal Form>.Effect:
You become a bodyless soul for up to 8 hours and enter a willing ally.
While inside the ally's body, you can communicate with them mentally, and only they can see you.
You can slightly peek outside of their body, and move your arms, upper body and head as if you were a ghost originating from that ally's body.
{Diamond} You can't move yourself, but you always move with that ally.
{Diamond} You can't do any physical actions (because you are a ghost and can't touch anything or anyone).
{Diamond} You can cast spells normally. 
{Diamond} You follow your own Initiative in combat.
{Diamond} You can't take Control Effects from external sources, but you feel every body sensation that ally feels.
You can freely exit their body and revert back to your physical self using 0 {A}Action Points.
<Incorporeal Form>.Name: <Incorporeal Form>

<Dream Walk>.Effect:
Make a Presence Check against another non-Epic Unit's Presence Check. If you succeed, it falls Asleep for 2 turns.
Alternatively, you can use Dream Walk on an already sleeping target to alter their dreams to your liking.
<Dream Walk>.Notes: A Sleeping Unit wakes up if it takes Damage or other Control Effects.
<Dream Walk>.Name: <Dream Walk>

<Enlightening Ritual>.Effect:
You undergo an isolated, personal and mind-altering ritual with a willing non-Warlock Hero at a campfire, and using incense, smoke and special herbs.
The ally must make a Presence Check against 6 + Your Presence.
If it succeeds, its Max {Mana}Mana permanently increases by 1, and gets +2 to all Checks for the rest of the Adventure.
If it fails, it takes 1d8 Psychic Damage and gets -1 to all Checks for the rest of the Adventure.
<Enlightening Ritual>.Upgrade:
You can perform this ritual as many times as you want per Adventure until you succeed once. It costs you 1 {Mana}Mana (not Max {Mana}Mana), which is spent when the ally passes the ritual.
A person can only succeed one Enlightening Ritual in their lifetime.
Respeccing keeps the effects for your Ally.
<Enlightening Ritual>.Name: <Enlightening Ritual>

<Rainmaking>.Effect:
Perform a ritual to change the weather or atmosphere on a 100 meter area (in diameter) centered on you.
Choose one option from Storm, Wind, Heat, Cold.
<Rainmaking>.Notes: In dungeons and indoors, this only goes through open doors and spaces - the weather starts from you and extends as much as possible through open holes, windows, doors, etc.

Values: Your team deals 2 extra Damage with all Spells
Your team has +1 Movement Speed, +1 Damage with missiles and can freely jump 5 meters (using Movement)
Your team deals 2 extra Damage with physical weapons

<Rainmaking>.Name: <Rainmaking>

<Psyche Tether>.Effect:
Place a tether on 2 Units within 10 meters of you.
The next time one of them is Damaged or Healed, the other one takes the Damage (as Psychic Damage) or Healing as well.
<Psyche Tether>.Notes:
If both are Damaged/Healed at the same time, this only applies once and you choose which takes the Damage/Healing of the other.
The extra Damage of Smites, Ambush, etc over an attack counts as the same Damage source.
<Psyche Tether>.Name: <Psyche Tether>

~Sending~.Effect: Send a message no longer than 5 seconds long to an ally, wherever it is. It can include images, sounds and smells. That ally knows they received a message from you.
~Sending~.Upgrade: Requires you to be holding something physical from that ally, such as a piece of clothing, an object, a strand of hair, etc.
~Sending~.Notes: Sending might be impeded if sent to another plane/world.
~Sending~.Name: ~Sending~

~Telekinesis~.Effect:
For the next 1 minute, while channeling, you can manipulate objects 10 meters away from you as if used by your own hand.
You can also zoom in on your vision, hearing and smelling up to 10 meters away.
~Telekinesis~.Name: ~Telekinesis~

<Synchronicity>.Effect: Your _echo_ dice become 2d8 (instead of 1d8). Each rolled 8 makes the Ability Echo.
<Synchronicity>.Name: <Synchronicity>

<Reincarnation>.Effect:
Use when you or an ally you can see Falls or dies. Choose an animal from the Pets and Animals list.
They immediately come to life as a translucent spirit version of that Animal.
Lasts until the ally Rises (or the animal dies too).
<Reincarnation>.Upgrade: The ally can do Animal Attack (Druid), which does 1d6 + ^their Presence^ Damage (for a 1 {A}Action Point).
<Reincarnation>.Name: <Reincarnation>

~Second Soul~.Effect:
You have another Unit beside you that you control which is essentially another Hero.
Your companion is built like a normal Level 1 Hero, but all its stats are decreased by 1, starts with no separate {Gold}Gold and can not gain Feats.
It always has the same Initiative as you and Levels Up only when you Level Up (doesn't have personal Experience).
~Second Soul~.Upgrade: For the Quest Masters, your companion counts as a normal Hero for encounter Experience!
~Second Soul~.Notes: Come up with a story about why you have your companion and why your god allowed this or gave them to you.
~Second Soul~.Name: ~Second Soul~

<Weakness of the Soul>.Effect: Cast Awe on a Unit. It becomes Slowed and Blinded. Apply a ~Combo~.
<Weakness of the Soul>.Name: <Weakness of the Soul>
<Weakness of the Soul>.Notes:
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Warding Incense~.Effect:
Use when an ally would take Damage.
Roll 1d6 and subtract that much from the attack.
Then give them the rolled die as one Shielding and apply a ~Combo~ on them.
~Warding Incense~.Name: ~Warding Incense~

~Saving Throw~.Effect:
Use when the Turn of an Enemy starts (or on your Turn).
Instantly pull another ally to your nearest empty space.
~Saving Throw~.Notes:
The ally goes flying.
You need line of sight to the targets. The allies fly to you ignoring obstacles and ground traps (goes around obstacles), unless the ally needs to swerve more than 2 meters in any direction.
~Saving Throw~.Name: ~Saving Throw~

~Mending~.Effect:
Touch a slightly broken piece of material that is still in one piece.
You can repair the Damage done to it.
Mending can repair a piece of Armor or Weapon for 1 Defense or Damage, but no more.
~Mending~.Notes: For example, repair a hole through a chain shirt or textile material, the crack in a piece of glass, etc.
~Mending~.Name: ~Mending~

~Partner in Life~.Effect:
Your companion is an alive being. It can be a sentient person of any race, except Hollow.
This companion's soul is tied to yours and viceversa - when one of you dies, the other dies as well.
Both of you gain +3 Health Regen.
~Partner in Life~.Name: ~Partner in Life~

~True Necromancy~.Effect:
Your companion is an undead. It can be a sentient undead person of any race (without affecting its stats) or an abstract undead creature using any race's Abilities.
This companion's life depends on yours - when you die, your companion dies as well.
Your companion takes -50% Slashing and Scourge Damage.
~True Necromancy~.Notes: If your companion dies, you can spend 1 week to "revive" someone else as your new companion.
~True Necromancy~.Name: ~True Necromancy~

~Guardian Angel~.Effect:
Your companion is an otherworldly celestial in material form. It can be a sentient person of any race, or an abstrat celestial creature using any race's Abilities.
Your life is tied to your companion's - when it dies, you die.
You share the your Health pool with your companion (it does not have separate separate Health). If it goes more than 10 meters away from you, it is teleported near you immediately.
You gain +10 Maximum Health.
~Guardian Angel~.Name: ~Guardian Angel~

<Blessing of Life>.Effect:
Cast Awe ~twice~ and the target(s) becomes Blessed until the end of the next (or current) Combat.
Blessed Allies have +1 to all Checks ~and +1 to all Damage instances~. Blessed Enemies have -3 Initiative ~and -1 to all Damage instances~.
<Blessing of Life>.Upgrade: On Epic Monsters, the -1 Damage only affects their first turn.
<Blessing of Life>.Notes:
You can bless yourself.
Lasts until the end of the next combat encounter.
<Blessing of Life>.Name: <Blessing of Life>

~Awe For Corpses~.Effect:
Whenever you spend {Mana}Mana, "cast Awe" on a Unit.
This deals 1d4 Divine Damage to enemies or heals allies for 1d4.
~However, if there is any nearby corpse within 5 meters when you would cast Awe, you instead raise a zombie to fight for you from that corpse.~
~Awe For Corpses~.Notes: Ignores Cover. Some other Cleric spells will "cast Awe" for free. Zombies take their turn on your turn.

~Attack~.Effect: Attack an Enemy for 1d4 Damage (Pierce, Slash or Smash).

~Awe For Corpses~.Name: ~Awe For Corpses~

~Reaping~.Effect:
Whenever a Worthy Enemy dies in combat, gain 0.05 Max {Mana}Mana.
If ^you^ killed that Worthy Enemy, gain 0.2 instead.
~Reaping~.Name: ~Reaping~

<Divine Transposition>.Effect: Swap places with your companion, then cast Awe on both of you.
<Divine Transposition>.Name: <Divine Transposition>

Manual Extras: +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +4)
<Stat Bonus 4>.Effect: Gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +4.
<Stat Bonus 4>.Name: <Stat Bonus 4>

<Double Stat Bonus>.Effect: Gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +3, twice.
<Double Stat Bonus>.Name: <Double Stat Bonus>

<Ascendance>.Effect:
Your Awe has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
You gain Wingspan (Cleric) and Penitence.
You start every Adventure with one extra Inspiration Point.
<Ascendance>.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1..
<Ascendance>.Name: <Ascendance>

~Wingspan (Cleric)~.Effect: Quickly fly up to 3 meters. If you're in Worthy Combat, also cast Awe.
~Wingspan (Cleric)~.Name: ~Wingspan (Cleric)~

~Penitence~.Effect:
Make a Check with any Stat against a Unit's Presence Check.
If you pass, it can't cast Healing Spells, do Control Effects or apply On-Roll Effects for 1 minute.
~Penitence~.Notes: Against Epic Monsters, it only last for 2 turns.
~Penitence~.Name: ~Penitence~

~Everlasting Sustenance~.Effect:
You stop the effects of aging on yourself and your companion.
Your companion Levels Up.
~Everlasting Sustenance~.Name: ~Everlasting Sustenance~

~The Clerical Trinity~.Effect:
You have a third Unit beside you that you control, which is another Hero.
Your companion is built like a normal Level 1 Hero, but all its stats are decreased by 1, starts with no separate {Gold}Gold and can not gain Feats.
It always has the same initiative as you and Levels Up only when you Level Up.

Apply the same "soul bond death" rules as your chosen Soulwright Ability at Level 2, and apply the same bonuses to the Stats (or resistances).
~The Clerical Trinity~.Upgrade: For the Quest Masters, note that this companion also counts as a normal Hero for encounter Experience!
~The Clerical Trinity~.Notes:
Come up with a story about why you have your companion and why your god allowed this or gave them to you.
You should now have 3 characters of Levels 1, 3 and 5.
~The Clerical Trinity~.Name: ~The Clerical Trinity~

~Encode Thoughts~.Effect:
You pull a String of Memory or Thoughts (can be visual, auditive, sensory and olphactive) from your own memory.
This String can be up to 1 minute in length.
To view the String, a person can willingly absorb it through the mouth, eyes, nose, etc (corresponding to the type of memories) and visualize the String.
~Encode Thoughts~.Notes:
It is visible to the eye as a magical ribbon-like energy. You can transport this String like you would carry a normal 10x10x10 centimeter object.
The String disappears after being absorbed or if you make another String.
~Encode Thoughts~.Name: ~Encode Thoughts~

~Wraithwalk~.Effect:
You become spectral for 10 seconds (until the start of your next turn).
While spectral, you can move through walls, objects and Units, but not through floors and ceilings.
If the effect doesn't end in an empty space, you are instantly thrown to the nearest empty space and you take 3d4 Pulse Damage.
~Wraithwalk~.Name: ~Wraithwalk~

<Army of Death>.Effect:
All your summons and minions instantly transform into Death Ghouls.
They take their turns on your turn (if they haven't already).
Death Ghouls have 15 Health, 1 in all Stats, 7 meters speed and their attacks deal 1d10 Damage.

Monster.Name: Death Ghoul
Monster.Description: After 1 minute, it transforms back to how it was previously. If your companion ghoul dies, it transforms to how it previously was (with its old Health as well). If other minions ghouls die, they remain dead.

~Attack~.Effect: Melee attack a Unit for 1d10 Damage.

<Army of Death>.Name: <Army of Death>

<Presence of Fear>.Effect:
All enemies within 5 meters must succeed a Presence Check against Your Health Regen or be Feared.
For each Enemy Feared, cast Awe (on anyone).
<Presence of Fear>.Notes: A Feared Unit can only do one Act on its turn (e.g. move, make one attack, use one Ability, etc).
<Presence of Fear>.Name: <Presence of Fear>

<Sanctuary>.Duration: Until the start of your next turn
<Sanctuary>.Effect:
Choose a 6x6 meter area. Cast Awe on all Units there.
No Enemy can willingly enter the area or attack Units inside the area.
<Sanctuary>.Name: <Sanctuary>

Manual Extras: +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +5)
<Stat Bonus 5>.Effect: Gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +5.
<Stat Bonus 5>.Name: <Stat Bonus 5>

<The Covenant>.Effect:
All your other Characters Level Up to Level 10.
Over time, all your Heroes start to resemble you (or your equiavalent if a different gender), gaining more and more of your features until they almost resemble you perfectly, with some small flaws.
Passively, gain +2 Presence and +25% base Max Health.
<The Covenant>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<The Covenant>.Name: <The Covenant>

<High Benediction>.Effect:
You Level Up to Level 13. Another Hero belonging to a different player also Levels Up to Level 11.
Passively, gain +2 Presence and +25% base Health Regen.
<High Benediction>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<High Benediction>.Name: <High Benediction>

<Wrath of the Wight King>.Effect:
You channel your sacremental magic to raise an army of undead.
If there are at least 100 corpses within 100 meters of you, roll 7d20, otherwise roll only 5d20. You raise that many corpses or minions that will fight for you.
You can have up to 250 such minions active at a time, including the ones from Awe for Corpses.
Passively, gain +1 in all Stats.
<Wrath of the Wight King>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.

~Attack~.Effect: Attack an Enemy for 1d4 Damage (Pierce, Slash or Smash).

<Wrath of the Wight King>.Name: <Wrath of the Wight King>

~Evoke~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

You may pick 2 Evocations.
~Evoke~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can change your Evocations inbetween Adventures.
~Evoke~.Name: ~Evoke~

~Flux~.Effect: Choose a Damage Type from the ones listed below. That becomes your {Color('orange' 'Flux')} Type. Some of your Spells's Damage deal that Damage Type (written explicitly on those Spells).
~Flux~.Upgrade:
1. Fire, 2. Cold, 3. Shock, 4. Pulse, 5. Poison, 6. Acid, 7. Divine, 8. Scourge.
You can change your Flux inbetween Adventures.
~Flux~.Name: ~Flux~

~Transfusion~.Effect: Give all your {Mana}Mana to an ally.
~Transfusion~.Name: ~Transfusion~

~Diverge~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Act that targets Unit(s) targets an extra Unit in range per Evoke Point spent, but deals -50% Damage (or Healing if it heals) to the secondary targets.
~Diverge~.Name: ~Diverge~

~Overwhelm~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next offensive Act also Single-Stuns one of the Units hit, for each extra Evoke Point spent
~Overwhelm~.Notes:
You can Single-Stun the same Unit, or a different Unit hit. When increasing the Stun Degree inflicted with an Evoke Point, only increase it for one of the hit Units.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
~Overwhelm~.Name: ~Overwhelm~

~Amplify~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Ability or Attack has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type per Evoke Point spent.
~Amplify~.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.
~Amplify~.Name: ~Amplify~

~Obliterate~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Act that targets Unit(s) deals +1d6 Damage on cast, or +1d4 Healing to the target on cast, per Evoke Point spent.
~Obliterate~.Upgrade: These extra dice can not produce more Evoke Points.
~Obliterate~.Notes: If it heals, it does extra Healing. If it deals Damage, it deals extra Damage. If used with Damage over time effects, the extra Damage only happens when you cast the Spell.
~Obliterate~.Name: ~Obliterate~

~Transpose~.Effect: {Evoke}: Teleport up to 4 meters away per Evoke Point spent.
~Transpose~.Name: ~Transpose~

~Summon Familiar~.Effect:
You have a familiar, shaped directly by your {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} (a small demon, a spirit, etc).
The familiar follows you, has its own personality, and casts ^Eerie Bolt^ automatically if you have Evoke Points.
While with you in Combat, it can't take Damage unless purposefully targeted.
~Summon Familiar~.Upgrade:
It has a number of Skill Points equal to your Level.
It may or may not follow your commands, depending on your relationship.
If it dies or runs away, you can spend 10 minutes to resummon it.
~Summon Familiar~.Notes:
Work with your Quest Master to determine your familiar's look and personality. You may need to work to convince it to do things for you.
The familiar doesn't obey normal Combat rules, and doesn't use Movement or {A}Action Points.

Eerie Bolt.Effect:
Cast automatically and for free, on the same target, after the Warlock targets a Unit within 3 meters.
Can generate an Evoke Point!

~Summon Familiar~.Name: ~Summon Familiar~

~Curse of the Mind~.Duration: Minor curse lasts until end of Adventure
~Curse of the Mind~.Effect:
Choose a Unit. Deal 6d4 Psychic Damage to it and it becomes Single-Stunned.
Apply a ~Combo~ to it.
~Curse of the Mind~.Upgrade: Alternatively, affect it bywith minor curse effects (e.g. is clumsy, stumbles, get pimples, etc), getting -2 on all Checks.
~Curse of the Mind~.Notes:
Be creative with the effects of the minor curse effects!

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
~Curse of the Mind~.Name: ~Curse of the Mind~

~Wyrd Suture~.Effect:
Roll 1d12 - 4. Then choose a Unit.
If it's negative, deal Scourge Damage to it. Otherwise, Heal it.

{Evoke}: +100% Damage or Healing per Evoke Point spent.
~Wyrd Suture~.Name: ~Wyrd Suture~

~Deathfire Wave~.Effect:
Shoot a bolt of deathly fire in a 1x10 meter line. All Units it touches take 1d4 + 1d6 + 1d8 Scourge or Fire Damage (your choice).

{Evoke}: When it hits a wall or the range ends, the bolt continues at an angle you choose for another 1x10 meters. This happens per Evoke Point spent.
~Deathfire Wave~.Notes: The bolt can't hit the same Unit twice. The bolt travels as if you're drawing multiple lines with the same stroke. For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, there will be 3 lines.
~Deathfire Wave~.Name: ~Deathfire Wave~

~Witherwave~.Effect:
Your next {Type} weapon attack deals +50% Damage and applies a ~Combo~.

{Variants}
~Witherwave~.Name: ~Witherwave~

~Soul Drain~.Effect:
Deal 2d6 True Damage to 2 Units.
For each killed, Heal for 4 Health or gain +1 Max Health permanently (your choice).

{Evoke}: Executes non-Epic Units at or below 10% of its Max Health per Evoke Point spent.
~Soul Drain~.Notes:
For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 20% Health. If you spend 3 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 30% Health. And so on.
Both Units take Damage from the same roll.
~Soul Drain~.Name: ~Soul Drain~

~Veinlight~.Effect:
Choose a 3x3 meter area.
All Enemies in the area take 2d6 + 2d8 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage.

{Evoke}: Increase the area by 3 meters in both directions per Evoke Point spent.
~Veinlight~.Notes: For example, for 1 Evoke Point spent the area becomes 6x6 meters. For 2, it becomes 9x9 meters. And so on.
~Veinlight~.Name: ~Veinlight~

~Curse of Lethargy~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of its Turns, it is Slowed.
~Curse of Lethargy~.Name: ~Curse of Lethargy~
~Curse of Lethargy~.Notes: A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.

~Life Sap~.Effect: You can cast Abilties that cost {Mana}Mana by spending 2d6 {Health}Health per 1 {Mana}Mana instead.
~Life Sap~.Upgrade: If you would go Down this way, you still cast the Spell, and go Down immediately after.
~Life Sap~.Name: ~Life Sap~

~Mind Over Matter~.Effect:
You can choose how many Evoke Points you want to spend when spending them.
At any time, you can spend 1 {Mana}Mana to gain 2 Evoke Points.
~Mind Over Matter~.Name: ~Mind Over Matter~

Combat Extras: You have extra Magic Font Spells
~Font Magic~.Effect:
You may select a `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` to pick Spells from.
You get a number of them equal to your Focus.
~Font Magic~.Notes: All Magic Font Spells act like Class Talents. Notes: You can change your Font and Spells inbetween Adventures.
~Font Magic~.Name: ~Font Magic~

~Invoke Kindred~.Effect:
Invoke 3 _Kindred Beings_, each within 10 meters of you. These are creatures themed and shaped to your {Color('magenta' 'Flux')}, which will do your bidding before returning to their original world.

{Evoke}: +1 summon per Evoke Point spent.

Monster.Name: Kindred Being
Monster.Description: Has a 1 Action Point. Takes its Turn at the end of your Turn.

~Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage, or use an Item or Default Ability.

~Invoke Kindred~.Name: ~Invoke Kindred~

~Curse of Frailty~.Effect:
A Unit you can see becomes special-Frail: it takes +50% Damage the next time it takes Damage from an ally.

{Evoke}: +50% extra Damage per Evoke Point spent.
~Curse of Frailty~.Name: ~Curse of Frailty~
~Curse of Frailty~.Notes: A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.

~Gateway~.Duration: Lasts until end of Combat, or 10 real minutes
~Gateway~.Effect:
Open a _gateway_, and another paired one in a location you can see.
Units and projectiles can go through a gateway and appear through the other.

You can cast this with 0 {A}Action Points and no Cooldown by spending 1 {Mana}Mana.
~Gateway~.Upgrade: The gateway does not have a direction - projectiles going one way come out the same way. Units have Line of Sight through the gates, and their Range counts as if the two gates are connected (obviously).
~Gateway~.Name: ~Gateway~

~Curse of the Plague~.Effect:
Choose a Unit and roll 5d6 to see its _death threshold_.
When it gets to that amount or less Health, you can use a free Reaction to kill it.
Then the curse spreads with the same _death threshold_ to all Units within 2 meters of it.
~Curse of the Plague~.Upgrade: Wherever the plague goes, it kills small plants, insects, and rots wood and rusts metal. It also makes fertile soil infertile, turns textile and paper materials into dust, and decays food and poisons water.
~Curse of the Plague~.Notes: The death threshold can stack from multiple Curses of the Plague! Ask the Quest Master whether a Unit should die from the curse.
~Curse of the Plague~.Name: ~Curse of the Plague~

~Torrent~.Effect:
Choose a Unit. Deal 1d4 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage or apply a ~Combo~ to it.

Then do it again for each Evoke Point you have.
~Torrent~.Name: ~Torrent~

~Overloading Evocation~.Effect: Cast 2 Evocation Talents you Know, combined, with the same Evoke Points applied to both.
~Overloading Evocation~.Name: ~Overloading Evocation~

<Blood Pact>.Effect: This turn, you deal +50% Damage to other Units. Every time you deal 10 or more Damage in one instance, take 5 Psychic Damage.
<Blood Pact>.Name: <Blood Pact>

<Higher Evoke>.Effect: You start each Combat with +1 Evoke Point.
<Higher Evoke>.Name: <Higher Evoke>

~As Fate Willt~.Effect: Gain 2 Evoke Points, then cast a random Evocation spending all your Evoke Points.
SingleTable: 1. Diverge
2. Overwhelm
3. Amplify
4. Obliterate
5. Transpose
~As Fate Willt~.Notes: You can roll 1d6 and reroll on 6.
~As Fate Willt~.Name: ~As Fate Willt~

~Master of Curses~.Effect: Your Curses that are empowered by at least 1 Evoke Point cast as if empowered by +1 Evoke Point.
~Master of Curses~.Name: ~Master of Curses~

~Aura of Ruin~.Requirement: Only usable the moment Combat starts
~Aura of Ruin~.Effect: Reduce the Max Health of all enemies by 10%.
~Aura of Ruin~.Name: ~Aura of Ruin~

~Evoke Entropy~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 ~minimum or~ maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

Additionally, you have an extra Talent tier for special Evocations.
~Evoke Entropy~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can pick one for free Evocation at Level 1, and get more like you would normally get extra Class Talents (e.g. with the extra Known Talents from Intelligence, if above 0).
~Evoke Entropy~.Name: ~Evoke Entropy~

~Consumption~.Effect:
Consume one of your known Abilities until the end of the Adventure to gain 1 Evoke Point.
You can't cast it until the end of the Adventure.
~Consumption~.Name: ~Consumption~

~Inward Invocation~.Effect: Use when ^you^ take minimum or maximum Damage from a dice attack. Gain 1 Evoke Point.
~Inward Invocation~.Name: ~Inward Invocation~

~Borrowed Power~.Effect:
You each Adventure with 2 Evoke Points.
You age 12 times as rapidly.
~Borrowed Power~.Name: ~Borrowed Power~

~Blood Dividend~.Range: 5 meters from you to healed Unit
~Blood Dividend~.Effect:
Your next weapon attack or Spell deals -50% Damage, but heals another Unit for the Damage dealt.
Then it applies a ~Combo~ to one of them.
~Blood Dividend~.Name: ~Blood Dividend~

~Contract of Hunger~.Effect:
At the start of each Combat, get a random _Contract_. While active, you gain a buff. When broken, you suffer a punishment and the _Contract_ ends this Combat.

{Purple(Payout)}: Gain 1 Evoke Point each Turn
{Red(Punishment)}: Become Exhausted
SingleTable: 1. You shall choose a Warlock Ability and cast it every Turn!
2. You shall always target the alive Unit ^you^ have Damaged the most (choose if tied)!
3. You shall never end your Turn without having spent Mana or Evoke Points!
~Contract of Hunger~.Notes:
You always know which Unit you have Damaged the most.
An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.
~Contract of Hunger~.Name: ~Contract of Hunger~

~Contract of Obsidian~.Effect:
At the start of each Combat, get a random _Contract_. While active, you gain a buff. When broken, you suffer a punishment and the _Contract_ ends this Combat.

{Purple(Payout)}: You have doubled Range and gain double the Evoke Points from Evoke.
{Red(Punishment)}: Become Exhausted
SingleTable: 1. You shall never use Movement!
2. You shall never roll minimum on on all dice per Act!
3. You shall always end Turns at least 5 meters away from where you started!
~Contract of Obsidian~.Name: ~Contract of Obsidian~
~Contract of Obsidian~.Notes: An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.

~Contract of Sacrifice~.Effect:
At the start of each Combat, get a random _Contract_. While active, you gain a buff. When broken, you suffer a punishment and the _Contract_ ends this Combat.

{Purple(Payout)}: You start with +1 {Mana}Mana and +1 Evoke Point.
{Red(Punishment)}: Take 2d8 Damage.
SingleTable: 1. You shall take at least 3d8 Damage this Combat!
2. You shall never target a Unit you've already targeted with an attack or Ability this Combat!
3. You shall never use the same attack or Ability a second time this Combat!
~Contract of Sacrifice~.Name: ~Contract of Sacrifice~

~Tome of Evocations~.Effect: You have a special Tome that contains all Evocations and Warlock Talents that have an {Evoke} effect. While carrying the Tome, you know all of them.
~Tome of Evocations~.Notes: Requires spending 1 day and 100 {Gold}Gold to write the Tome, as dictated to you by a higher power.
~Tome of Evocations~.Name: ~Tome of Evocations~

~Congregation of Power~.Effect: +1 Spellpower for each Evoke Point you have.
~Congregation of Power~.Upgrade: Note that Evocations and other Abilities spend the Evoke Points immediately when cast (e.g. Diverge followed by Hail won't benefit from the extra Damage). However, Abilities that themselves consume Evoke Points do benefit from the extra Damage when cast with Evoke Points, like Deathfire Wave or Soul Drain.
~Congregation of Power~.Name: ~Congregation of Power~

~Reabsorption~.Effect: After you use an Ability empowered by at least 2 Evoke Points (from Evocations or itself), gain 1 Evoke Point.
~Reabsorption~.Name: ~Reabsorption~

~Forebearer's Magic~.Effect: You start each Adventure 2 extra {Mana}Mana that doesn't regenerate or disappear after Combats.
~Forebearer's Magic~.Name: ~Forebearer's Magic~

~Hemomancy~.Effect: Whenever you take Damage on your Turn, gain 1 Evoke Point.
~Hemomancy~.Name: ~Hemomancy~

Extras: You may have any number of Contracts
~More Contracts~.Effect: You may select as many Level 7 Talents as you like. All apply.
~More Contracts~.Name: ~More Contracts~

<Final Word>.Effect: When you have exactly 1 {Mana}Mana, and you cast a Spell that cost 1 {Mana}Mana, that Spell casts twice (for free).
<Final Word>.Notes: This is akin to casting the Spell again for 0 {A}Action Points without spending {Mana}Mana (not necessarily on the same target).
<Final Word>.Name: <Final Word>

~Improved Evocations~.Effect: You can always cast 2 Evocations simultaneously, using the same Evoke Points.
~Improved Evocations~.Name: ~Improved Evocations~

~Finger of Obliteration~.Effect:
Deal 12d12 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage to a Unit you can see.
If it dies, regain 1 {Mana}Mana and its corpse disintegrates.
~Finger of Obliteration~.Name: ~Finger of Obliteration~

<Invoke Old God>.Effect:
You bring forth into the mortal realm a manifestation of your source of power - an old god from the `Pets and Animals page$/Other/PetsAndAnimals`.
You do not control it - it has its own Turn in combat with a Setback of 1d4 and possesses its own will. What will you compromise to forcefully drag an unknowable entity into the mortal plane?
Also, passively, you gain +2 Focus and Presence, and you automatically pass all Impossible Focus Checks (requiring at least 25).
<Invoke Old God>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Invoke Old God>.Name: <Invoke Old God>

<The Dark Ritual>.Effect:
Spend any amount of {Mana}Mana. Your next Spell has +50% Damage, Heal, area diameter and range for each {Mana}Mana spent.
After that, restore all your {Mana}Mana.
<The Dark Ritual>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<The Dark Ritual>.Name: <The Dark Ritual>

~Second Wind~.Effect: Gain +1 {A}Action Point and a ~Combo~. This Turn, all your Acts miss if they roll 1 on any of the dice.
~Second Wind~.Downside: Only usable as your first Act on a Turn.
~Second Wind~.Name: ~Second Wind~

~War Fierce~.Effect:
Once per Turn, certain attacks may become {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}. {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attacks deal +1d4 Damage.
Choose your Fierce Craft from below!
~War Fierce~.Upgrade: You may change your Fierce Craft inbetween Adventures.
~War Fierce~.Name: ~War Fierce~

~Command - Resist~.Effect:
Use when another Ally would take Damage.
They don't take the Damage now. They take it at the end of their Turn.
~Command - Resist~.Notes: You can use dice and put them on their Hero Sheet to track that they will take the Damage later.
~Command - Resist~.Name: ~Command - Resist~

<Ruining Throw>.Effect: Throw a weapon at a target and attack it (without Throwing penalties and ignoring Cover).
<Ruining Throw>.Downside: TODO - Make this more interesting. Also it has an _Upgrade_ that makes the weapon return.
<Ruining Throw>.Name: <Ruining Throw>

~Raise and Roil~.Effect: Single-Stun all Enemies you have hit with your Fierce Craft this Combat.
~Raise and Roil~.Combo: A Comboed Unit affected is also Slowed.
~Raise and Roil~.Name: ~Raise and Roil~
~Raise and Roil~.Notes:
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.

~Command - Charge~.Effect: Choose a direction. You and all Allies may move up to 3 meters in that direction.
~Command - Charge~.Name: ~Command - Charge~

~Rending Edge~.Requirement: Only works if target can bleed
~Rending Edge~.Effect:
Make a {Type} {A}Action Point weapon attack. It deals -50% Damage, but applies a Bleed effect on the target.
While Bleeding, it takes {Amount} True Damage at the end of your Turns.
~Rending Edge~.Notes: Remember which enemies have how much Bleed.
~Rending Edge~.Name: ~Rending Edge~

~Whirlwind~.Upgrade: The Ability is Whirlwind if a melee weapon is equipped, or Rain Death if a ranged weapon is equipped.
~Whirlwind~.Notes:
Each rolled die ^must^ be assigned to a Unit.
The Damage type depends on the weapon currently equipped. Doesn't apply weapon effects (the weapon only matters for the Damage type).

Variants.Name: Rain Death
Variants.Area: in a chosen 4x4 meter area (5 meter range to the edge).

~Whirlwind~.Name: ~Whirlwind~

~Break Mountains~.Effect:
Pick up an object 1x1x1 to 2x2x2 meters in size, and Slam it 6d6 meters in any direction.
{CriticalStrike} for each max die rolled, deal +1d6 Damage and, if it's an object, it breaks on impact!
~Break Mountains~.Upgrade: You can instead pick up an enemy and Slam it a number of meters equal to half the rolled dice.
~Break Mountains~.Notes: When something Slammed it hits a Unit, they both takes Damage equal to the number of meters left.
~Break Mountains~.Name: ~Break Mountains~

<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Effect:
When you get this, choose a Font Spell that costs 1 {Mana}Mana from any Magic Font, up to your Level.
That Ability becomes a ^physical version of itself^: instead of using magic to cast that Spell, you use your body, weapons, or tools! Be creative with how it works!
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Upgrade: The Damage of that Spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage). Be creative, come up with a description of how it works!
You can change this Ability inbetween Adventures.
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Name: <MIGHT OVER MAGIC>

~Flurry of Blades~.Effect: Your next {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attack has {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} applied twice, and also deals the {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} Damage to all other Enemies within 2 meters of the main target.
~Flurry of Blades~.Name: ~Flurry of Blades~

~Command - Patience~.Effect: Count the Round number. A Unit you can see gains that many Shieldings that can block 3 Damage each.
~Command - Patience~.Name: ~Command - Patience~

<Quick Maneuvers>.Effect: Immediately after you make a weapon attack, choose one effect to apply.
SingleTable: Freely move up to 2 meters
Taunt a Unit you can see (that can see you)
Slam the target 1 meter (any direction)
<Quick Maneuvers>.Notes: Taunted means its next offensive Act has Cover if it's not on you.
<Quick Maneuvers>.Name: <Quick Maneuvers>

~Bull Rush~.Effect: If you move at least 3 meters in a straight line and then Attack a Unit in front of you on the same line, the Attack gains +1 for every 3 meters moved in that line.
~Bull Rush~.Notes: Works if mounted or if using Abilities that dash or jump (in a straight line), but teleporting interrupts this.
~Bull Rush~.Name: ~Bull Rush~

~Colossal Strikes~.Effect:
Each _consecutive_ {Type} weapon attack or single-target Ability on the same Unit deals {Amount} to both you and the target for each previous consecutive attack you made on that Unit.
~Click on the Icon to select which variant you want to have have!~
~Colossal Strikes~.Combo: Any of your attacks consume the Combo to not Damage you!
~Colossal Strikes~.Notes:
Consecutive attacks mean that you haven't attacked another target. For example, say you attack a Goblin this Turn. Then you attack it again, and this attack deals +1d4 to you and the Goblin. Next Turn, you attack the Goblin again and deal +2d4 Damage, to you and it. If you now attack a different target, that consecutiveness resets back to baseline (no extra Damage). Even if you attack the Goblin again, you have to repeat the cycle.
Moving or using non-single-target Abilities does _not_ break the consecutiveness.
~Colossal Strikes~.Name: ~Colossal Strikes~

~Weaponmaster~.Effect: If your {Type} {A}Action Point weapon attack can't Critical Strike, it gains the following effect.
~Weaponmaster~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you rolled maximum on at least one die, deal {Amount} Damage.
~Weaponmaster~.Name: ~Weaponmaster~

<Run Towards Glory>.Effect:
When Worthy Combat starts, a _Glory Point_ appears directly behind the furthermost Enemy from you.
The first time you reach the _Glory Point_, Heal for 1d10.
<Run Towards Glory>.Notes: The Glory Point is just a space/zone.
<Run Towards Glory>.Name: <Run Towards Glory>

~Thicker Than Water~.Requirement: Can only trigger in Worthy Combat
~Thicker Than Water~.Effect: Whenever you take Damage on your Turn, deal 50% of that to the last Unit you attacked as Fire Damage.
~Thicker Than Water~.Name: ~Thicker Than Water~

~Lead Commander~.Requirement: Can only trigger in Worthy Combat
~Lead Commander~.Effect: Whenever you use a Command Ability, give yourself or an affected Unit one Shielding that can block 1d6 Damage.
~Lead Commander~.Name: ~Lead Commander~

~Execute~.Effect:
Your next weapon attack kills the target if it leaves it with at most 1 {Health}Health.
If it dies, increase that number by +1 permanently.
~Execute~.Notes: Remind the Quest Master about this Ability when you think the enemy should die.
~Execute~.Name: ~Execute~

<Opportunity Attack>.Effect:
Use when an enemy within 1 meter moves away from you or makes a Ranged attack.
Make a {1AP} weapon attack on it.
<Opportunity Attack>.Upgrade: You can quickly equip a {1AP} weapon and attack with it.
<Opportunity Attack>.Name: <Opportunity Attack>

~Chainwaver~.Effect: Slam a Unit 1d8 meters towards another Unit that isn't near it.
~Chainwaver~.Downside: At the end of the Turn you used this, it goes on Cooldown until the next Combat.
~Chainwaver~.Notes: You can Slam yourself! Or another Unit into you. You can use this as many times as you want, but all uses must be on the same Turn.
~Chainwaver~.Name: ~Chainwaver~

~Division and Conquest~.Effect:
Choose a Unit within your {Type} ^weapon^'s Range and spend all your remaining {A}Action Points.
For each spent, Damage them for {Amount} (weapon's Damage Type) and inflict a random Control Effect from below:
~Division and Conquest~.Upgrade: 1. Lagged, 2.Deafened, 3. Dazed, 4.Single-Stunned, 5. Slowed, 6. Blinded, 7. Crippled, 8. Silenced, 9. Rooted, 10. Frailed.
~Division and Conquest~.Notes:
Epic Units can't be Silenced or Rooted, and instead become Deafened or Lagged respectively.
A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -100% Damage/Healing.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.
~Division and Conquest~.Name: ~Division and Conquest~

<Intercept>.Effect:
Dash towards a Unit.
Slam it away from you a number of meters equal to how many meters you just dashed.
<Intercept>.Name: <Intercept>

<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Effect:
When you get this, choose ~two~ Class Talents that cost 1 {Mana}Mana from (any Specialization of) Cleric, Mage or Warlock, up to your Level.
Those Abilities become ^physical versions of themselves^: instead of using magic to cast that spell, you use your body/weapons/tools!
<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Upgrade: The Damage of that Spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage). Be creative, come up with a description of how it works!
You can change this Ability inbetween Adventures.
<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Name: <MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>

~Command - Focus Fire~.Effect:
Choose a target and spend any number of {A}Action Points.
For each spent, command another Ally (all different) in your party to make a 1 {A}Action Point Act on that target.
~Command - Focus Fire~.Name: ~Command - Focus Fire~

~Groundbreaker~.Effect: When falling, your impact makes a crater a number of meters in diameter equal to the fallen distance, 2 meters deep at the edges, and Damages all other Units caught in the crater for your Falling Damage taken.
~Groundbreaker~.Notes: Only triggers if you take Falling Damage.

~Heavenbreaker~.Effect:
Spend any number of Action Points.
For each spent, Slam yourself 1d8 meters upward.
~Heavenbreaker~.Upgrade: If you went above 10 meters up into the air, you land at the start of your next Turn.

~Groundbreaker~.Name: ~Groundbreaker~

~Breathing Technique~.Effect: You can breathe underwater for up to 1d20 minutes and swim at your normal speed.
~Breathing Technique~.Name: ~Breathing Technique~

<Overthrow>.Effect: When you Slam a Unit into a wall, it becomes Single-Stunned instead of taking Damage.
<Overthrow>.Name: <Overthrow>
<Overthrow>.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~Command - Formation~.Effect: All Allies within 10 meters immediately move to form one of these formations with you:
List: Line: line with no space between Units!
V: V with no space between Units!
Box: equilateral square, extra Units in the middle!
~Command - Formation~.Name: ~Command - Formation~

<Into the Fray>.Effect:
When Combat starts, determine which side is your Ally Side and which is the Enemy Side of the battlefield (the line is drawn in the middle).
While in the Ally Side, Second Wind heals you for 2d6 Health.
While in the Enemy Side, your {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attacks have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
<Into the Fray>.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.
<Into the Fray>.Name: <Into the Fray>

<Expert Maneuvers>.Effect: Immediately after you make a weapon attack, choose one effect to apply.
SingleTable: Freely move up to 1d4 meters
Taunt up to 1d4 Units you can see
Slam the target 1d4 meter (any direction)
<Expert Maneuvers>.Notes: Taunted means its next offensive Act has Cover if it's not on you.
<Expert Maneuvers>.Name: <Expert Maneuvers>

<Command - Attack>.Effect:
An ally immediately makes an Act that takes 2 {A}Action Points (can spend {Mana}Mana, Cooldowns, etc on it, as if it were on its Turn).
You can use this at any point, before or after someone does an Act.
^You^ roll all the dice for this Act.
<Command - Attack>.Name: <Command - Attack>

~Unstoppable Juggernaut~.Effect: Whenever ^you^ kill a Worthy Enemy, take 1d6 Damage and gain +1 {A}Action Point this Turn.
~Unstoppable Juggernaut~.Name: ~Unstoppable Juggernaut~

<Row Control>.Effect: Your Slams deal +50% Damage. Your pushes can become Slams.
<Row Control>.Name: <Row Control>

<Supreme Tactician>.Effect:
Use after you manually use a Command Ability you haven't used this Combat.
Recast the previous Command Ability you used.
<Supreme Tactician>.Notes:
If it requires spending {A}Action Points, consider it spends 1 {A}Action Point for free.
Does not trigger on triggered Commands (e.g. from Phalanx Discipline).
<Supreme Tactician>.Name: <Supreme Tactician>

<Gravetaker>.Effect: Grab a Unit and SLAAAMM it into the ground 1d8 meters + 1d8 meters for each {A}Action Point you spent this Combat (including this Ability's {A}Action Points).
<Gravetaker>.Name: <Gravetaker>

~Meat Grinder~.Effect: You Heal for all the {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} extra Damage done.
~Meat Grinder~.Upgrade: {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} Mass Damage done Heal you for 50% of the total Damage done instead.
~Meat Grinder~.Name: ~Meat Grinder~

~Preparing For War~.Effect: Until the end of your next Turn, your {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attacks apply the {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} Damage thrice.
~Preparing For War~.Name: ~Preparing For War~

~ABSOLUTE UNIT~.Effect: THIS TURN, YOU DEAL +50% DAMAGE _(except to yourself)_!
~ABSOLUTE UNIT~.Name: ~ABSOLUTE UNIT~

~Phalanx Discipline~.Effect: After you do the same Ability or weapon attack 3 times on the same Turn, freely cast a Command Ability you have used this Combat.
~Phalanx Discipline~.Notes: If it requires spending {A}Action Points, consider it spends 1 {A}Action Point for free.
~Phalanx Discipline~.Name: ~Phalanx Discipline~

~Third Wind~.Effect: You have +1 {A}Action Point each Turn, but you can no longer spend {Mana}Mana.
~Third Wind~.Name: ~Third Wind~

<Perfect Strike>.Effect:
Your next weapon attack this Turn deals +300% Damage. If it kills the target, overkill Damage is dealt to all enemies within 3 meters of the main target.
Also, passively, you gain +2 Instinct and you are immune to monster _weapon effects_ (e.g. critical strikes).
<Perfect Strike>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Perfect Strike>.Name: <Perfect Strike>

<Master Tactician>.Effect:
Gain +4 Max Health and +1 Damage on all attacks for every 3 sessions the Campaign has progressed.
From now on, at the end of every session, gain +4 Max Health and +1 Damage on all attacks.
Also, passively, gain +2 Focus and you know the Abilities and strategies of all enemies you encounter.
<Master Tactician>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Master Tactician>.Name: <Master Tactician>

<Greatwielder>.Effect:
You can wield Two-Handed weapons, one in each hand.
Attacks like this take only a 1 {A}Action Point and count as One-Handed weapon attacks but deal -2 Damage.
While dual wielding Two-Handed weapons, if any Ability tells you to perform an attack with a Two-Handed and the ability costs 2 {A}Action Points, it costs only 1 {A}Action Point.
Also, passively, gain +1 Might and +1 Instinct.
<Greatwielder>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Greatwielder>.Name: <Greatwielder>

~Hex Magic~.Effect:
After you cast a Spell, you can expend 5 Health to force it to _echo_.
You can expend 3 Health to add or subtract 1d6 from any other Unit's roll (not yours).
~Hex Magic~.Notes:
The QM might not roll Damage for monsters, and instead take the average - even if they take the average, that counts as a roll.
Keep in mind you only have 1 Reaction per Round.
~Hex Magic~.Name: ~Hex Magic~

~Day Night Cycle~.Effect:
You are always in either {Orange('Solar')} or {Purple('Lunar')} stance, based on the _period of day_ (see gray text).

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: you have +3 Health Regen and can cast any Ability Shapeshifted.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: once per attack/Ability/animal feature, when you roll maximum on a die, roll one more.
~Day Night Cycle~.Notes:
{Orange('Solar Stance')} period is from 6:00 to 18:00. {Purple('Lunar Stance')} period is from 18:00 to 6:00.
Your stance may change during combat. {Orange('Solar Stance')} Health Regen applies if you end the combat in Solar Stance.
If the campaign setting somehow skewes the day/night cycle, the Quest Master should find a different criterion to determine day/night.
~Day Night Cycle~.Name: ~Day Night Cycle~

~Another Effect~.Effect: Each Day Ability increases your Damage and Healing by 1. After triggering 50%, switch to Night.
~Another Effect~.Name: ~Another Effect~

~Moonsun Fire~.Effect: {Orange('Solar Stance')}: Damage an enemy for 1d4 + ^Any Stat^ (Fire), then Heal an ally for the same amount.
~Moonsun Fire~.Name: ~Moonsun Fire~

~Venin Shot~.Effect:
A target takes 1d8 + ^Presence^ Poison Damage.
The _next time_ it takes damage from a weapon, it takes an extra 1d8 Poison Damage.
~Venin Shot~.Combo: The next time Damage happens now instead.
~Venin Shot~.Name: ~Venin Shot~

~Burnished Flames~.Effect: Deal 1d12 + ^Presence^ Damage (Fire if {Orange('Solar')}, Scourge if {Purple('Lunar')}) and apply a ~Combo~.
~Burnished Flames~.Name: ~Burnished Flames~

~Curse of Locusts~.Effect:
A swarm of locusts appears and chases a Unit you can see for 1 minute.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Whenever it makes a Move Act, it takes 1d4 Poison Damage.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: For every Act not spent Moving, it takes 1d4 Acid Damage
~Curse of Locusts~.Name: ~Curse of Locusts~

~Effigy of Warding~.Cooldown: Up to 1 effigy placed at a time
~Effigy of Warding~.Effect:
Place an effigy in a space. It triggers an effect when a Unit comes within 2 meters of it:
If Enemy, it takes +50% Damage next time it takes Damage.
If Ally, it takes -50% Damage next time it takes Damage.
~Effigy of Warding~.Upgrade: Does not trigger if the Unit was already there.
~Effigy of Warding~.Name: ~Effigy of Warding~

~Solunar Psyche Blast~.Effect:
A Unit takes 3d6 Psychic Damage and:

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: it becomes Blinded or Silenced (your choice).

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: An ally within 3 meters is healed for 50% of the Damage dealt.
~Solunar Psyche Blast~.Name: ~Solunar Psyche Blast~
~Solunar Psyche Blast~.Notes:
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.

~Improved Moonsun Fire~.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Damage ~and Root~ an enemy for 1d4 + ^Any Stat^ (Fire), then Heal an ally for the same amount.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Damage ~and Single-Stun~ or Heal a Unit for ~2d4~ + ^Any Stat^ (Pulse) and apply a ~Combo~. The next ~Combo~ on that Unit triggers twice!
~Improved Moonsun Fire~.Name: ~Improved Moonsun Fire~
~Improved Moonsun Fire~.Notes:
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.

<Daybreak-Nightfall>.Effect: When you pass from day to night and viceversa, roll 1d4 and gain one of these boons.
SingleTable: 1. Regain 5 Health
2. Your next Shapeshift costs 0 Mana
3. Your next Spell costs -1 Action Point
4. Regain 1 Mana
<Daybreak-Nightfall>.Name: <Daybreak-Nightfall>

<Forced Eclipse>.Effect:
By weather-wight and star-song, I bid the sun forth and call the moon to reign!
Force 1 minute of artificial day or night in a 1km area around you.
<Forced Eclipse>.Upgrade: This can reset the Cooldown of Moonsun Fire's, once when it happens, and again when it ends.
<Forced Eclipse>.Notes: Nothing happens if used with Equinox.
<Forced Eclipse>.Name: <Forced Eclipse>

~Love and Lust~.Effect:
At the end of the Adventure, if most of your time was spent in a certain stance this Adventure, gain a permanent bonus:

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Gain +2 Skill Points.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Gain an extra positive Quirk.
~Love and Lust~.Upgrade: These effects are permanent, even after you no longer have this Talent.
~Love and Lust~.Name: ~Love and Lust~

<Voodoo Magic>.Effect:
A Unit within 6 meters makes a Presence Check.
If it fails, it takes 2d6 Psychic Damage at the start of your every turn for 1 minute, and for its next turn, you can choose that enemy's Acts as long as it would seem reasonable to that enemy (decide with your QM).
Epic Monsters can not be controlled; they only take the Damage.
<Voodoo Magic>.Notes: For example, you can make a goblin run or recklessly attack one of your party members. But you can't make a guard jump off a cliff, because that's not what it would normally do.
<Voodoo Magic>.Name: <Voodoo Magic>

<Corpseblast>.Effect:
Use the moment a Worthy Unit dies.
Explode the corpse, dealing 1d4 Poison Damage to all Units near it.
Heal for the Damage dealt.
<Corpseblast>.Name: <Corpseblast>

<Blood Brew>.Effect:
You spend 10 minutes creating a strange splashable brew made from your own blood, with a random effect.
The brew can be splashed (1 {A}Action Point) onto a Unit (at 3 meters range).
When you create it, roll 1d4 to determine its effect.
You are immune to Blood Brews.
<Blood Brew>.Notes: The brews lose their effect at the end of the Adventure. Acid and Muck ignore real Cover.

Values: Target takes 1d8 Damage and becomes Blinded
Deals 1d12 Damage in a 5x5 area centered on the target, and a Toxic Gas cloud forms there.

<Blood Brew>.Name: <Blood Brew>

<Bone Mass>.Effect:
Declare a square area with a diameter equal to the Health spent.
Sharp bones grow from the area (occupying 1x1 meters each).
When a Unit steps on a Sharp Bone, it directly takes 1d8 Pierce Damage and loses 1 meter of its remaining speed.
The bone then shatters.
<Bone Mass>.Name: <Bone Mass>

<Star Fall>.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Heal a Unit for 6d12.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Damage a Unit for 6d10 True Damage.
<Star Fall>.Name: <Star Fall>

~Eclipsis Penumbrae~.Effect: For 1 hour, you are both in {Orange('Solar Stance')} and {Purple('Lunar Stance')}. Both effects apply.
~Eclipsis Penumbrae~.Name: ~Eclipsis Penumbrae~

~Zodiac Alignment~.Effect:
Declare a 4x4 meter area.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Deal Fire Damage to all Units caught equal to the number of empty spaces in the area.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Declare 1 animal feature. Shapeshift all Units caught into an animal with that feature for their next Turn.
~Zodiac Alignment~.Notes: The Damage is dealt all at once, not 1 by 1. Shapeshifted Units can not do their regular Abilities and can't cancel the effect. They remain Shapeshifted until the end of their (next) Turn.
~Zodiac Alignment~.Name: ~Zodiac Alignment~

~Consummation~.Effect:
