Use your tools to conduct a scientific experiment on a person (even yourself).
They get {Brown('-1 Presence')} but get a random upgrade permanently.
If used on yourself, you gain an extra +1 Health.
SingleTable: 1. The experiment fails and nothing else happens
2. +1 Might and +2 Max Health and veins glow in the dark
3. +1 Instinct and +0.5 Initiative and skin tints to a color
4. +1 Focus and +1 Skill Point and eyes change color
5. +4 Health Regen and the inability to feel pain
6. +1 Health, Health Regen and Movement Speed, and +0.5 Initiative
~Gene Editing~.Notes: These changes are kept even if you change this Talent. The values do ^not^ exceed the Stat Limit. {StatLimit}
~Gene Editing~.Name: ~Gene Editing~

~Mechanical Precision~.Effect: Your next attack, if it's with the same metal weapon as the previous attack, deals exactly the same base weapon Damage (and you do not roll those dice).
~Mechanical Precision~.Notes:
Same Damage as after the attack's final Damage roll from the base weapon.
This attack does not trigger Critical Strikes.
If your last Gun attack dealt 11 Damage, use this and your next Gun attack will deal exactly 11 Damage.
~Mechanical Precision~.Name: ~Mechanical Precision~

~Spell Cartridge~.Effect:
Spend 2d6 {Health}Health to create a special _Spell Cartridge_.
An Ally (or you) can cast a non-Healing Spell on the _Cartridge_, which absorbs it.
The _Cartridge_ can be fired from a weapon with 1 {A}Action Point (the Range becomes that weapon's Range), and then is destroyed.
~Spell Cartridge~.Notes: Spells that can Heal can't be cast on Cartridges.
~Spell Cartridge~.Name: ~Spell Cartridge~

<Reforge Weapon>.Effect: You reforge a weapon to provide 2 from the following benefits:
<Reforge Weapon>.Upgrade: Reforging it again changes the benefit.
SingleTable: +1 Damage (if One-Handed)
+1d4 Damage (if Two-Handed)
+1 Movement Speed while wielding it
Damage becomes Fire or Shock
Wielder starts Combat with a 1d6 Shielding.
<Reforge Weapon>.Name: <Reforge Weapon>

Popup.Message: Once the mask is attached, remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).

~Iron Mask~.Effect:
Spend 150 {Gold}Gold to craft a special _mask_ that can be permanently attached to one's face.

Once attached, the wearer permanently get {Brown('-1 Presence')}, +8 Max Health, +2 Range on all Abilities and attacks, they are immune to being Blinded.
~Iron Mask~.Name: ~Iron Mask~
~Iron Mask~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Force Field~.Range: 5 meters to any part of the field
~Force Field~.Effect:
Immediately raise a thin, 3-meter wide force field.
Any missile passing through the force field get -50% Damage.
~Force Field~.Upgrade: Units can't pass through the field, but it can be deliberately destroyed with a 1 {A}Action Point.
~Force Field~.Name: ~Force Field~

~Reactor Beam~.Effect:
Passively, you may select a `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` to cast Spells from.

Steal 1 or more {Mana}Mana from an Ally within 3 meters.
Using that {Mana}Mana, cast any Spell from your Font up to your Level (spending {A}Action Points as normal).
~Reactor Beam~.Notes: You can change your Font inbetween Adventures.
~Reactor Beam~.Name: ~Reactor Beam~

~Biological Study~.Effect:
Choose an Enemy type you can see. Guess one of its Stats (you choose which).
If you were right, your next real weapon attack or Spell cast against it deals extra Damage equal to your _absolute_ Presence.
If you were wrong, lose Health equal to your _absolute_ Presence.
~Biological Study~.Notes:
You can't guess the same Stat twice on the same Unit type, ever.
For example, if you guess correctly twice, your next 2 attacks or Spells deal extra Damage against it.
Don't cheat by looking at the monsters! The Quest Master may ban this Talent for players they suspect are cheating or have too much previous knowledge.
~Biological Study~.Name: ~Biological Study~

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).

<Reforge Armor>.Effect: You reforge a set of body armor to provide 1 of the following benefits:
SingleTable: +4 Health
+2 Health Regen
+1 Movement Speed
+3 Initiative
-50% Damage Taken of a chosen non-physical Damage Type
<Reforge Armor>.Upgrade: An armor can only be reforged twice, to have up to 2 different benefits.
<Reforge Armor>.Notes:
After reforging twice, you can keep reforging an armor to change one of its benefits to a different one.
A reforged armor can't have 2 of the same Reforge Armor benefit at a time.
<Reforge Armor>.Name: <Reforge Armor>

~Give In~.Effect: Gain a number of {A}Action Points equal to your _absolute_ Presence.
~Give In~.Notes: E.g. if your Presence is -2, you gain 2 {A}Action Points.
~Give In~.Name: ~Give In~

<Create Golem>.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).
<Create Golem>.Effect:
Permanently get {Brown('-1 Presence')} and -1 Health Regen and craft a Golem that does your bidding.

It has 1 {A}Action Point and takes its Turn on the same Turn as you. It has the Attack Ability, but you need to choose the material it's made out of.
<Create Golem>.Upgrade: Each additional Golem you craft takes -2 Health Regen more than the previous.
<Create Golem>.Notes:
If the Golem is destroyed, you can spend 10 minutes to repair it. You can change its type between Adventures.
The Golem can be stored as a smaller version of itself that expands at the beginning of the Combat, or when thrown somewhere for 1 {A}Action Point.

~Attack~.Effect:
{Brown('Clay')} {CriticalStrike}: if you rolled 6, Single-Stun the target.
{Brown('Flesh')} {CriticalStrike}: if you rolled 6, +1d6 Damage.
{Brown('Metal')} {CriticalStrike}: if you rolled 6, deal the Damage to all Units near the target.

~Effect~.Effect:
{Brown('Clay:')} Enemies ending their Turn near the Clay Golem are Slowed.
{Brown('Flesh:')} Instead of attacking, Slam a Unit 1d6 meters towards the Golem (5 meters range).
{Brown('Metal:')} Allies within 1 meter of the Metal Golem have Cover from Ranged attacks.

<Create Golem>.Name: <Create Golem>

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab.

~Body Augmentation~.Effect:
Perform a surgical augmentation to replace one of your biological limbs with a mechanized, gear-driven prosthesis.
Get {Brown('-1 Presence')} permanently.
Gain +2 Health and +1 in Might (if arm) or +1 Instinct (if leg).
The total extra Might or Instinct can exceed your Stat Limit by up to 1 per limb replaced.
~Body Augmentation~.Notes:
With 2 arms and 2 legs, you can have +2 Might and Instinct over the limit.
{StatLimit}
~Body Augmentation~.Name: ~Body Augmentation~

~Aesthetic Surgery~.Effect:
Perform an aesthetic operation upon a willing Unit.
The patient gets {Brown('-2 Health Regen')}, but {Brown('+1 Presence')} and a random Positive Quirk permanently, and you can alter one of their physical traits, such as hair or eye shape or color, shape of the nose, lips or ears, removal of body fat, moles, or skin impurities, etc.
~Aesthetic Surgery~.Upgrade: The total extra Presence from this can only go up to 1 above the Stat Limit, irrespective of the number of aesthetic operations.
~Aesthetic Surgery~.Notes: The Quest Master determines the Quirk the patient gets. You can perform this surgery on yourself.
~Aesthetic Surgery~.Name: ~Aesthetic Surgery~

~Land Vehicle~.Effect:
Spend 2000 {Gold}Gold to engineer a multi-passenger transport vehicle. Maximum operational velocity is 100 km/h, consuming 50 {Gold}Gold worth of fuel per hour, but it is impractical for combat.
Due to mechanical complexity, the vehicle requires 1 minute of calibration in order to start moving from being stationary.
~Land Vehicle~.Upgrade:
Upon impact, the vehicle stops and Slams Units hit 1d8 to 3d8 meters in a direction they choose, depending on the vehicle's current velocity.
At level 9, it can fly.
~Land Vehicle~.Name: ~Land Vehicle~

~Transmute Rock~.Effect:
Select a 1x1x1 meter cube of rock, mud, sand, or similar material and transform it into a different material of similar composition, rarity and worth. A Unit caught in this effect becomes Slowed.
Once per Adventure, you can transmute a piece of metal you can hold in your hand into gold worth up to 400% its original worth in {Gold}Gold.
~Transmute Rock~.Name: ~Transmute Rock~
~Transmute Rock~.Notes: A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.

~Circle of Manifestation~.Effect:
Inscribe a grand alchemical glyph on a flat plane and make a wish, translating your intent into the circle through precise mathematical symbology.
When activating it with your palm, it initiates the transmutation of the inscribed wish into reality, but you pay an unknown cost proportional to your wish's value.

Make a Roll (2d6). The higher you roll, the more accurately you gain what you wished for.
~Circle of Manifestation~.Upgrade: On doubles, there may be complications or bonuses.
~Circle of Manifestation~.Name: ~Circle of Manifestation~

~Propulsion Backpack~.Effect:
Spend 400 {Gold}Gold to construct a specialized backpack which generates sustained lift when activated, allowing the user to achieve flight at their normal Speed for up to 1 hour.
The backpack is destroyed once exhausted.
~Propulsion Backpack~.Name: ~Propulsion Backpack~

~Consciousness Backup~.Effect:
Perform a live open brain surgery on a Unit and implant a special device augmentation.
The subject gets {Brown('-1 Presence')} and -2 {Health}Max Health permanently.
It gains +1 Focus and +2 in all Checks regarding memory, and +5 Skill Points.
When the subject dies, its _consciousness_ passes into the device, where it can live indefinitely.
~Consciousness Backup~.Upgrade: If the implant is removed, the host's brain dies immediately. The device can be reimplanted into another brain to regain life, consciousness, and memories there, sharing the new body and mind with the previous owner.
~Consciousness Backup~.Name: ~Consciousness Backup~

<Alchemy>.Effect: You can use Create Elixir a number of times per Adventure equal to your Presence.
<Alchemy>.Name: <Alchemy>

<Adrenaline Steroid>.Effect:
Enter a state of chemical surge until the end of your next Turn.
You get +100% Healing on you (from any source) and all your offensive attacks and Abilities consume a Combo to increase their Damage by 100%.
<Adrenaline Steroid>.Notes: Does not work for after-Combat Health Regen.
<Adrenaline Steroid>.Name: <Adrenaline Steroid>

~Spell Cartridge 2.0~.Effect:
Spend ~1d6~ {Health}Health to create a special _Spell Cartridge_.
An Ally (or you) can cast a non-Healing Spell on the _Cartridge_, which absorbs it.
~Any Spell you cast on the Cartridge yourself costs 0 {A}Action Points.~
The _Cartridge_ can be fired from a weapon with 1 {A}Action Point (the Range becomes that weapon's Range), and then is destroyed.
~Spell Cartridge 2.0~.Notes: Spells that can Heal can't be cast on Cartridges.
~Spell Cartridge 2.0~.Name: ~Spell Cartridge 2.0~

~Overclock~.Effect: All your _summons_ immediately gain 1 {A}Action Point to use now.
~Overclock~.Name: ~Overclock~

~Auxiliary Nervous System~.Effect:
Using 300 {Gold}Gold worth of materials, perform an operation on a Unit to replace their central nervous system with a metalic alloy sewn with electrically condusive wires.
The subject gets {Brown('-1 Presence')} permanently, but gains +3 Health Regen.
They have an extra Reaction per Round, and, when taking Damage, they can use a Reaction to move up to their Speed.
~Auxiliary Nervous System~.Name: ~Auxiliary Nervous System~

~Survival By Destruction~.Effect: When you or an ally would die or take Damage, they don't, and instead one of their metal augmentations may be destroyed.
~Survival By Destruction~.Notes: Destroying one of the aumentations to prevent death or Damage is optional.
~Survival By Destruction~.Name: ~Survival By Destruction~

<Create Replica>.Effect:
Fabricate a perfect replica of a non-legendary magic item.
Only one replica of that item can exist, and the previous one must be destroyed in order to use Create Replica again.
<Create Replica>.Name: <Create Replica>

<Augmentation>.Effect:
You augment your body using chemical, mechanical or magical procedures.
You get {Brown('-1 Presence')} and 4 Negative Quirks, but +2 Might, +2 Instinct, and +10 {Health}Health.
<Augmentation>.Downside: After learning this Talent, you can never unlearn it.
<Augmentation>.Name: <Augmentation>

~Research Breakthrough~.Effect: Permanently increase all numbers of an Ability you know by 50%.
~Research Breakthrough~.Upgrade: You can only do this for each Ability twice.
~Research Breakthrough~.Notes:
This also increases the Cost, Action cost, Cooldown, etc. Round down. After using this on the same Ability twice, the total increase is +100% (not +50%, then +50% of +50%)!
Note that some Abilities that conduct surgeries will increase their values ^when^ you conduct the surgery. Does not apply to operations already completed.
~Research Breakthrough~.Name: ~Research Breakthrough~

<Transfiguration>.Effect:
You replace your body entirely with magical constructs, and transfuse your mind and consciousness into a different part of your new transcendental body, which can be entirely biological or mechanical in nature.
Your Might and Instinct increase by 4, your base Defense is 4, and you are Skilled when doing anything with Might, Instinct or Focus.
You no longer age and you are immune to all diseases.
<Transfiguration>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Transfiguration>.Name: <Transfiguration>

<Master Artifex>.Effect:
All potions and elixirs you create are 2 times as potent. Your Golems, Autoturrets and Grenades deal 100% more Damage.
Once per Adventure, you can create a Magic Item as per the _QM Resources, Homebrewing Magic Items_ page rules and spend {Gold}Gold for the materials equal to half of the item's gold cost.
<Master Artifex>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Master Artifex>.Name: <Master Artifex>

<Carbonic Reflection>.Effect:
You create a perfect clone of yourself, that can be biological or mechanical in nature. It resembles you identically in appearance, Stats, personality, etc.
It can cast any Abilities you have access to, but they share a Cooldown. You control both in Combat and they act on the same Turn.
Beware: The clone is intelligent, and while its goals are aligned with yours, it is not guaranteed to always listen to your commands and desires outside of Combat. You decide if its intelligence is natural or artificial, and if your clone is truly sentient or conscious or not.
<Carbonic Reflection>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Carbonic Reflection>.Name: <Carbonic Reflection>

~Formation~.Effect: Your party gains various bonuses depending on your formation!
~Formation~.Name: ~Formation~

~Advance!~.Effect: After making a weapon attack, you can make a free Movement Act for 1 meter.
~Advance!~.Name: ~Advance!~

~Delayed Valor~.Effect: You can store an After trigger and use it later.
~Delayed Valor~.Name: ~Delayed Valor~

~Valor Flex~.Effect: Your first Ability each Turn counts as {Teal(After)} every Act type.
~Valor Flex~.Name: ~Valor Flex~

~Axiom~.Effect: Roll 1d6 and convert it to Movement or Shielding.
~Axiom~.Name: ~Axiom~

~Courageous Duel~.Effect: Choose a Unit. You and it can only target* eachother.
~Courageous Duel~.Name: ~Courageous Duel~

~Self-Sacrifice~.Effect:
Take 2d6 True Damage. Heal a different ally for 200% of the rolled amount.

{Teal('With Valor:')} They gain +1 Health Regen for the rest of the Adventure.
{Teal('Next:')} Damage Ability
~Self-Sacrifice~.Notes: Can not be used on other Knights or characters with a Health Transfer Ability.
~Self-Sacrifice~.Name: ~Self-Sacrifice~

~Liberating Judgement~.Effect:
Deal 2d4 Damage to a Unit (you choose the Damage Type).

{Teal('With Valor:')} Then move a number of meters equal to the lower of the dice.
{Teal('Next:')} Damage Ability
~Liberating Judgement~.Name: ~Liberating Judgement~

~Outpost~.Effect:
Choose either a First Aid Tent or an Outpost Tower to build from scratch.
Once per Adventure, the tent can Heal everyone inside for 1 Health.
While within 50km of the Tower, your party can't be ambushed, has +2 in Sight, and halves the travel time of your party.
~Outpost~.Upgrade: For smaller-scope adventures, the Quest Master can reduce the distance of the Tower to 10km.
~Outpost~.Notes: Try to build towers within 100km of eachother, and in places you may want to visit multiple times. Construct a network of such towers!
~Outpost~.Name: ~Outpost~

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (and tell your Ally to do so).

~Nominate Squire~.Effect:
Nominate a Hero from your party to become your _squire_ - your trusted companion and helper in your quest.

Your squire gets -2 Max Health, but you get +3 Max Health.
Whenever one of you would get a Quirk, you can choose to deny it, and be given a different Quirk that fits the situation.
~Nominate Squire~.Upgrade:
Your squire has doubled inventory capacity and you can instantly swap items from eachother with 0 {A}Action Points (if near eachother).
They also have +2 in War Machines.
~Nominate Squire~.Name: ~Nominate Squire~

~Vows~.Requirement: Only usable in Campaigns with multiple sessions
~Vows~.Effect:
Vow on achieving a goal that would take at least 1 full Adventure.
Upon reaching your goal, you get a number of Positive Quirks equal to the number of sessions it took.
~Vows~.Upgrade: You can only have one vow at a time. Abandoning a vow gives you a Negative Quirk.
~Vows~.Name: ~Vows~

~Trusted Steed~.Effect:
You have a steed that increases your Movement Speed by 50%.
In Combat, your first Damaging Act dismounts you, but deals +1d4 Damage or Slams the target 1d4 meters away (if Targeted).
~Trusted Steed~.Upgrade: At Level 3, your Steed can climb steep hills and jump up to 5 meters. At Level 6, it can walk on water. At Level 9, it can fly.
~Trusted Steed~.Notes: The steed can be any animal that fits the story. When dismounting, your steed runs away and disappears into the surroundings. Once per real hour, you can whistle for your steed and it will appear running towards you and you automatically mount it.
~Trusted Steed~.Name: ~Trusted Steed~

~Actions With Valor~.Effect: Your Abilities and attacks in Worthy Combat may trigger extra effects if made immediately {Teal('After')} an Act that did a certain type of _thing_.
~Actions With Valor~.Upgrade:
The previous Act can be from your previous Turn, but from before Combat.
_Protection_ means giving Shielding, absorbing Damage, etc.
Slamming or Pushing count as _Control Effects_.
~Actions With Valor~.Notes: You can take a look at the ^tags^ of an Ability to see what kind of effects it can do. The {Teal('After')} effect can only trigger if the previous Act actually did that type of ^thing^. For example, "{Teal('After')} Mass Damage" can only trigger if the previous Act did Damage to more than 1 Unit. Apply common sense, and the Quest Master has the final say for whether an {Teal('After')} can trigger.
~Actions With Valor~.Name: ~Actions With Valor~

~Challenge of Arms~.Effect:
Roll 1d8.
Gain that as a Shielding, or Heal yourself for 50% of that.
Deal that as Smash Damage to a Unit, 50% of that to Units within 3 meters of you.
Slam yourself for that, or another Unit in any diretion for 50% of that.
~Challenge of Arms~.Notes: Use this to start a chain of Abilities With Valor! When you repeat this, choose the effects again and roll dice as normal. Obviously, the repeat does not retrigger another repeat.
~Challenge of Arms~.Name: ~Challenge of Arms~

~Chivalric Privilege~.Effect: Pick 2 Talents from the Level 1 Core Knight set.
~Chivalric Privilege~.Name: ~Chivalric Privilege~

~Row Through~.Effect:
Make a weapon attack with +1 Damage per {A}Action Point spent.

{Teal('After Control Effect:')} Hits one more Unit within 2 meters of the main target with -50% Damage.
~Row Through~.Name: ~Row Through~

~Cowards!~.Effect:
Choose a Worthy Unit within 2 meters.
Give them and yourself a _shared_ 1d6 Shielding.

{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} The Range is 5 meters and you dash in front of it.
~Cowards!~.Upgrade: The _shared_ Shielding is automatically consumed when _either_ of you takes Damage.
~Cowards!~.Notes:
This shared Shielding has priority over other Shieldings in reducing Damage.
In ^front^ of the Unit means on the closest space in front of where they are facing.
You dash ignoring obstacles. Requires Line of Sight, and dashing requires a mostly ^clear^ path (meaning of ^clear^ up to the Quest Master).
~Cowards!~.Tips: In certain situations, you might want to target an Enemy, so you can dash closer to them!
~Cowards!~.Name: ~Cowards!~

~Platinum Storm~.Effect:
Use a weapon to deal 2d4 + 2d6 Damage on a 3x3 meter area, of the weapon's Damage Type.

{Teal('After Protection:')} Does not Damage Allies, but Heals an ally caught for one of the rolled dice.
~Platinum Storm~.Notes: Each Healing d4 must be target a different Ally.
~Platinum Storm~.Name: ~Platinum Storm~

Variants.Eff: All Units you pass through are Slammed 2 meters to the side (requires a Trusted Steed).
All Units you pass through are Slowed.

~Champion's Gallop~.Name: ~Champion's Gallop~

~Blade of Liberation~.Effect:
Heal a Unit for 1d8 and remove a Control Effect from them.

{Teal('After Movement:')} Then deal 200% of that die as ^weapon^ Damage to a Unit within 3 meters of you.
~Blade of Liberation~.Name: ~Blade of Liberation~

~Provocation~.Effect:
Slam a Unit 3 meters towards you, or 3 meters away from you.

{Teal('After Healing or being Healed*')} Daze it instead of Slamming, then gain a 1d6 Shielding.
~Provocation~.Upgrade: The {Teal('Valor*')} extra effect may trigger even if you were affected by a Heal on someone else's Turn.
~Provocation~.Name: ~Provocation~

~Charging Stallion~.Effect:
Charge in a straight line to any location on the battlefield.
All Units you pass through _shuffle_ their positions.

{Teal('After Control Effect:')} Give yourself or a Unit you passed through 2 Shiedings, each equal to how many Units you passed through.
~Charging Stallion~.Upgrade: Each Shielding can go into a different Unit.
~Charging Stallion~.Notes:
Units you hit swap their positions between them _randomly_ (as chosen by the Quest Master). For example, the first Unit hit might swap positions with the last Unit hit.
Optionally, you can use this to exit the battlefield and the Combat.
Shuffling positions does not count as a Control Effect.
~Charging Stallion~.Name: ~Charging Stallion~

~Templar Retribution~.Effect:
Blind a Unit and gain 1 {Gold}Gold.
Then permanently increase the {Gold}Gold gained from this by 1d4.

{Teal('After Protection:')} Dash to the Unit, Slam it in any direction for the 1d4 rolled, and further increase the {Gold}Gold generated by 1d4.
~Templar Retribution~.Name: ~Templar Retribution~
~Templar Retribution~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Blockade~.Effect:
Use when another Unit within 2 meters would take Damage.
Gain a 1d4 Shielding and take the incoming Damage instead of that Unit.

{Teal('After Movement:')} After blocking the Damage with the d4, Slam the attacker the same number of meters away from you.
~Blockade~.Name: ~Blockade~

~Font Knight~.Effect:
You may select a `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` to cast Spells from. You have all Spells from that Font up to your Level.

Whenever you would trigger an {Teal('After')} effect, you can skip it to gain 0.5 {Mana}Mana.
~Font Knight~.Notes:
The unspent {Mana}Mana lass until the end of Combat. The {Mana}Mana can only be gained and spent in Worthy Combat.
You can change your Font and Spells inbetween Adventures.
~Font Knight~.Name: ~Font Knight~

~CATAPULT!~.Effect:
Spend 300 {Gold}Gold to craft a special Large catapult that you can take with you on your adventures!

Instead of triggering your {Teal('After')} valor effects, you can activate your catapult to give it 1 {A}Action Point.
~CATAPULT!~.Upgrade:
Anyone can push the Catapult by simply moving from behind it, without penalties.
You can spend 1 hour to spend any amount of {Gold}Gold to Heal the Catapult for 50% of that.
You can only have 1 Catapult at a time.
~CATAPULT!~.Notes:
The Catapult occupies a 2x2 meter area. The Catapult can use 1 {A}Action Point to move on its own.
The Catapult can't make Checks, and has 2/-2/0/2 in Stats, if it ever needs them.

~HURL!~.Sieger: Deals +100% Damage against Constructs and buildings!

~CATAPULT!~.Name: ~CATAPULT!~

~Stand Strong, Fellows~.Effect:
Heal either yourself, or all other Allies within 2 meters for 1d2.

{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} Also Damages Enemies within 2 meters for 1d4 Psychic Damage.
~Stand Strong, Fellows~.Name: ~Stand Strong, Fellows~

~Ruin Lineage~.Effect:
The _strongest_ Enemy takes 3d6 Scourge or Pulse Damage, and the next strongest Enemy takes 50% of that.

{Teal('After Heal:')} Choose another Unit on the battlefield to take 50% of that.
~Ruin Lineage~.Notes:
Will only affect alive Units. ^Strongest^ is up to the Quest Master.
For each target, you can choose the Damage Type.
~Ruin Lineage~.Name: ~Ruin Lineage~

~Lance Unbound~.Effect:
Make a melee weapon attack that applies a ~Combo~ and has +1 Range for each {A}Action Point spent.

{Teal('After Mass Damage:')} Heal an Ally for 1 for each {A}Action Point spent.
~Lance Unbound~.Name: ~Lance Unbound~

~Creed of the Crown~.Effect:
Your first moving* Act each Turn has its distance increased by 50%.
At the end of each Turn, gain {Gold}Gold equal to 100% the number of meters you moved this Turn.
You are immune to being Slowed, Rooted, and to Hard Terrain.
~Creed of the Crown~.Upgrade: You serve the realm above all else. Your sword defends law, order, and your liege's will.
~Creed of the Crown~.Notes:
Moving* bonus accounts for Pushing or Slamming, too!
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.
Moving 1 meter through Hard Terrain takes 2 meters of Movement.
~Creed of the Crown~.Name: ~Creed of the Crown~

~Creed of the Rose~.Effect:
All your Abilities that can Heal do the {Teal(After)} effect regardless of the previous Act.
Your Abilities that can Heal that don't have an {Teal(After)} effect at all have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Creed of the Rose~.Upgrade: You are the knight of beauty and grace, a protector of the innocent, and a paragon of compassion.
~Creed of the Rose~.Notes: Healing Abilities that have an {Teal(After)} effect that doesn't Heal ^do^ trigger their {Teal(After)} effect anyway.
~Creed of the Rose~.Name: ~Creed of the Rose~

~Creed of the Dragon~.Effect:
You take -50% Damage from that dragon's element Type.
All your Abilities' Ranges, areas, and distances increase by 2 meters, become of the dragon's element Type, and you deal +1d4 Mass Damage*.
~Creed of the Dragon~.Upgrade: You swear your allegiance to an elder dragon you have encountered on your journey.
~Creed of the Dragon~.Notes: If an effect or Ability manages to deal Mass Damage, it deals +1d4 to all affected Units.
~Creed of the Dragon~.Name: ~Creed of the Dragon~

~Creed of Vengeance~.Requirement: Requires having been betrayed this Campaign, or having broken an oath
~Creed of Vengeance~.Effect:
You gain 2 Hatred Positive Quirks of choice.
For each die rolled with Targeted Damage, gain 0.01 Initiative and 0.05 Damage or Healing on a chosen Ability permanently.
After killing a Unit, you can move through obstacles* and enemy Units until the end of your Turn.
~Creed of Vengeance~.Upgrade: Justice has failed. Your oath was broken, your faith was betrayed, but you swore a new one: to hunt those who wronged you and make the world remember. You will bring justice, to the world and to yourself.
~Creed of Vengeance~.Notes: Obstacles* are not walls and ceilings.
~Creed of Vengeance~.Name: ~Creed of Vengeance~

~Creed of the Sun~.Effect:
You have +4 Max Health.
Whenever you inflict a non-Slam Control Effect, you can also Slam that Unit 1d6 meters away from you.
Whenever you Slam a Unit, they must choose to be Blinded, Lagged, or Frailed.
~Creed of the Sun~.Upgrade: You are the dawn that banishes despair. You ride with the light at your back and hope in your hand.
~Creed of the Sun~.Name: ~Creed of the Sun~
~Creed of the Sun~.Notes:
A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.
A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Creed of Steel~.Effect:
You can wear 2 Shields at the time, both on the same hand.
Whenever you block some Damage with a Shielding, save the blocked amount as _Steel Points_, or give 50% of the blocked amount as a Shielding to an Ally you can see.
_Steel Points_ may last until the end of the Adventure.

~Rebuke~.Effect: {Teal('After Protection:')} Consume all _Steel Points_ to deal that much Damage of your Shield's Damage Type.
~Rebuke~.Notes: If your Shield has multiple Damage Type reductions, you can choose. If it has no Damage Type reducion, it's Smash Damage.

~Creed of Steel~.Name: ~Creed of Steel~

~Inevitable Cataclysm~.Requirement: Can't be used on the first Round
~Inevitable Cataclysm~.Effect:
You declare war on your enemy, and wait for the perfect moment to obliterate them.

Choose a Unit you can see. At the start of your next Turn, you jump to them and strike them with your weapon for 5d10 Damage of your weapon's type. The impact ripples to Units within 2 meters, and each Unit caught takes 1 die less of the result per meter away from the main target. The Quest Master chooses which die to drop per meter.

{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} Ripples to Units within up to 5 meters, and Allies hit take -50% Damage.
{Teal('After Heal:')} Damage increases to 5d12
~Inevitable Cataclysm~.Notes: If the main target took 7, 8, 9, 10, and 11 Damage on the dice, then Units 1 meter away may take 8, 9, 10, and 11 if the Quest Master decides to drop the lowest die. Units 2 meters away take 8, 9, and 10 if the Quest Master decides to drop the highest die. And so on.
~Inevitable Cataclysm~.Name: ~Inevitable Cataclysm~

<Peasant! I Choose You!>.Effect:
You recruit a trusted beginner adventurer non-player character as a follower. It starts out with one _improvement_ from below, whichever makes sense for that person, or random. It has -1, 0, 0, 1 distributed among the Stats.
It acts on your Turn and has 2 {A}Action Points per Turn. At the end of every Worthy Combat, if the follower dealt and took Damage, it gains 1 XP, which it can spend to buy _improvements_ it chooses.
Only one can follow you in your journeys at a time.
<Peasant! I Choose You!>.Upgrade: Followers obey Hero rules for death and being Fallen. However, followers have no Health Regen, and instead replenish 50% of their Max Health at the end of each of your Adventures.
<Peasant! I Choose You!>.Notes: Your follower can get the same improvement multiple times, unless it's unique. It is not a Hero by any means and does not behave like one (it can't use Weapons, Armor, Feats, Abilities, etc like a Hero). It is limited to what its stat block and Abilities say it can do. You can, however, give it orders, customize its looks (hair style, clothes, etc) and it will obey your commands within reason. You are the leader it looks up to. Lead proudly and fairly!

SpellTable.Name: Healthy {XP}1
SpellTable.Effect: +2 {Health}Health

SpellTable.Name: Speedy {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: +1 Movement Speed

SpellTable.Name: Rangey {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: +1 Range on all attacks and Abilities

SpellTable.Name: Tanky {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: Gain a 1d4 Shielding at the start of each Combat.

SpellTable.Name: Bashy (Unique) {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if it rolled 6, Single-Stun the target.

SpellTable.Name: Slashy {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if it rolled 6, +1 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Flanky {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: Flank attacks deal +1 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Sneaky (Unique) {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: Follower can't be targeted on the first Round.

SpellTable.Name: Witchy {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: When you get this, choose a Damage Type. Can freely change attack Damage to that type.

SpellTable.Name: Lighty {A}1 Action Point {Cooldown}Once / Adventure (Unique) {XP}3
SpellTable.Effect: Blind a Unit within 2 meters.

SpellTable.Name: Healy {A}1 Action Point {Cooldown}Once / Adventure {XP}3
SpellTable.Effect: Heal a Unit within 2 meters for 1d6.

Attack.Weaponize: Can be equipped with any magic weapon and benefit from its magic passive effects (e.g. not Critical Strikes). Damage does not increase.

<Peasant! I Choose You!>.Name: <Peasant! I Choose You!>

~Knight's Corral~.Effect:
You make your surrounding area impossible to tresspass, except for your challenger of choice.

Choose a Worthy Enemy. All other Units within 4 meters of either of you are Pushed 3d4 meters away from between you. Until the start of your next Turn, no other Units can willingly come within 3 meters of either of you, and for the rest of the Combat, you both Heal for 100% of the Round number at the start of each Worthy Round.

{Teal('After Mass Damage:')} +1d4 and +100% Healing you two receive from this.
{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} +1d4 and Pushing becomes Slamming instead.
~Knight's Corral~.Notes: Units can't willingly enter the zone. If a Unit somehow gets in, they can't willingly move closer to either of them.
~Knight's Corral~.Name: ~Knight's Corral~

~Liege's Banner~.Requirement: Can't be used on the first Round
~Liege's Banner~.Effect:
You detach your banner, and raise it above the battlefield, ready to throw it.

Throw your special banner onto a place on the battlefield, dealing 2d6 Pierce Damage to Units in a 2x2 meter area around its point and Healing the thrower for 1d4. The banner has 10 Max Health and absorbs all Damage the Knight's allies take.

{Teal('After Heal:')} Damage becomes 3d6 and area increases to 3x3.
{Teal('After Mass Damage:')} The banner's Health becomes 15 and Heal increases to 1d8.
~Liege's Banner~.Upgrade: Anyone can use 1 {A}Action Point to pick up the banner and throw it again, with the first throw's {Teal('After Valor')} effects!
~Liege's Banner~.Notes: You must spend 50 {Gold}Gold to craft the special banner, and you must draw a picture of what it looks like.
~Liege's Banner~.Name: ~Liege's Banner~

~Perfect Form~.Effect: After you use all six Act types in a Combat, choose an Ability. It is always made with Valor this Combat and has no Cooldown.
~Perfect Form~.Name: ~Perfect Form~

~Knightsville~.Effect:
You claim an open and available piece of land as your own.
For 100 {Gold}Gold, you can recruit a person as a villager to come live on your property and work on the various projects there. The village houses up to 3 people at first.
Each villager may have its own preferences for work types.

Each town project starts at 0 _work_ done. Every real hour, each villager can accomplish 1d4 to 1d10 _work_, based on personality and preferences.

Your village's Unhappiness starts at 25, but increases by 1d6 whenever a new villager joins the town.
At the end of each Adventure, produces 1d4 {Gold}Gold for you, and rolls 1d100 for happiness. If it rolls below the Unhappiness level, they may leave, get sick, die, steal {Gold}Gold, etc.
~Knightsville~.Notes: The Quest Master decides whether your villagers work during downtime or not. You need to come to town to collect the {Gold}Gold, but your villagers will follow your work commands even if you're not there. The Unhappiness reduction happens when the building is constructed, and is permanent until destroyed.

SpellTable.Name: House {Hammer}30 Work
SpellTable.Effect: +2 Population Cap, -1d4 Unhappiness

SpellTable.Name: Wall {Hammer}25 Work
SpellTable.Effect: -1d8 Unhappiness

SpellTable.Name: Cultural Building {Hammer}45 Work
SpellTable.Effect: -2d8 Unhappiness

SpellTable.Name: Church {Hammer}40 Work
SpellTable.Effect: -1d10 Unhappiness. Once / Adventure, can Heal people inside for 1d6.

SpellTable.Name: Town Hall {Hammer}65 Work
SpellTable.Effect: Villagers have their ^Dice Upgraded^ for all work they do.

SpellTable.Name: Market {Hammer}45 Work
SpellTable.Effect: The {Gold}Gold generated by Villagers has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.

SpellTable.Name: Farm {Hammer}45 Work
SpellTable.Effect: -1d4 Unhappiness. Each Farm further produces 10 {Gold}Gold per Adventure, but requires a villager to

SpellTable.Name: Guild Workshop {Hammer}45 Work
SpellTable.Effect: -1d4 Unhappiness. Each Shop has a type (blacksmith, library, bowyer, leatherworker, etc). At the end of each Adventure, each shop produces a magic item worth 1d100 {XP}Experience (or multiple of the same type, all together, produce an item worth that many d100 in {XP}Experience). Magic items from Guilds are sold at 20% of their value.

SpellTable.Name: Military Camp {Hammer}45 Work
SpellTable.Effect: +1d4 Unhappiness. Each military camp may send one villager to fight with you until death. Their Health may range from 5 to 15, Damage from 1d2 to 1d8, etc based on your workshops and number of Military Camps.

~Knightsville~.Name: ~Knightsville~

~Get Up, Stand Up~.Effect:
Remove all your party members' Exhaustion (from any source).
If they were Exhausted from lack of sleep, they can resist sleep Exhaustion for 8 more hours.
~Get Up, Stand Up~.Name: ~Get Up, Stand Up~
~Get Up, Stand Up~.Notes: An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.

~Renown~.Effect: Each Adventure, the first time you enter each Worthy* friendly hub you didn't start in, gain 100 {Gold} and you have +1 to Presence Checks.
~Renown~.Notes: A friendly hub is a town or city where there are other non-player characters. It's considered Worthy if you didn't enter it specifically to only gain the 100 {Gold}Gold.
~Renown~.Name: ~Renown~

~Honorable Duel~.Effect: At the start of each Combat, choose an Enemy. You deal +10% Damage against eachother.
~Honorable Duel~.Name: ~Honorable Duel~

~Obsession and Compulsion~.Effect: At the end of every Combat, if all your used {Teal(After)} Abilities triggered their {Teal(After)} effect, gain a Plot Point, +2 Max Health, and a random Positive Quirk.
~Obsession and Compulsion~.Name: ~Obsession and Compulsion~

~Knight in Black~.Effect:
While wearing all black and at 50% or more Health, you can't take more than 10 Damage at a time.
You have +1 Movement Speed.
~Knight in Black~.Name: ~Knight in Black~

~White Knighthood~.Effect:
While wearing all white and at 90% or more Health, your Abilities trigger their {Teal(After)} effect anyway.
You have +1 Initiative.
~White Knighthood~.Name: ~White Knighthood~

<Man of Steel>.Effect:
While wearing Heavy Armor or a Tower Shield, Enemy ranged attacks against other allies within 1 meter of you have Cover.
You have +6 Max Health.
<Man of Steel>.Notes: Nothing happens if an ally near you already has Cover. If playing on a grid, this does work for allies diagonally.
<Man of Steel>.Name: <Man of Steel>

~Echoes of Heritage~.Effect: Your next {Teal(After)} effect triggers 2 extra times.
~Echoes of Heritage~.Name: ~Echoes of Heritage~

~Sovereign Execution~.Requirement: Can't be used on the first Round
~Sovereign Execution~.Effect:
You prepare to decimate the meek and using their life force as fuel for your conquest.

Your next attack propels you up to 5 meters towards the target, and heals you for 50% Damage done. If it leaves the non-Epic Unit with 25% or less Health, further deals extra Damage equal to its current Health and the Damage type becomes True.

{Teal('Control Effect:')} 100% Healing instead of 50%.
{Teal('After Protection:')} 50% Health execution instead of 25%.
~Sovereign Execution~.Name: ~Sovereign Execution~

~Damsel's Deliverance~.Requirement: Can't be used on the first Round
~Damsel's Deliverance~.Effect:
You lock eyes with a target, and prepare to take them into oblivion.

Charge towards the target, grab them, and dash with it away from your original position until you hit a non-Unit obstacle. On impact, it takes 7d6 Smash Damage.

{Teal('After Movement:')} +3d6 Damage
{Teal('After Protection:')} Can now also collide with Units, and the impact Damage may work akin to Slamming a Unit into another.
~Damsel's Deliverance~.Notes: You grab the Unit and you both go flying, until you smash it into the first obstacle it collides with. If you reach 15 meters of uninterrupted dashing, you smash them into the ground and stop, dealing the Damage then and there.
~Damsel's Deliverance~.Name: ~Damsel's Deliverance~

~Divide and Conquer~.Requirement: Can't be used on the first Round
~Divide and Conquer~.Effect:
You stomp your weapons into the ground and divide the battlefield.

ALL Units in front of you take 4d8 Damage of your weapon's type and are Slammed back 1d8 meters. Each Unit behind you gains a 1d8 Shielding.

{Teal('After Control Effect:')} Units in the front also become Blinded.
{Teal('After Movement:')} Units in the back may make a free Movement on their next Turn.
~Divide and Conquer~.Name: ~Divide and Conquer~
~Divide and Conquer~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Master Falconer~.Effect:
You have a trusted falcon or a similar animal that scouts around and aids you in Combat.
Whenever you trigger an {Teal(After)} effect, the falcon dashes down and deals 1d4 Pierce Damage to the target, or give an affected ally a 1d6 Shielding, which disappears if the falcon moves away from the ally.

You have +3 in Scouting.
~Master Falconer~.Name: ~Master Falconer~

~Shatter Through~.Effect:
Make a weapon attack with ~+1d4~ Damage per {A}Action Point spent.

{Teal('After Control Effect:')} Hits ~2 more Units~ within 2 meters of the main target with -50% Damage.
~Shatter Through~.Name: ~Shatter Through~

~Infidels!~.Effect:
Choose a Worthy Unit within 2 meters.
Give them ~or~ yourself a ~1d10~ Shielding.

{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} The Range is ~10 meters~ and you dash in front of it.
~Infidels!~.Upgrade: There is no _shared_ on this Ability anymore.
~Infidels!~.Notes:
In ^front^ of the Unit means on the closest space in front of where they are facing.
You dash ignoring obstacles. Requires Line of Sight, and dashing requires a mostly ^clear^ path (meaning of ^clear^ up to the Quest Master).
~Infidels!~.Tips: In certain situations, you might want to target an Enemy, so you can dash closer to them!
~Infidels!~.Name: ~Infidels!~

~Silver Storm~.Effect:
Use a weapon to deal ~2d8 + 2d10~ Damage on a ~4x4~ meter area, of the weapon's Damage Type.

{Teal('After Protection:')} Does not Damage Allies, but Heals an ally caught for one of the rolled dice.
~Silver Storm~.Notes: Each Healing die must be target a different Ally.
~Silver Storm~.Name: ~Silver Storm~

Variants.Eff: All Units you pass through are Slammed 1d8 meters to the side (requires a Trusted Steed).
All Units you pass through are Slowed.

~Make Way For The King~.Name: ~Make Way For The King~

~Blade of Condoleances~.Effect:
Heal a Unit for ~1d12~ and remove ~all~ Control Effects from them.

{Teal('After Movement:')} Then deal ~300%~ of that die as ^weapon^ Damage to a Unit within 3 meters of you.
~Blade of Condoleances~.Name: ~Blade of Condoleances~

~Indignation~.Effect:
Slam a Unit ~1d8~ meters towards you, or ~1d8~ meters away from you.

{Teal('After Healing or being Healed*')} ~Single-Stun~ it instead of Slamming, then gain a ~1d8~ Shielding.
~Indignation~.Upgrade: The {Teal('Valor*')} extra effect may trigger even if you were affected by a Heal on someone else's Turn.
~Indignation~.Name: ~Indignation~
~Indignation~.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~The Crown~.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
~The Crown~.Effect:
You become the king, emperor, or hierarch of a certain area or city.
In combat, you may be accompanied by up to 2 loyal Knight Heroes, who start at Level 3, and can Level Up like normal Heroes through the {XP}Experience system.

Also, your Max Health becomes 100 and can not change by any means, and you gain +2 in 2 Stats of your choice. You automatically pass all Hard Presence Checks while within your territory.
~The Crown~.Name: ~The Crown~

~The Last Knight~.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
~The Last Knight~.Effect:
As long as your other Hero party members are alive, your Health can not be reduced below 1.
You have all Level 9 Talents, and all numbers on your chosen Creed are tripled (except costs and the values of dice).

Also, you have +1 in all Stats.
~The Last Knight~.Name: ~The Last Knight~

~Legend of the Realm~.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
~Legend of the Realm~.Effect:
All your {Teal(After)} effects trigger 1 extra time, and your first {Teal(After)} effect each Turn triggers its {Teal(After)} effect anyway.
Once / Adventure, you gain an item from any shop of the realm without paying for it, and all your food, housing, etc are taken care of for free.
You can rest for 30 minutes at a friendly place to immediately end the Adventure for yourself and start a new one.

Also, you have +4 Presence.
~Legend of the Realm~.Name: ~Legend of the Realm~

~OSR Spell~.Effect: Roll an US die. The effect increases based on your roll with a table.
~OSR Spell~.Name: ~OSR Spell~

~Spell Roulette~.Effect: Roll 3 USD and cast a spell that combined value something something....
~Spell Roulette~.Name: ~Spell Roulette~

<Star Burst>.Effect:
Declare up to 4 different targets you can see. Assign a different number from #1 to #4 to each.
Roll a number of d4's equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die. Each d4 rolled deals that much {Orange(Flux)} Damage to the target with that number.
<Star Burst>.Notes:
E.g. if you put #2 on a goblin, and you roll three 2's on the d4's, then that goblin takes 6 Damage.
You should probably assign the higher number to the target you want to do most Damage to.
<Star Burst>.Name: <Star Burst>

~Spark Farmer~.Effect:
Whenever you roll an US die...
Essentially you want to roll as many US dice as possible.
~Spark Farmer~.Name: ~Spark Farmer~

~High Roller~.Effect: Build it for high rolls on the USD.
~High Roller~.Name: ~High Roller~

~Low Roller~.Effect: Build it for low rolls on the USD.
~Low Roller~.Name: ~Low Roller~

~Paradox~.Effect:
Use after rolling an Unstable Spark die.
Treat the result as 11 - ^the rolled number^.
~Paradox~.Notes: If your roll is outside your Unstable Spark die numbers, the world might break! What breaking the world means is up to the Quest Master.
~Paradox~.Name: ~Paradox~

~Unstable Spark~.Effect:
At the start of your every Turn in a Worthy Combat, roll 1d10. Apply any effects you have.
Other Talents will add extra effects to your Unstable Spark die.

{Spark(1)} you take 1d6 True Damage.
{Spark(10)} your next Spell this Turn has +50% Damage.
~Unstable Spark~.Upgrade: The Color('orange' 'orange d10') icon on a Sorcerer Ability means that effect triggers when you roll that number on the Unstable Spark die.
~Unstable Spark~.Notes: The triggered {Spark(numbers)} may or may not overlap.
~Unstable Spark~.Name: ~Unstable Spark~

~Overcharge~.Effect: Permanently learn one Level 1 Sorcerer Talent.
~Overcharge~.Notes: You may use this as many times as you want, until you learn all Level 1 Sorcerer Talents (works for both Utility or Class Talents). The {Mana}Mana spent is restored inbetween Adventures as usual. You can't replace the permanently learned Spell inbetween Adventures... and why would you, anyway?
~Overcharge~.Name: ~Overcharge~

~Poetic Justice~.Effect:
At any point where it's fit, you can call for a _poetic justice moment_, representing a living metaphor, turning a situation around, karma, irony, or coming full circle.
Declare an event you would like to happen that can be interpreted as _poetic justice_, which could be either good or bad for your team.
Soon, the Quest Master may fumble one die roll or alter the current situation so that it reflects a _poetic moment_, in a way similar to your desire.
~Poetic Justice~.Upgrade: There may be no place for poetic justice at that time, and it's possible nothing happens as the result of this.
~Poetic Justice~.Notes: They can be events such as being saved by your worst enemy, or a xenophobic person being discriminated against by someone else who is xenophobic. Or perhaps a goblin dies by an arrow to the kn-, I mean shoulder, after he launched an arrow in someone else's shoulder.
~Poetic Justice~.Name: ~Poetic Justice~

~Fracture Reality~.Effect: Lightly alter reality to change a small detail in a story or environment that does not have large consequences. All other characters believe it didn't change, and it's always been like that.
~Fracture Reality~.Upgrade: This may not be the right time to fracture reality, and it's possible your request does not happen. If so, reset this Ability's Cooldown.
~Fracture Reality~.Notes: They can be _Mandela effect_ events such as changing the color of an object, a character placing something in a different room, you having bought a certain item that you didn't buy. Ask the Quest Master if your request fits!
~Fracture Reality~.Name: ~Fracture Reality~

~Superposition~.Effect:
Use on your Turn, or when a Unit wants to attack you.
Teleport yourself (or a non-Epic Unit you can see) in a _random direction_ a number of meters equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die.
~Superposition~.Notes:
Roll 1d8 to determine the direction. 1. North, 2. North-East, 3. East, etc. You take with you all items carried. Does not work if you're Rooted or stuck in place somehow.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.
~Superposition~.Name: ~Superposition~

~Jolt~.Effect:
Shoot a quick burst of current at a Unit, dealing 1d6 + ^Any Stat^ {Color('orange' 'Flux')} Damage.
Then roll an Unstable Spark die if in Worthy Combat.
~Jolt~.Combo: Then roll an Unstable Spark die if in Worthy Combat.
~Jolt~.Downside: Only usable if your last Unstable Spark die rolled was at least 6.
~Jolt~.Name: ~Jolt~

~Arcane Fire~.Effect: Your next weapon attack until the end of your next Turn applies a ~Combo~ and deals extra Damage equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die and all its Damage dealt becomes {Color('orange' 'Flux')} Damage.
~Arcane Fire~.Name: ~Arcane Fire~

~Arc Lance~.Effect:
Shoot a lance in a direction that Damages the first Unit it hits for 2d8 {Orange(Flux)} Damage.
{CriticalStrike} if you roll an 8, apply a ~Combo~.

You can take the roll as an Unstable Spark die roll. If it's out of bounds, nothing happens (_or the world breaks, who knows!?_)
~Arc Lance~.Notes:
The lance will not hit the target if there's Cover between you and it, and will instead hit the cover.
What breaking the world means is up to the Quest Master.
~Arc Lance~.Name: ~Arc Lance~

<Sap>.Effect:
A Unit must make a Presence Roll at least equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die or Stun-Stunned.
Then roll an Unstable Spark die.
<Sap>.Notes: What are you doing, just pick Wild Casting.
<Sap>.Name: <Sap>

~Spellbloodweave~.Effect: Use after you make an attack or use an offensive Ability. It deals -50% Damage, but instead heals an ally you can see for the final Damage dealt.
~Spellbloodweave~.Name: ~Spellbloodweave~

~Gathering the Magic~.Requirement: Level 2, Only usable in Worthy Combat
~Gathering the Magic~.Effect:
For the rest of the Combat, gain:
{Spark(3)} gain +1 Skill Point.
~Gathering the Magic~.Name: ~Gathering the Magic~

~Lightning Striking Twice~.Effect:
Blast a Unit you can see for {Amount} {Color('orange' 'Flux')} Damage and {Choose} Deafened, Lagged, or Dazed.

Then do it again.
~Lightning Striking Twice~.Notes:
When doing it again, you can choose the same Unit or a different one. The efect can happen again and again if each hit Unit has a ~Combo~.
A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.
~Lightning Striking Twice~.Name: ~Lightning Striking Twice~

~Plot Armor~.Effect:
{Text} Shielding that can block Damage equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die.
Then roll an Unstable Spark die.

Variants.Text: Give a Unit you can see a

~Plot Armor~.Notes: Your party gains a Plot Point when rolling evens on a Check.
~Plot Armor~.Name: ~Plot Armor~

~Cascadence~.Effect: Choose an ally you can see. Your next Unstable Spark die rolled applies to them instead of you.
~Cascadence~.Name: ~Cascadence~

~Chaos Storm~.Requirement: Level 6, Only usable in Worthy Combat
~Chaos Storm~.Effect:
Roll an Unstable Spark die.
Deal that much Damage of that Damage Type to exactly that many Worthy Units you can see.
~Chaos Storm~.Notes:
Roll for a random Damage type from the following: 1. Pierce, 2. Slash, 3. Pulse, 4. Poison, 5. Acid, 6. Divine, 7. Scourge, 8. Shock, 9. Cold, 10. Fire.
Targeting Worthy Units is mandatory, and you count as a Worthy Unit.
If your Unstable Spark is higher than 10, you can choose the Damage Type.
~Chaos Storm~.Name: ~Chaos Storm~

~Chronohype~.Effect:
Use after someone rolls dice for an Act.
Start a timer for a number of seconds equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die.
You have that many seconds to reroll ^all the dice together^ until you are satisfied with the result.
Then take the final result.
~Chronohype~.Name: ~Chronohype~

~Timeslip~.Effect:
Increase the Initiative of 2 Units you can see by 1.
Apply a ~Combo~ to each of them.
~Timeslip~.Name: ~Timeslip~

~Soulforce Tap~.Effect: Reroll an Unstable Spark die, or you can choose to roll it again after you did its effect.
~Soulforce Tap~.Name: ~Soulforce Tap~

<Wild Casting>.Effect:
{Spark('2 or 3')} roll 1d20. You automatically cast that Spell from the table below, but the Quest Master determines the targets and strength.
If you rolled 2 on the Unstable Spark die, the effect is negative for your team. Otherwise, it's positive.
The lower Health you are, the more intense the effect (probably).
<Wild Casting>.Notes:
For example, if you roll 1 and the random Spell is Fire Enchantment, it will be cast on an enemy's weapon if possible (respecting the range). If not possible, then it will be cast on a random, non-Hero's weapon. If not possible, then it will be cast on a Hero's weapon. If nothing is possible, nothing happens.
If an effect can be cancelled or has ongoing effects, you have control of them as if you yourself had cast the Spell.

SpellTable.Name: 1. Wilder Casting
SpellTable.Effect: Roll 2 more times on this table.

SpellTable.Name: 2. Quicksand
SpellTable.Effect: A 3x3 to 9x9 area becomes covered in a hazard respective to your {Orange(Flux)} (e.g. ice, fire, toxic gas, etc).

SpellTable.Name: 3. Conjure Steed
SpellTable.Effect: A random animal is conjured as a mount for 1 to 5 Units.

SpellTable.Name: 4. Force Wall
SpellTable.Effect: A thin 2x2 to 6x6 transparent wall is created.

SpellTable.Name: 5. Obstable Break
SpellTable.Effect: One or more obstacles or traps are destroyed.

SpellTable.Name: 6. Strange Wave
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units are Healed or Damaged for 1d4 to 1d12.

SpellTable.Name: 7. Teleportation
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units are teleported 1 to 10 meters.

SpellTable.Name: 8. Fog
SpellTable.Effect: A 3x3 to 9x9 fog cloud is created.

SpellTable.Name: 9. Enchanted Weapons
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units have their weapons enchanted (+2 Damage, any element)

SpellTable.Name: 10. Invisibility
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units become invisible for 1 to 99 Turns.

SpellTable.Name: 11. FULMINATION
SpellTable.Effect: A 3x3 to 9x9 explosion happens, dealing 2d6 to 6d6 Damage of any element.

SpellTable.Name: 12. Fling
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 objects or items are flung around. If any hits a Unit, deals 1d6 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: 13. Thunder Clap
SpellTable.Effect: All Units within 2 to 6 meters of you take 1d6 to 3d6 Damage (any type).

SpellTable.Name: 14. Lightning Strikes Again
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 3 Units get any Control Effect.

SpellTable.Name: 15. Reverse Gravity
SpellTable.Effect: The gravity in a 3x3x3 to 9x9x9 area is reversed.

SpellTable.Name: 16. Banish
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 3 Units are banished to another plane for 1 Turn. When they come back, they immediately take 1 Turn.

SpellTable.Name: 17. Unknowable Health
SpellTable.Effect: A Unit is healed for 5 to 55 Health.

SpellTable.Name: 18. Summon Elementals
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 angry {Color('orange' 'Flux')} Elementals worth 50 to 150 {XP}XP are summoned at points on the battlefield. They are agressive towards everyone.

SpellTable.Name: 19. Nervous System Jolt
SpellTable.Effect: One Unit permanently gains +1 in a Stat, or +1 to +3 Max Health, Regen or Mana.

SpellTable.Name: 20. Resurrection
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 3 dead or Fallen Units come back to life (without Exhaustion) with 1 to full Health.

<Wild Casting>.Name: <Wild Casting>

<Viled Casting>.Effect:
You are afflicted by the vile, and your person form becomes ever more corrupted with the passage of time.

{Spark(2)} you become permanently mutated by the corruption at the number equal to your ^next^ rolled {Orange('Unstable Spark')} die.
_(You know the result of it!)_
<Viled Casting>.Upgrade: Roll your next Unstable Spark die now. Next time you would roll one, don't, and apply this die.
<Viled Casting>.Notes: Your Max Health can't decrease below 1. The Quest Master determines which Talent you learn with Arcane Cyst. The inversal/reversal of Involution may be up to the Quest Master's interpretation for certain mutations.

SpellTable.Name: Bone Restructuring
SpellTable.Effect: Gain +1 in a random Stat and -1 in a random Stat.

SpellTable.Name: Skin Reconstruction
SpellTable.Effect: Take -50% Damage of a random Type, but +50% Damage of a random Type.

SpellTable.Name: Burning Blood
SpellTable.Effect: Gain +1 {Mana}Max Mana, but -1d10 {Health}Max Health

SpellTable.Name: Chitinous Growths
SpellTable.Effect: Gain +5 Max Health, but -3 Health Regen.

SpellTable.Name: Arcane Cyst
SpellTable.Effect: Learn a random Talent from a random Class, but choose to unlearn a different one you had.

SpellTable.Name: Fate Threading
SpellTable.Effect: Gain a Plot Point, but the Quest Master also gains one.

SpellTable.Name: Psychotic Magical Thought
SpellTable.Effect: Roll twice on the Wild Casting Talent's table. The first is positive, the second is negative for your team.

SpellTable.Name: Extended Limbs
SpellTable.Effect: Gain +1 melee Range, but -1 ranged Range.

SpellTable.Name: Unknowable Knowledge
SpellTable.Effect: Gain a random Skill, and a random Flaw you have is replaced by a different random one.

SpellTable.Name: Cartilage Alteration
SpellTable.Effect: Become immune to a random type of Crowd Control, but another type of Crowd Control is doubled whenever you receive it.

SpellTable.Name: Organ Growth
SpellTable.Effect: Roll 2 more times: gain only the positive mutation of the first roll, and only the negative one of the second roll.

SpellTable.Name: Involution
SpellTable.Effect: Roll again, but the positive and negative effects are reversed.

<Viled Casting>.Name: <Viled Casting>

<Guiled Casting>.Effect: {Spark(1)} gain +1 Spellpower of a random Damage Type _permanently_, as long as you have this Talent.
<Guiled Casting>.Notes: 1. Fire, 2. Cold, 3. Shock, 4. Pulse, 5. Poison, 6. Acid, 7. Divine, 8. Scourge.
<Guiled Casting>.Name: <Guiled Casting>

<Mild Casting>.Effect: {Spark(9)} trigger the base Unstable Spark effect for 10.
<Mild Casting>.Notes: If you cast the 1st version Soulflare, you can still cast its other versions this Combat.
<Mild Casting>.Downside: After you cast a Spell or one of its variants, you can't cast that spell or variant again this Combat.
<Mild Casting>.Name: <Mild Casting>

<Arcano Mantissa>.Effect: {Spark(4)} gain 0.5 Max Health and 0.25 Max {Mana}Mana permanently.
<Arcano Mantissa>.Notes: {Mana}Mana and Health can't be expended or Damaged in fractions, but if you manage to get this 2 times, you essentially get +1 Health permanently (or 1 {Mana}Mana permanently if you trigger this 4 times).
<Arcano Mantissa>.Name: <Arcano Mantissa>

<Honorificabilitudinitatibus>.Effect:
Your Unstable Spark die becomes 1d12 instead of 1d10.
{Spark("11 or 12")} Your next Spell this Turn has +50% Damage.
{Spark(10)} No effect.
<Honorificabilitudinitatibus>.Notes:
If other Talents refer to the number 10 on the Unstable Spark die, treat that as a 12.
You're a Sorcerer, I'm sure you'll figure it out.
<Honorificabilitudinitatibus>.Name: <Honorificabilitudinitatibus>

<Tap>.Effect: {Spark(4)} deal 1d4 {Color('orange' 'Flux')} Damage. The target gets affected by that effect:
<Tap>.Name: <Tap>
<Tap>.Notes:
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Font Sorcerer~.Effect: {Spark(4)} permanently learn a Spell from the `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` respective to your {Orange(Flux)} (up to your Level).
~Font Sorcerer~.Notes: You can change your Font and Spells inbetween Adventures.
~Font Sorcerer~.Name: ~Font Sorcerer~

~Event-Horizon Ego Death~.Effect:
{Spark(5)} store 1d8 _Undying Points_.

When you would drop to 0 Health, you immediately spend all _Undying Points_ Heal back to that much {Health}Health without Exhaustion.
~Event-Horizon Ego Death~.Upgrade: These _Undying Points_ are kept until spent, even inbetween Adventures.
~Event-Horizon Ego Death~.Name: ~Event-Horizon Ego Death~
~Event-Horizon Ego Death~.Notes: An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.

~Recoherence~.Effect: {Spark(5)} this can count as a {Orange(4)} or {Orange(3)} (you choose which).
~Recoherence~.Name: ~Recoherence~

~Adrenaline Drift~.Effect:
{Spark(5)} roll 1d8 to determine a direction (North, North-East, East, etc).
Heal another Worthy Unit roughly in that direction for 1d6.
If there is none, Heal yourself.
~Adrenaline Drift~.Name: ~Adrenaline Drift~

~Manifest Abundance~.Effect: {Spark(5)} for the rest of the Combat, gain {Gold}Gold equal to all dice you roll.
~Manifest Abundance~.Name: ~Manifest Abundance~

~Vibe~.Effect: {Spark(5)} you can spend 1 {Mana}Mana to deal 1d12 {Orange(Flux)} Damage to the closest Enemy to you and apply a ~Combo~.
~Vibe~.Name: ~Vibe~

~Arcane Feedback~.Effect: {Spark(6)} your next Ability casts again, but with -90% Spellpower.
~Arcane Feedback~.Upgrade: The Damage, Healing, etc of that Ability can't be less than 1.
~Arcane Feedback~.Name: ~Arcane Feedback~

~Plasmify~.Effect:
{Spark(6)} roll another Unstable Spark die.
Give an Ally a Shielding that can block that much Damage.
~Plasmify~.Name: ~Plasmify~

~Entropy Reversal~.Effect: {Spark(6)} gain 1 Plot Point, and your next Ability gains +1d2 Spellpower.
~Entropy Reversal~.Name: ~Entropy Reversal~

~Wave Collapse~.Effect: {Spark(6)} Slam a Unit 1d6 meters towards a wall.
~Wave Collapse~.Notes: You can Slam yourself. Ceilings and floors do not count as walls.
~Wave Collapse~.Name: ~Wave Collapse~

~Reverse Gravity~.Effect:
Declare an area with a diameter in meters (in all directions) equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die (whenever it was).
The gravity becomes reversed in that area and all Units instantly fall upwards. Units can make a Instinct Check to grab onto an object to not be lifted.
Units suffer fall Damage if they fall onto a ceiling.
When the effect ends, all Units fall at half velocity (and take half of the fall Damage). The same happens to a Unit if it exits the area.
Lasts for up to 1 minute. You can cancel this effect at will.
~Reverse Gravity~.Notes: Fall Damage is 1d6 for every 2 meters fallen (e.g. 1d6 for 2 and 3 meters, 2d6 for 4 and 5 meters, etc).
~Reverse Gravity~.Name: ~Reverse Gravity~

~Hearth Recall~.Effect:
You can spend 10 minutes in a place to Bind to it.
When you use this Ability, channel for 10 minutes to teleport a number of allies you can see up to your last rolled Unstable Spark die (whenever it was) to that place.
You can only have 1 bound place at a time.
~Hearth Recall~.EffectRed: Actually, you _can_ teleport more Allies than that, but the teleportation will have strange side effects or consequences...
~Hearth Recall~.Notes: You can remove the binding of a place at will, from any distance.
~Hearth Recall~.Name: ~Hearth Recall~

~Synchronicity Convection~.Effect: Whenever ^you^ generate a Plot Point for your team, you generate 2 instead.
~Synchronicity Convection~.Name: ~Synchronicity Convection~

<Chakra!>.Effect:
{Spark(7)} gain 1 {Mana}Mana.
{Spark(8)} replenish 1 {Mana}Mana of ally you can see.
<Chakra!>.Name: <Chakra!>

~Floccinaucinihilipilification~.Effect: Consume all _Nihil Charges_ to zap all Units within 3 meters for that much {Orange(Flux)} Damage.

~Retrograde Alignment~.Effect: {Spark('8')} freely cast the last Enemy Ability or attack against you.
~Retrograde Alignment~.Name: ~Retrograde Alignment~

~Karmic Decay~.Effect: When you trigger the maximum effect of Unstable Spark (e.g. 10), that Spell gains +100% Damage instead, but the _next_ next Spell you cast deals -50% Damage.
~Karmic Decay~.Name: ~Karmic Decay~

~Defenestration Vortex~.Effect: All your Unstable Spark dice are doubled. If they exceed 10, the overflow over 10 counts as another rolled Unstable Spark die.
~Defenestration Vortex~.Notes: For example, if you roll 8, that becomes 16. Then 16 becomes 2 separate dice, 10 and 6.
~Defenestration Vortex~.Name: ~Defenestration Vortex~

<Chronomancism>.Effect:
Instantly return to how and where you were at the start of your turn (or your previous turn if it's not currently your turn), with that same Movement, Actions, Health, Shielding, Buffs and Cooldowns (not {Mana}Mana, though).
Alternatively, if you're out of combat, you can turn back time for all the world up to 10 minutes, exactly how it was, but retaining all your information from the future. Allies don't retain the information.
<Chronomancism>.Name: <Chronomancism>

~Lagcore~.Effect:
At the start of every Combat, you can alter the way the Enemies are positioned relative to you: you can place them anywhere on the battlefield as long as they are at the same distance from you.
Roughly 25% of the Enemies start combat Lagged.
~Lagcore~.Name: ~Lagcore~
~Lagcore~.Notes: A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.

~Obviate~.Effect: {Spark(9)} the next projectile an enemy fires vanishes into thin air.
~Obviate~.Name: ~Obviate~

~Butterfly Effect~.Effect:
Immediately end your Turn and take another one.
You skip your next Turn.
~Butterfly Effect~.Name: ~Butterfly Effect~

~Arcane Anomaly~.Effect:
{Spark(9)} summon a 3x3 meter Arcane Anomaly anywhere you choose on the battlefield, which may change the shape and terrain of the area affected.

Units standing in them are Deafened.
At the end of your Turn, all Arcane Anomalies deal 1d6 Psychic Damage to Units inside them.
_Units inside anomalies may be prompted to choose different actions by the Quest Master..._
~Arcane Anomaly~.Name: ~Arcane Anomaly~
~Arcane Anomaly~.Notes: A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.

<Grand Sorcery>.Effect:
Arcane power flows potently through your veins! Whenever you would roll one or more Unstable Spark dice, roll 3 more.
Whenever you would roll dice for a Spell, all the dice are a baseline d10, no matter what die type it is (can still have ^Dice Upgraded^).
<Grand Sorcery>.Upgrade: Your appearance changes to reflect your sorcerer powers, resulting in glowing eyes, or your hair resembling a particular element, like fire or electricity.
<Grand Sorcery>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Grand Sorcery>.Name: <Grand Sorcery>

<Locus of Control>.Effect:
You gain control over your own magic, and, whenever you would roll an Unstable Spark die, you can instead choose the number. In fact, whenever you roll one or more dice for a Spell, instead of rolling half of them, you can even choose the numbers.
Screw it, once per Round, when someone else would roll a die, just name what number you want and it happens!
<Locus of Control>.Upgrade: The control over magic reflects in your physical appearance, resulting in effects such as contracted pupils, uncannily smooth body and hair, or an uncoventionally toned voice.
<Locus of Control>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Locus of Control>.Name: <Locus of Control>

<Draconianism>.Effect:
Your natural form changes to that of a large, winged dragon. Your base Maximum {Mana}Mana increases by 10 and your base Max Health by 50%. You can fly at your normal Speed.
You must choose what color you are as a dragon. As your breath attack, you can cast any Basic Ability that deals Damage and doesn't cost {Mana}Mana, and it also hits all Units within 2 meters of the main target. You also take -50% Damage from the Damage Type of your chosen Ability.
<Draconianism>.Upgrade: You can transform into your person-self at will, but, to you, your dragon form is more comfortable.
<Draconianism>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Draconianism>.Name: <Draconianism>

~Loan Shark~.Effect:
Loan a non-playable character anywhere between 100 and 500 {Gold}.
After a set amount of time, you get it back with 1d100 interest.
If the interest is 9% or less, you get nothing back.
~Loan Shark~.Name: ~Loan Shark~

~Combo Machine~.Effect: Whenever a combo is triggered, the target takes....
~Combo Machine~.Name: ~Combo Machine~

~180 to Hell~.Effect:
Choose an Enemy within 3 meters.
You quickly dash to the diametrically opposite space, on its other side, at the same distance.
~180 to Hell~.Notes: For example, if you're 3 meters to the South of a Unit, you move so that you become 3 meters to the North of it. Your starting space, the Enemy, and your landing space must be on the same line. Requires a clear path, but you can circle 'round the back.
~180 to Hell~.Name: ~180 to Hell~

~Raise~.Effect:
Use immediately before rolling a Blood in the Water attack.
If the attack deals Damage equal to or above its _average_, gain {Gold}Gold equal to 200% of the rolled amount.
Otherwise, the attack misses.
~Raise~.Name: ~Raise~

~What Have We Here~.Effect:
You can spend 1 minute to fast talk a non-playable character to try to bamboozle their morality.
Make a Presence Check against their Presence Check.
If you succeed, _steal_ a random Quirk it has. Otherwise, they notice you're trying to bamboozle them.
~What Have We Here~.Name: ~What Have We Here~

~I Know A Guy~.Effect: Use when in a town or hub to add 1d4 to an Focus Check, to bring up a reason as to why you know extra details about it. It can be about a particular subject you've encountered before, a person you know there, etc.
~I Know A Guy~.Upgrade: Come up with a story on why you are already familiar with that subject matter!
~I Know A Guy~.Name: ~I Know A Guy~

~Blood in the Water~.Effect:
If your last 2 Acts that did Damage both either triggered a {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} or a ~Combo~, your next targeted {Type} {A}Action Point Act deals +{Amount}% Damage.

{Variants}
~Blood in the Water~.Notes: Note that misses do not break your chains of critting attacks, since only Acts that did Damage count towards this! For example, if you crit an attack, then miss, then crit another attack, then your next attack ^will^ benefit from Blood in the Water!
~Blood in the Water~.Name: ~Blood in the Water~

~Sharp End~.Effect: Your next offensive attack or Ability deals +1d4 Damage and triggers its {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} and ~Combo~ effect anyway, but misses if you roll 1 on any of the dice!
~Sharp End~.Upgrade: If it can not {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critically Strike')}, it further deals an extra +1d4 Damage and counts as a {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} anyway.
~Sharp End~.Name: ~Sharp End~

~Hack and Slash~.Notes:
Roll the attack only once. Weapon effects (like Critical Strikes), if necessary, are applied to the main target only.
This may benefit from Blood in the Water.

Variants.Name: Hack and Slash
Variants.Eff: melee Two-Handed weapon attack also hits all other Units within weapon range, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Slice and Dice
Variants.Eff: melee One-Handed weapon attack also hits all other Units within weapon range.

Variants.Name: Lock and Load
Variants.Eff: ranged Two-Handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Point and Shoot
Variants.Eff: ranged One-Handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target.

~Hack and Slash~.Name: ~Hack and Slash~

<Deflect>.Effect: Reduce the Damage of a weapon attack you or a Unit near you receives by 100%.
<Deflect>.Notes: Works for ranged weapons. Melee body parts are considered weapons.
<Deflect>.Name: <Deflect>

~Payday~.Effect: For the rest of the Combat, gain 25 {Gold}Gold whenever you use an {A}Action Point.
~Payday~.Name: ~Payday~

~All or Nothing~.Effect: Add 1d6 to an attack's Damage. If the total is _odd_, the attack misses, but you Heal for 1.
~All or Nothing~.Name: ~All or Nothing~

~Overunder Blow~.Effect:
You have +1 Focus (up to your Stat Limit).
Instead of dealing extra Damage with Blood in the Water, do one of the following:
SingleTable: 1. Heal yourself for that amount
2. Single-Stun the target (Double-Stun for two-handed weapons)
3. Freely move that many meters
4. Push the target that many meters
~Overunder Blow~.Notes: Pushing only works on non-Epic Units.
~Overunder Blow~.Name: ~Overunder Blow~

<At Me!>.Effect: After landing 2 non-Critical Strikes in a row on a Unit, inflict a random Control Effect from the following options. Then the Unit becomes immune to ^At Me!^ for the rest of the Combat.
<At Me!>.Upgrade: If they were both with a Two-Handed weapon, the Control Effect applied is doubled (Double-Slowed, Double-Blind, etc)!
<At Me!>.Name: <At Me!>
<At Me!>.Notes:
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

<10 Percent Luck>.Effect: Reroll one non-Check die you just rolled. If it rolls 1, the Act misses.
<10 Percent Luck>.Name: <10 Percent Luck>

~Came To Collect~.Effect:
Use a ranged weapon to shoot a Worthy Unit for 1d4 Damage.
Then, if it died, choose a permanent upgrade for this Ability from below.
SingleTable: 1. Dice Upgraded to the next die type
2. Cooldown improved*
3. Gain Gold equal to 1000% of the rolled Damage
4. Restores 1 Health on use
~Came To Collect~.Upgrade: You can use this for Abilities that specify one-handed or {1AP} weapons.
~Came To Collect~.Notes: Cooldown improved follows the following pattern, starting from the base Cooldown: Once / 2 Turns, Once / Turn, Twice / Turn, Thrice / Turn, etc.
~Came To Collect~.Name: ~Came To Collect~

~Strafe and Backpedal~.Effect: After you move from place 2 times on the same Round, your next weapon attack triggers its Critical Strike regardless, but misses if you roll 1 on at least one die.
~Strafe and Backpedal~.Name: ~Strafe and Backpedal~

<Duel To Death>.Requirement: Only usable on Units with 50% or more Health
<Duel To Death>.Effect:
Challenge a non-Epic Worthy Enemy to a duel to the death!
The two of you take Turns one after another until one of you reaches 0 Health.
Neither of you can move away from eachother until the duel is over.
If you win, roll on the table to permanently improve your Hero!
<Duel To Death>.Notes: First, you continue your Turn; then the Enemy has its turn. After the duel is over, resume Turn order, as if you just finished your Turn. All of these Turns happen on the same Round, as if in a vaccuum (e.g. Round number does not increase for some effects' purposes).
<Duel To Death>.Name: <Duel To Death>

<Dry Gulch>.Effect: Your next attack deals extra Damage equal to 50% of how many meters you moved this Round.
<Dry Gulch>.Name: <Dry Gulch>

~Drunken Bluff~.Effect:
After you roll an attack this Combat, you can make it miss on purpose.

Whenever you miss or do 0 Damage with an attack, your next one deals +1d8 Damage this Combat.
~Drunken Bluff~.Name: ~Drunken Bluff~

~Steady Hands~.Effect: Your multi-dice attacks that miss if they roll 1 on any of the dice now miss if they roll 1 on ~at least two~ of the dice.
~Steady Hands~.Name: ~Steady Hands~

~Off-Hand Shank~.Effect: Make 3 attacks with a {1AP} weapon you haven't used this Turn that would normally scale with a Stat. These attacks do not add any Stat to the Damage, and miss if they roll 1 on any of the dice.
~Off-Hand Shank~.Upgrade: You may apply Sharp End, Blood in the Water, or similar effects to individual attacks.
~Off-Hand Shank~.Notes: If the weapon jams or breaks, it does so after you finish the attacks.
~Off-Hand Shank~.Name: ~Off-Hand Shank~

~Circle Round~.Effect: Slam the target 1d6 meters away from you. Then, if the space is not blocked, you can dash behind it.
~Circle Round~.Downside: Only usable immediately after a Blood in the Water attack.
~Circle Round~.Name: ~Circle Round~

<Swing Thing>.Effect:
Use when a Unit within 5 meters (or yourself) becomes affected by a Control Effect.
Slam it 1d8 meters in any direction.
<Swing Thing>.Notes: Requires a Whiplash item, which can be bought for 50 {Gold}Gold (or freely crafted for the same price in materials).
<Swing Thing>.Name: <Swing Thing>

<Momentum Dance>.Effect: Gain 1 Shielding equal to your 400% of your Initiative.
<Momentum Dance>.Name: <Momentum Dance>

<High Noon>.Requirement: Only usable on the 3rd Round of Combat
<High Noon>.Effect:
Make 6 attacks with a {1AP} ranged weapon, which miss if they roll 1 on any of the dice.
Further High Noon attacks on the same Unit (after the first) deal -50% Damage.
<High Noon>.Notes: Each attack may miss individually, not all at the same time.
<High Noon>.Name: <High Noon>

<Exude Damage>.Effect: Your first offensive melee Act every Turn deals Damage equal to your Movement Speed to all other Units within 2 meters of the main target.
<Exude Damage>.Notes: Excluding the main target and yourself.
<Exude Damage>.Name: <Exude Damage>

~Sharp and Pointy End~.Effect:
~Use after you landed an offensive attack or Ability.~
~Add~ +1d4 Damage and trigger its {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} and ~Combo~ effect anyway!
~Sharp and Pointy End~.Upgrade: If it can not {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critically Strike')}, it also deals +1d4 Damage and counts as a {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} anyway.
~Sharp and Pointy End~.Name: ~Sharp and Pointy End~

~Switcheroo~.Effect:
After you deal at least 10 Damage with a {Type1} attack, your next {Type2} attack this Turn deals +1d4 Damage.

~Both Variants can trigger one after another.~
~Switcheroo~.Name: ~Switcheroo~

~Been There Done That~.Effect: Once per Adventure, you can introduce an _actually fact_ without spending a Plot Point.
~Been There Done That~.Name: ~Been There Done That~
